import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { type Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';

import { SplitHeading } from '@/components/motion/split-heading';
import { buttonClass } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { findGuide, GUIDES, TOPIC_LABEL } from '@/features/guide/content';
import { GuideArticle, GuideMeta } from '@/features/guide/components/guide-article';
import { GuideIcon } from '@/features/guide/components/guide-icon';
import { plainText } from '@/features/guide/lib/rich';
import { cn } from '@/lib/cn';

export const dynamicParams = false;

export function generateStaticParams() {
  return GUIDES.map((g) => ({ slug: g.slug }));
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const guide = findGuide(slug);
  if (!guide) return {};
  return { title: `${guide.title} — Cẩm nang cầu lông`, description: plainText(guide.lead) };
}

/** Trang riêng của một bài (mở link trực tiếp, tải lại trang, máy tìm kiếm). */
export default async function GuidePage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const guide = findGuide(slug);
  if (!guide) notFound();

  return (
    <article className="pt-6 pb-16 sm:pt-10 sm:pb-24">
      <nav aria-label="Vị trí" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted">
        <Link href="/guide" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:text-ink">
          <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          Cẩm nang
        </Link>
        <span aria-hidden>/</span>
        <span>{TOPIC_LABEL[guide.topic]}</span>
      </nav>

      <header className="mt-6 flex max-w-3xl flex-col gap-4 border-b border-line pb-8 sm:mt-8 sm:pb-10">
        <GuideIcon guide={guide} size="lg" />
        <GuideMeta guide={guide} className="text-muted" />
        <SplitHeading as="h1" className="text-[2.6rem] leading-[1.02] sm:text-6xl">
          {guide.title}
        </SplitHeading>
      </header>

      <div className="mt-8 grid gap-12 sm:mt-10 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_19rem] lg:gap-16">
        <div className="max-w-3xl min-w-0">
          <GuideArticle guide={guide} />
        </div>
        <aside className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:sticky lg:top-24 lg:self-start">
          <nav aria-label="Các bài trong cẩm nang" className="rounded-2xl border border-line p-2">
            <p className="px-3 pt-2 pb-1 text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.14em] text-muted uppercase">Trong cẩm nang</p>
            <ol>
              {GUIDES.map((g, i) => {
                const current = g.slug === guide.slug;
                return (
                  <li key={g.slug}>
                    <Link
                      href={`/guide/${g.slug}`}
                      scroll={false}
                      aria-current={current ? 'page' : undefined}
                      className={cn(
                        'flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-[0.95rem] transition-colors',
                        current ? 'bg-ink text-paper' : 'hover:bg-hall',
                      )}
                    >
                      <span className={cn('w-6 font-display tabular', current ? 'text-court' : 'text-muted')}>
                        {String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{g.title}</span>
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ol>
          </nav>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-court p-5 text-on-court">
            <p className="font-display text-2xl leading-tight">Sẵn sàng ra sân?</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-ink/75">Xem giờ trống và giữ sân trong một phút, không cần tài khoản.</p>
            <Link href="/booking" className={buttonClass('primary', 'md', 'w-full')}>
              Đặt sân ngay
              <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';

import { findGuide, GUIDES } from '@/features/guide/content';
import { GuideArticle, GuideMeta } from '@/features/guide/components/guide-article';
import { GuideDialog } from '@/features/guide/components/guide-dialog';
import { GuideIcon } from '@/features/guide/components/guide-icon';

export const dynamicParams = false;

export function generateStaticParams() {
  return GUIDES.map((g) => ({ slug: g.slug }));
}

/** Bấm thẻ ở trang Cẩm nang → đọc bài trong hộp thoại, trang phía sau giữ nguyên vị trí cuộn. */
export default async function GuideModalPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const guide = findGuide(slug);
  if (!guide) notFound();
  const titleId = `guide-title-${guide.slug}`;
  return (
    <GuideDialog
      titleId={titleId}
      header={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
          <GuideIcon guide={guide} size="md" />
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <GuideMeta guide={guide} className="text-muted" />
            <h2 id={titleId} className="mt-0.5 text-[1.6rem] leading-tight sm:text-[2rem]">
              {guide.title}
            </h2>
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <GuideArticle guide={guide} inDialog />
    </GuideDialog>
  );
}

import { ArrowRight, Clock3, MapPin } from 'lucide-react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';

import { MediaImage } from '@/components/brand/media-image';
import { bookingHref } from '@/features/booking/lib/links';
import { type HomeBranch } from '@/features/home/queries';
import { formatVnd } from '@/lib/format';
import { shortTime } from '@/lib/time';

interface Props {
  branches: HomeBranch[];
  date: string | null;
  time: string | null;
}

function BranchVisual({ branch }: { branch: HomeBranch }) {
  return (
    <div className="rly-branch-photo">
      <Link href={`/branches/${branch.slug}`} aria-label={`Xem chi tiết ${branch.name}`} className="rly-branch-photo-link">
        {branch.coverImagePath ? (
          <MediaImage path={branch.coverImagePath} alt={`Sân cầu lông ${branch.name}`} sizes="(min-width: 900px) 620px, 100vw" className="rly-branch-cover" />
        ) : (
          <Image src="/images/hero-court.webp" alt="Không gian sân cầu lông Rally" fill sizes="(min-width: 900px) 620px, 100vw" className="rly-branch-cover-img" />
        )}
      </Link>
      <span className={`rly-branch-open ${branch.isOpen ? 'is-open' : ''}`}>
        <span aria-hidden="true" />{branch.isOpen ? 'Đang mở cửa' : 'Ngoài giờ hoạt động'}
      </span>
      <span className="rly-branch-count">{branch.courtCount} sân</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function BranchCard({ branch, index, date, time }: { branch: HomeBranch; index: number; date: string | null; time: string | null }) {
  const addr = [branch.addressLine, branch.district, branch.city].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
  const slots = branch.slots.slice(0, 4);
  const mainHref = bookingHref(branch.slug, { date, time });
  return (
    <article className={`rly-branch-card ${index === 0 ? 'is-featured' : ''}`}>
      <BranchVisual branch={branch} />
      <div className="rly-branch-content">
        <p className="rly-branch-small">CHI NHÁNH {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</p>
        <h3><Link href={`/branches/${branch.slug}`}>{branch.name}</Link></h3>
        <p className="rly-branch-address"><MapPin size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> <span>{addr}</span></p>
        <div className="rly-branch-facts">
          <div><span>Giá tham khảo từ</span><strong>{branch.minPrice === null ? 'Liên hệ' : formatVnd(branch.minPrice)}{branch.minPrice !== null && <small> /giờ</small>}</strong></div>
          <div><span>Giờ hoạt động</span><strong><Clock3 size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> {shortTime(branch.opensAt)} - {shortTime(branch.closesAt)}</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div className="rly-branch-timebox">
          <p>{branch.slotsIsToday ? 'Giờ trống gợi ý hôm nay' : 'Giờ trống gợi ý ngày mai'}</p>
          {slots.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="rly-branch-times">
              {slots.map((slot) => slot.freeCourts > 0 ? (
                <Link key={slot.start} href={bookingHref(branch.slug, { date: branch.slotsDate, time: slot.start })} title={`Còn ${slot.freeCourts} sân lúc ${slot.start}`}>
                  {slot.start}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                <span key={slot.start} className="is-full" title="Hết sân">{slot.start}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : <p className="rly-branch-times-empty">Chọn ngày trên lịch để xem khung giờ khả dụng.</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="rly-branch-actions">
          <Link className="rly-btn rly-btn-red" href={mainHref}>Xem lịch & đặt sân <ArrowRight size={18} aria-hidden="true" /></Link>
          <Link className="rly-btn rly-btn-secondary" href={`/branches/${branch.slug}`}>Thông tin sân</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

export function RallyBranchCards({ branches, date, time }: Props) {
  return (
    <div className={`rly-branch-grid ${branches.length === 1 ? 'is-single' : ''}`}>
      {branches.map((branch, index) => (
        <BranchCard key={branch.id} branch={branch} index={index} date={date} time={time} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// RALLY_PRODUCT_SHOWCASE_V6: data-driven product catalog
import {
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowUpRight,
  BadgeCheck,
  ChevronDown,
  CircleHelp,
  Clock3,
  Footprints,
  MapPin,
  Package,
  Search,
  ShieldCheck,
  Shirt,
  ShoppingBag,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Tag,
} from 'lucide-react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';

import { MediaImage } from '@/components/brand/media-image';
import { formatVnd } from '@/lib/format';
import { isSupabaseConfigured } from '@/lib/env';
import { CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE, listBranchOptions, listCatalog, listCategories, type CatalogItem } from '../queries';
import { ProductPlaceholder } from './product-placeholder';

export interface ProductSearchParams {
  q?: string;
  category?: string;
  branch?: string;
  page?: string;
}

type FilterState = { q?: string; category?: string; branch?: string };

function clean(value: string | undefined, max: number) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return undefined;
  return value.trim().slice(0, max) || undefined;
}

function buildHref(filters: FilterState, patch: Partial<FilterState> & { page?: number } = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  const merged = { ...filters, ...patch };
  for (const key of ['q', 'category', 'branch'] as const) {
    if (merged[key]) params.set(key, merged[key]);
  }
  if (patch.page && patch.page > 1) params.set('page', String(patch.page));
  const query = params.toString();
  return query ? `/products?${query}` : '/products';
}

function categoryIcon(label: string) {
  const v = label.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/đ/g, 'd');
  if (v.includes('giay')) return Footprints;
  if (v.includes('quan') || v.includes('ao')) return Shirt;
  if (v.includes('nuoc') || v.includes('uong')) return ShoppingBag;
  if (v.includes('phu')) return Package;
  if (v.includes('vot')) return Tag;
  return ShieldCheck;
}

function ProductCard({ item }: { item: CatalogItem }) {
  const discounted = item.compareAtPrice !== null && item.compareAtPrice > item.minPrice;
  const discount = discounted && item.compareAtPrice !== null
    ? Math.max(0, Math.min(99, Math.round((1 - item.minPrice / item.compareAtPrice) * 100)))
    : 0;
  const available = item.available > 0;
  const lowStock = item.available > 0 && item.available <= 3;
  const priceLabel = `${item.minPrice !== item.maxPrice ? 'Từ ' : ''}${formatVnd(item.minPrice)}`;

  return (
    <li className="rally-shop-product">
      <Link href={`/products/${item.id}`} className="rally-shop-product-link" aria-label={`Xem chi tiết ${item.name}`}>
        <div className="rally-shop-product-image">
          {item.coverPath ? (
            <MediaImage path={item.coverPath} alt={item.name} className="rally-shop-media" sizes="(min-width: 1100px) 260px, (min-width: 700px) 33vw, 50vw" />
          ) : (
            <ProductPlaceholder name={item.name} category={item.categoryName} kind={item.kind} className="rally-shop-media" />
          )}
          {discounted && discount > 0 && <span className="rally-shop-sale">-{discount}%</span>}
          {item.isBundle && <span className="rally-shop-bundle">Combo</span>}
        </div>
        <div className="rally-shop-product-details">
          <span className="rally-shop-category">{item.categoryName ?? item.brandName ?? 'Vật phẩm'}</span>
          <h3 className="rally-shop-product-name">{item.name}</h3>
          <div className="rally-shop-product-bottom">
            <div className="rally-shop-price-block">
              <div className="rally-shop-prices">
                <span className={discounted ? 'rally-shop-price is-sale' : 'rally-shop-price'}>{priceLabel}</span>
                {discounted && item.compareAtPrice !== null && <s>{formatVnd(item.compareAtPrice)}</s>}
              </div>
              <span className={available ? 'rally-shop-stock is-available' : 'rally-shop-stock is-out'}>
                <span className="rally-shop-stock-dot" />
                {available ? (lowStock ? `Chỉ còn ${item.available}` : 'Còn hàng') : 'Tạm hết hàng'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="rally-shop-product-open" aria-hidden="true"><ArrowUpRight size={20} /></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Link>
    </li>
  );
}

function FilterPanel({ categories, branches, filters }: {
  categories: ReadonlyArray<{ slug: string; name: string }>;
  branches: ReadonlyArray<{ id: string; name: string }>;
  filters: FilterState;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rally-shop-filters" id="bo-loc-san-pham">
      <form className="rally-shop-searchform" action="/products" method="get">
        {filters.category && <input type="hidden" name="category" value={filters.category} />}
        <div className="rally-shop-input-wrap">
          <Search size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
          <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="rally-shop-search">Tên sản phẩm hoặc thương hiệu</label>
          <input id="rally-shop-search" name="q" type="search" defaultValue={filters.q ?? ''} placeholder="Tìm vợt, cầu, giày, đồ uống..." autoComplete="off" />
        </div>
        <div className="rally-shop-select-wrap">
          <MapPin size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
          <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="rally-shop-branch">Chi nhánh</label>
          <select id="rally-shop-branch" name="branch" defaultValue={filters.branch ?? ''}>
            <option value="">Mọi chi nhánh</option>
            {branches.map((branch) => <option key={branch.id} value={branch.id}>{branch.name}</option>)}
          </select>
          <ChevronDown size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        </div>
        <button className="rally-shop-filter-submit" type="submit"><SlidersHorizontal size={17} /> Lọc sản phẩm</button>
      </form>
      <nav className="rally-shop-chip-strip" aria-label="Lọc nhóm sản phẩm">
        <Link href={buildHref(filters, { category: undefined })} className={`rally-shop-chip ${!filters.category ? 'is-current' : ''}`} aria-current={!filters.category ? 'page' : undefined}>Tất cả</Link>
        {categories.map((category) => {
          const Icon = categoryIcon(category.name);
          return <Link key={category.slug} href={buildHref(filters, { category: category.slug })} className={`rally-shop-chip ${filters.category === category.slug ? 'is-current' : ''}`} aria-current={filters.category === category.slug ? 'page' : undefined}><Icon size={15} /> {category.name}</Link>;
        })}
      </nav>
    </div>
  );
}

export async function RallyProductShowcase({ searchParams }: { searchParams: ProductSearchParams }) {
  const q = clean(searchParams.q, 60);
  const category = clean(searchParams.category, 60);
  const branch = clean(searchParams.branch, 36);
  const rawPage = Number.parseInt(searchParams.page ?? '1', 10);
  const page = Number.isFinite(rawPage) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(200, rawPage)) : 1;
  const filters: FilterState = { q, category, branch };
  const configured = isSupabaseConfigured();
  const [result, categories, branches] = configured
    ? await Promise.all([
        listCatalog({ kind: 'sale', q, category, branchId: branch && /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(branch) ? branch : undefined, page }),
        listCategories(),
        listBranchOptions(),
      ])
    : [null, [], []] as const;
  const totalPages = result ? Math.ceil(result.total / CATALOG_PAGE_SIZE) : 0;

  return (
    <div className="rally-shop">
      <section className="rally-shop-hero full-bleed" aria-labelledby="rally-shop-title">
        <div className="rally-shop-hero-photo" aria-hidden="true">
          <Image src="/images/shop-banner.webp" alt="" fill priority sizes="100vw" className="rally-shop-hero-image" />
        </div>
        <div className="rally-shop-hero-content">
          <div className="rally-shop-hero-inner">
            <p className="rally-shop-eyebrow">RALLY BADMINTON <span>/</span> VẬT PHẨM</p>
            <h1 id="rally-shop-title">Trang bị chuẩn.<br className="rally-shop-hero-break" /> Chơi bứt phá.</h1>
            <p className="rally-shop-hero-copy">Từ cầu lông, vợt, giày đến nước uống và phụ kiện. Chọn đúng món đồ cho buổi chơi, xem giá và kiểm tra hàng tại chi nhánh Rally.</p>
            <div className="rally-shop-hero-benefits" aria-label="Thông tin mua sắm">
              <span><BadgeCheck size={19} /> Giá bán minh bạch</span>
              <span><MapPin size={19} /> Theo từng chi nhánh</span>
              <span><ShoppingBag size={19} /> Nhận hàng tại quầy</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span className="rally-shop-hero-corner" aria-hidden="true">RALLY / READY TO PLAY</span>
      </section>

      <div className="rally-shop-main">
        <FilterPanel categories={categories} branches={branches} filters={filters} />
        <div className="rally-shop-section-heading">
          <div>
            <p className="rally-shop-kicker">TỦ ĐỒ CỦA NGƯỜI CHƠI CẦU</p>

          </div>
          {result && <p className="rally-shop-result-count">{result.total} sản phẩm</p>}
        </div>

        {!configured ? (
          <div className="rally-shop-state" role="status"><CircleHelp size={24} /><h3>Danh mục chưa được kết nối</h3><p>Hãy cấu hình kết nối Supabase để hiển thị sản phẩm đang bán.</p></div>
        ) : !result ? (
          <div className="rally-shop-state" role="status"><CircleHelp size={24} /><h3>Chưa thể tải danh mục</h3><p>Vui lòng thử tải lại trang sau ít phút.</p></div>
        ) : result.items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rally-shop-state"><Search size={26} /><h3>Chưa tìm thấy sản phẩm phù hợp</h3><p>Thử từ khóa khác hoặc bỏ bớt bộ lọc để xem thêm sản phẩm.</p><Link href="/products" className="rally-shop-reset">Xóa bộ lọc <ArrowRight size={16} /></Link></div>

              <nav className="rally-shop-pagination" aria-label="Phân trang danh sách sản phẩm">
                {page > 1 ? <Link href={buildHref(filters, { page: page - 1 })}>← Trang trước</Link> : <span />}
                <span>Trang {page} / {totalPages}</span>
                {page < totalPages ? <Link href={buildHref(filters, { page: page + 1 })}>Trang sau →</Link> : <span />}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowDown, ArrowRight, ArrowUpRight, Check, ChevronDown, CircleHelp, Clock3, MapPin, PackageCheck, Search, SlidersHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';

export interface RentalSearchParams {
  q?: string;
  category?: string;
  branch?: string;
  page?: string;
}

type RentalFilters = Pick<RentalSearchParams, 'q' | 'category' | 'branch'>;
type CategoryOption = { slug: string; name: string };
type BranchOption = { id: string; name: string };

function clean(value: string | undefined, max: number): string | undefined {
  const text = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim().slice(0, max) : '';
  return text || undefined;
}

function RentalFilterPanel({
  filters,
  branches,
  categories,
}: {
  filters: RentalFilters;
  branches: ReadonlyArray<BranchOption>;
  categories: ReadonlyArray<CategoryOption>;
}) {

  return (
    <aside className="rally-rental-filter" aria-label="Bộ lọc dụng cụ cho thuê">

        <div>

        </div>
      </div>
      <form action="/rentals" method="get" className="rally-rental-filter-form" data-nav-progress>
        <label htmlFor="rental-search">Tên dụng cụ</label>
        <div className="rally-rental-input-wrap">
          <Search aria-hidden size={17} />
          <input id="rental-search" name="q" type="search" defaultValue={filters.q ?? ''} placeholder="Vợt, giày, combo..." />
        </div>
        <label htmlFor="rental-branch">Chi nhánh</label>
        <div className="rally-rental-select-wrap">
          <MapPin aria-hidden size={17} />
          <select id="rental-branch" name="branch" defaultValue={filters.branch ?? ''}>
            <option value="">Tất cả chi nhánh</option>
            {branches.map((branch) => <option key={branch.id} value={branch.id}>{branch.name}</option>)}
          </select>
          <ChevronDown aria-hidden size={15} />
        </div>
        <label htmlFor="rental-category">Loại dụng cụ</label>
        <div className="rally-rental-select-wrap">
          <PackageCheck aria-hidden size={17} />
          <select id="rental-category" name="category" defaultValue={filters.category ?? ''}>
            <option value="">Tất cả loại</option>

          </select>

      <div className="rally-rental-filter-note">
        <Clock3 aria-hidden size={19} />

      </div>
    </aside>
  );

function RentalCard({ item }: { item: CatalogItem }) {

          )}
          {item.isBundle && <span className="rally-rental-combo">COMBO</span>}

          <h3>{item.name}</h3>

          <div className="rally-rental-item-price">

            <strong>{formatVnd(item.minPrice)}</strong>
          </div>
          <div className="rally-rental-item-bottom">
            <span className={available ? 'rally-rental-available' : 'rally-rental-unavailable'}>
              <span aria-hidden className="rally-rental-stock-dot" />
              {available ? 'Đang có dụng cụ' : 'Hiện không có sẵn'}
            </span>
            <span className="rally-rental-open" aria-label={`Xem chi tiết ${item.name}`}><ArrowUpRight aria-hidden size={20} /></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Link>
    </li>
  );
}

export async function RallyRentalExperience({ searchParams }: { searchParams: RentalSearchParams }) {

  const configured = isSupabaseConfigured();

    </div>

'use client';

import { Minus, Pause, Play, Plus, RotateCcw, ScanEye, Map } from 'lucide-react';
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { cn } from '@/lib/cn';
import { COURT, COURT_MODES, courtCaption, isServeMode, playArea, serviceBoxes, serveSide, type CourtMode } from '../lib/court';

import '../court-arena-3d.css';

const ArenaScene = dynamic(() => import('./court-arena-three').then((m) => m.CourtArenaScene), { ssr: false });

type View = 'angle' | 'top';

function PlanB({ mode, score }: { mode: CourtMode; score: number }) {
  const x0 = 74, y0 = 46, len = 630, width = 288;
  const px = (a: number) => x0 + a / COURT.length * len;
  const py = (a: number) => y0 + a / COURT.width * width;
  const area = playArea(mode);
  const serve = isServeMode(mode);
  const boxes = serviceBoxes(mode === 'serve-doubles' || mode === 'doubles' ? 'serve-doubles' : 'serve-singles', score);
  const rect = (r: {x:number;y:number;w:number;h:number}) => ({ x:px(r.x),y:py(r.y),width:r.w/COURT.length*len,height:r.h/COURT.width*width });
  const [a,b] = [boxes.server, boxes.target];
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 780 382" className="rga-plan" role="img" aria-label={`Sơ đồ sân cầu lông 2D: ${courtCaption(mode,score)}`}>
      <defs><linearGradient id="rga-fallback-green" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="1"><stop stopColor="#116c47"/><stop offset="1" stopColor="#05412e"/></linearGradient></defs>
      <rect width="780" height="382" rx="14" fill="#092d24"/>
      <rect x={x0-9} y={y0-9} width={len+18} height={width+18} fill="#033324" rx="8"/>
      <rect x={x0} y={y0} width={len} height={width} fill="url(#rga-fallback-green)"/>
      {(mode === 'singles'||mode === 'serve-singles') && <><rect x={x0} y={y0} width={len} height={py(COURT.sideAlley)-y0} fill="#062921" opacity=".65"/><rect x={x0} y={py(COURT.width-COURT.sideAlley)} width={len} height={py(COURT.sideAlley)-y0} fill="#062921" opacity=".65"/></>}
      {serve && <><rect {...rect(a)} fill="#ffffff" fillOpacity=".13" stroke="#d3ff8c" strokeWidth="2" strokeDasharray="7 6"/><rect {...rect(b)} fill="#9ddf55" fillOpacity=".36" stroke="#e31837" strokeWidth="3" strokeDasharray="8 5"/></>}
      <g stroke="#f8fff9" strokeWidth="2" fill="none">
        <rect x={x0} y={y0} width={len} height={width}/>
        <path d={`M${x0} ${py(.46)}H${x0+len} M${x0} ${py(5.64)}H${x0+len}`}/>
        <path d={`M${px(1.98+COURT.length/2)} ${y0}V${y0+width} M${px(COURT.length/2-1.98)} ${y0}V${y0+width}`}/>
        <path d={`M${px(.76)} ${y0}V${y0+width} M${px(COURT.length-.76)} ${y0}V${y0+width}`}/>
        <path d={`M${x0} ${py(3.05)}H${px(COURT.length/2-1.98)} M${px(COURT.length/2+1.98)} ${py(3.05)}H${x0+len}`}/>
      </g>
      <path d={`M${px(6.7)} ${y0-9}V${y0+width+9}`} stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth="5" />
      <g opacity=".45" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth=".8">{Array.from({length:22},(_,i)=><line key={i} x1={px(6.7)-3} x2={px(6.7)+3} y1={y0+i*width/21} y2={y0+i*width/21}/>)}</g>
      <circle cx={px(a.x+a.w*.64)} cy={py(a.y+a.h/2)} r="13" fill="#e31837" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth="3" />
      <circle cx={px(b.x+b.w*.4)} cy={py(b.y+b.h/2)} r="13" fill="#a3e26a" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth="3" />

    </svg>

/** Riêng cho trang /guide. Giữ CourtExplorer SVG nguyên bản trong các bài học chi tiết. */
export function CourtArena3D({ initial = 'serve-doubles', className }: { initial?: CourtMode; className?: string }) {
  const [mode,setMode] = useState<CourtMode>(initial);
  const [score,setScore] = useState(0);
  const [view,setView] = useState<View>('angle');
  const [paused,setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [show3D,setShow3D] = useState(true);
  const [visible,setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [failed,setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [ready,setReady] = useState(false);
  const intersectionRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const onReady = useCallback(() => setReady(true), []);
  const onError = useCallback(() => { setFailed(true); setReady(false); }, []);
  const serving = isServeMode(mode);
  const effective3D = show3D && !failed;
  const caption = courtCaption(mode, score);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Respect system preference on first load. The user may explicitly press Play.
    if (window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) setPaused(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = intersectionRef.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') { setVisible(true); return; }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      if (entries[0]?.isIntersecting) { setVisible(true); io.disconnect(); }
    }, { rootMargin: '220px' });
    io.observe(el);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <section className={cn('rga-root', className)} aria-label="Mô phỏng sân cầu lông ba chiều">
      <header className="rga-toolbar">
        <div className="rga-toolbar-heading"><span className="rga-live-dot" /> RALLY / SÂN CẦU LÔNG 3D</div>
        <button type="button" className="rga-switch" disabled={failed} onClick={() => { setReady(false); setShow3D((v) => !v); }} aria-pressed={!effective3D}>
          {effective3D ? <Map size={15} aria-hidden /> : <ScanEye size={15} aria-hidden />}{failed ? 'Chế độ 2D dự phòng' : effective3D ? 'Sơ đồ 2D' : 'Trở lại 3D'}
        </button>
      </header>
      <div className="rga-modes" role="group" aria-label="Chọn chế độ sân">
        {COURT_MODES.map((item) => <button key={item.mode} type="button" className={mode===item.mode?'is-active':''} aria-pressed={mode===item.mode} onClick={() => setMode(item.mode)}>{item.label}</button>)}
      </div>
      <div className="rga-stage" ref={intersectionRef}>
        {effective3D && visible ? <ArenaScene mode={mode} score={score} view={view} paused={paused} onError={onError} onReady={onReady} /> : <PlanB mode={mode} score={score}/>}
        {effective3D && !visible && <div className="rga-loading" aria-live="polite">Sân 3D sẽ tải khi bạn cuộn đến đây</div>}
        {effective3D && visible && !ready && <div className="rga-loading" aria-live="polite">Đang dựng sân 3D…</div>}
        {effective3D && ready && (
          <div className={cn('rga-playback-status', paused && 'is-paused')} role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <span className="rga-playback-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
            {paused ? 'Đã tạm dừng' : 'Đang mô phỏng'}
          </div>
        )}
        {effective3D && ready && paused && (
          <div className="rga-pause-overlay" aria-hidden="true">
            <span className="rga-pause-icon"><Pause size={22} strokeWidth={2.3}/></span>
            <span>Mô phỏng đã tạm dừng</span>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="rga-stage-meta" aria-hidden="true"><span><i className="rga-player-red"/> NGƯỜI CHƠI A</span><span><i className="rga-player-green"/> NGƯỜI CHƠI B</span></div>
      </div>
      <div className="rga-controls">
        <div className="rga-scene-buttons">
          <button type="button" disabled={!effective3D || !ready} onClick={() => setView((v) => v==='angle'?'top':'angle')}><RotateCcw size={16} aria-hidden/> {view==='angle'?'Nhìn từ trên':'Góc phối cảnh'}</button>
          <button type="button" className={cn('rga-play-toggle', paused && 'is-paused')} disabled={!effective3D || !ready} aria-pressed={paused} aria-label={paused ? 'Tiếp tục phát hoạt cảnh 3D' : 'Tạm dừng hoạt cảnh 3D'} onClick={() => setPaused((v) => !v)}>{paused?<Play size={16} aria-hidden/>:<Pause size={16} aria-hidden/>}{paused?'Tiếp tục':'Tạm dừng'}</button>
        </div>
        {serving && <div className="rga-score"><span>Điểm bên giao</span><div className="rga-stepper"><button type="button" disabled={score<=0} aria-label="Giảm điểm" onClick={() => setScore((v)=>Math.max(0,v-1))}><Minus size={16} aria-hidden/></button><output aria-live="polite">{score}</output><button type="button" disabled={score>=30} aria-label="Tăng điểm" onClick={() => setScore((v)=>Math.min(30,v+1))}><Plus size={16} aria-hidden/></button></div><strong>Ô {serveSide(score)==='right'?'phải':'trái'}</strong></div>}
      </div>
      <p className="rga-caption" aria-live="polite">{caption}</p>
      <p className="rga-note">Hai nhân vật mô phỏng động tác đánh cầu để minh họa; các vạch sân và ô giao cầu tuân theo chế độ đang chọn. Trên máy tính, kéo chuột để xoay sân 3D.</p>
    </section>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type { Group, Object3D, Mesh, Material, WebGLRenderer, Scene, PerspectiveCamera, Vector3 } from 'three';

import { COURT, isServeMode, serviceBoxes, type CourtMode } from '../lib/court';

type View = 'angle' | 'top';
type SceneProps = {
  mode: CourtMode;
  score: number;
  view: View;
  paused: boolean;
  onReady: () => void;
  onError: () => void;
};
type Puppet = { body: Group; rightArm: Group; leftArm: Group; rightLeg: Group; leftLeg: Group };

/** Rally Guide V12.3: procedural shuttle and anatomically connected racket grip. */
export function CourtArenaScene(props: SceneProps) {
  const container = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const latest = useRef(props);
  const notify = useRef({ onReady: props.onReady, onError: props.onError });
  const isIntersecting = useRef(true);
  latest.current = props;
  notify.current = { onReady: props.onReady, onError: props.onError };

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = container.current;
    if (!el) return;
    let alive = true;
    let raf = 0;
    let renderer: WebGLRenderer | null = null;
    let scene: Scene | null = null;
    let camera: PerspectiveCamera | null = null;
    let ro: ResizeObserver | null = null;
    let io: IntersectionObserver | null = null;
    let onVisibility = () => {};
    let removeDrag = () => {};
    let onContextLost = (_e: Event) => {};

    void (async () => {
      try {
        const T = await import('three');
        if (!alive) return;
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        canvas.style.width = '100%';
        canvas.style.height = '100%';
        canvas.style.display = 'block';
        canvas.style.touchAction = 'pan-y';
        onContextLost = (event: Event) => { event.preventDefault(); notify.current.onError(); };
        canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', onContextLost, false);
        el.appendChild(canvas);
        // WebGL fails here on unsupported devices and the parent switches to SVG fallback.
        const gl = new T.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: true, powerPreference: 'low-power' });
        renderer = gl;
        gl.setClearColor('#052c20', 0);
        gl.outputColorSpace = T.SRGBColorSpace;
        gl.toneMapping = T.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
        gl.toneMappingExposure = 1.4;
        gl.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, window.innerWidth < 680 ? 1.25 : 1.65));
        gl.shadowMap.enabled = window.innerWidth >= 900;
        gl.shadowMap.type = T.PCFSoftShadowMap;

        const stage = new T.Scene();
        scene = stage;
        stage.fog = new T.FogExp2('#072d22', 0.016);
        const cam = new T.PerspectiveCamera(36, 1, 0.1, 110);
        camera = cam;
        stage.add(new T.HemisphereLight('#dffff1', '#103a2a', 2.2));
        const sun = new T.DirectionalLight('#ffffff', 3.0);
        sun.position.set(-5, 13, 6);
        sun.castShadow = gl.shadowMap.enabled;
        sun.shadow.mapSize.set(1024,1024);
        sun.shadow.camera.left = -10; sun.shadow.camera.right = 10;
        sun.shadow.camera.top = 10; sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -10;
        sun.shadow.normalBias = 0.02;
        stage.add(sun);
        const rim = new T.DirectionalLight('#5af4be', 2.1);
        rim.position.set(6, 6, -10);
        stage.add(rim);

        const green = new T.MeshStandardMaterial({ color:'#05734b', roughness:.77, metalness:.06 });
        const surround = new T.MeshStandardMaterial({ color:'#073c2c', roughness:.94, metalness:0 });
        const boundary = new T.MeshStandardMaterial({ color:'#e9fff4', roughness:.6, emissive:'#5b957c', emissiveIntensity:.13 });
        const tape = new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#f7fff7', roughness:.6});
        const pad = new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(24,.12,28), surround);
        pad.position.y = -0.12;
        pad.receiveShadow = true;
        stage.add(pad);

        field.position.y = -.027;
        field.receiveShadow = true;
        stage.add(field);
        const line = (x1:number,z1:number,x2:number,z2:number,weight=.044) => {
          const cx=(x1+x2)/2, cz=(z1+z2)/2;
          const length=Math.hypot(x2-x1,z2-z1);
          const mesh=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(weight,.012,length),boundary);
          mesh.position.set(cx,.023,cz);
          mesh.rotation.y = Math.atan2(x2-x1,z2-z1);
          stage.add(mesh);
        };
        const W=COURT.width/2, L=COURT.length/2;
        // Court dimensions: singles sidelines 0.46m inside, doubles long service 0.76m inside.
        for (const x of [-W,W,-W+COURT.sideAlley,W-COURT.sideAlley]) line(x,-L,x,L);
        for (const z of [-L,L,-L+COURT.doublesLong,L-COURT.doublesLong,-COURT.shortService,COURT.shortService]) line(-W,z,W,z);
        line(0,-L,0,-COURT.shortService); line(0,COURT.shortService,0,L);

        // Actual net mesh built from fine horizontal and vertical threads.
        const poleMat=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#dfe8e6',metalness:.55,roughness:.36});
        for(const x of [-W-.035,W+.035]) {
          const pole=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(.035,.05,1.63,10),poleMat);
          pole.position.set(x,.815,0);pole.castShadow=true;stage.add(pole);
        }
        const netThread=new T.LineBasicMaterial({color:'#d4e9e2',transparent:true,opacity:.46});
        const netLines:number[]=[];
        for(let x=-W; x<=W+.0001;x+=.19)netLines.push(x,.09,0,x,1.52,0);
        for(let y=.1;y<=1.5;y+=.18)netLines.push(-W,y,0,W,y,0);
        const netGeometry=new T.BufferGeometry();
        netGeometry.setAttribute('position',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(netLines,3));
        stage.add(new T.LineSegments(netGeometry,netThread));
        const topTape=new T.Mesh(new T.BoxGeometry(COURT.width+.1,.048,.045),tape);
        topTape.position.set(0,1.53,0);stage.add(topTape);

        // Court highlight overlays, using the same rules as the site's original SVG.
        const highlightMat=new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:'#acff73',transparent:true,opacity:.24,depthWrite:false,side:T.DoubleSide});
        const markMat=new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:'#ffffff',transparent:true,opacity:.15,depthWrite:false,side:T.DoubleSide});
        const shadeMat=new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:'#00180f',transparent:true,opacity:.44,depthWrite:false,side:T.DoubleSide});
        const sheet=new T.PlaneGeometry(1,1);
        const serverOverlay=new T.Mesh(sheet,markMat), targetOverlay=new T.Mesh(sheet,highlightMat);
        const offsideLeft=new T.Mesh(sheet,shadeMat), offsideRight=new T.Mesh(sheet,shadeMat);
        const overlays=[serverOverlay,targetOverlay,offsideLeft,offsideRight];
        overlays.forEach((m)=>{m.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;m.position.y=.041;stage.add(m);});
        const setRect=(m:Mesh,r:{x:number;y:number;w:number;h:number})=>{
          // Court rules: x is length from 0 to 13.4, y is width from 0 to 6.1.
          m.position.x=r.y+r.h/2-W;
          m.position.z=r.x+r.w/2-L;
          m.scale.set(r.h,r.w,1);
        };

        const skin=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#eab68e',roughness:.8});
        const blackHair=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#151c21',roughness:1});
        const shoe=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#e9f0ed',roughness:.7});
        const shortMat=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#17262a',roughness:.8});
        const shirtA=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#e31837',roughness:.75});
        const shirtB=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#b8f55d',roughness:.75});
        const handleMat=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#111717',metalness:.3,roughness:.6});
        const racketA=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#101e1c',metalness:.48,roughness:.4});
        const racketB=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#e7e7e7',metalness:.42,roughness:.38});
        const stringMat=new T.LineBasicMaterial({color:'#f9fff9',transparent:true,opacity:.66});
        const add=(parent:Group, geometry:object, material:Material, pos:[number,number,number], cast=true) => {
          const mesh=new T.Mesh(geometry as ConstructorParameters<typeof T.Mesh>[0],material);
          mesh.position.set(...pos);
          mesh.castShadow=cast;
          parent.add(mesh);
          return mesh;
        };
        const limb=(group:Group,from:[number,number,number],to:[number,number,number],radius:number,material:Material) => {
          const a=new T.Vector3(...from),b=new T.Vector3(...to);
          const m=add(group,new T.CylinderGeometry(radius*.94,radius,a.distanceTo(b),10),material,[(a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2,(a.z+b.z)/2]);
          m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new T.Vector3(0,1,0),b.clone().sub(a).normalize());
          return m;
        };

        function createPlayer(color:Material, frameMat:Material):Puppet {
          const root=new T.Group(), person=new T.Group();
          root.add(person);stage.add(root);
          add(person,new T.CylinderGeometry(.28,.23,.6,12),color,[0,1.13,0]);
          add(person,new T.CylinderGeometry(.25,.25,.27,12),shortMat,[0,.78,0]);
          add(person,new T.SphereGeometry(.185,16,12),skin,[0,1.67,0]);
          add(person,new T.SphereGeometry(.192,16,12,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI*.35),blackHair,[0,1.746,0]);
          add(person,new T.CylinderGeometry(.09,.11,.22,10),skin,[0,1.46,0]);
          const leftLeg=new T.Group(), rightLeg=new T.Group();
          leftLeg.position.set(-.13,.73,0);rightLeg.position.set(.13,.73,0);
          person.add(leftLeg,rightLeg);
          for(const [g,x] of [[leftLeg,-.09],[rightLeg,.09]] as const){
            limb(g,[0,0,0],[x,-.35,.12],.105,skin);
            limb(g,[x,-.35,.12],[x*1.5,-.67,.04],.072,skin);
            add(g,new T.BoxGeometry(.17,.11,.29),shoe,[x*1.5,-.68,.12]);
          }
          const leftArm=new T.Group(), rightArm=new T.Group();
          leftArm.position.set(-.27,1.34,0);rightArm.position.set(.27,1.34,0);
          person.add(leftArm,rightArm);
          limb(leftArm,[0,0,0],[-.16,-.3,.08],.075,skin);
          limb(leftArm,[-.16,-.3,.08],[-.18,-.48,.17],.055,skin);
          limb(rightArm,[0,0,0],[.17,-.23,.13],.075,skin);
          limb(rightArm,[.17,-.23,.13],[.31,-.41,.21],.053,skin);
          // The wrist ends exactly at the handle: no floating racket or gap at the grip.
          const wrist:[number,number,number]=[.31,-.41,.21];
          add(rightArm,new T.SphereGeometry(.07,12,10),skin,wrist);
          const racket=new T.Group();
          racket.position.set(...wrist);
          racket.rotation.set(-.2,0,-.48);
          rightArm.add(racket);

          // Handle (through the palm), narrow shaft, two-neck throat and oval head.
          const grip=new T.Mesh(new T.CylinderGeometry(.027,.03,.22,12),handleMat);
          grip.position.y=-.005;
          racket.add(grip);
          for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
            const wrap=add(racket,new T.TorusGeometry(.029,.0016,5,14),racketB,[0,-.09+i*.042,0],false);
            wrap.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;
          }
          limb(racket,[0,.102,0],[0,.315,0],.012,frameMat);
          limb(racket,[0,.302,0],[-.075,.375,0],.010,frameMat);
          limb(racket,[0,.302,0],[.075,.375,0],.010,frameMat);
          const headCenter=.605, headW=.195, headH=.264;
          const outline:Vector3[]=[];
          for(let i=0;i<64;i++){
            const angle=i/64*Math.PI*2;
            outline.push(new T.Vector3(Math.cos(angle)*headW,headCenter+Math.sin(angle)*headH,0));
          }
          add(racket,new T.TubeGeometry(new T.CatmullRomCurve3(outline,true),72,.012,7,true),frameMat,[0,0,0]);
          const strings:number[]=[];
          for(let x=-.175;x<=.176;x+=.043){
            const h=headH*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(x/headW)**2));
            strings.push(x,headCenter-h,0,x,headCenter+h,0);
          }
          for(let y=-.238;y<=.239;y+=.044){
            const w=headW*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-(y/headH)**2));
            strings.push(-w,headCenter+y,0,w,headCenter+y,0);
          }
          const gStrings=new T.BufferGeometry();
          gStrings.setAttribute('position',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(strings,3));
          racket.add(new T.LineSegments(gStrings,stringMat));

          // Thumb plus curled fingers visibly wrap around the grip instead of hovering beside it.
          for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
            const finger=add(racket,new T.TorusGeometry(.032,.010,6,12,Math.PI*1.42),skin,[0,-.044+i*.026,0]);
            finger.rotation.set(Math.PI/2,0,.28);
          }
          const thumb=add(racket,new T.SphereGeometry(.026,10,8),skin,[.034,.059,.012]);
          thumb.scale.set(.9,1.65,.9);
          return {body:root,rightArm,leftArm,leftLeg,rightLeg};
        }
        const playerA=createPlayer(shirtA,racketA), playerB=createPlayer(shirtB,racketB);
        playerB.body.rotation.y=Math.PI;

        // Lightweight procedural feather shuttle: rounded cork, dark binding,
        // sixteen individual feather vanes and two fine strengthening rings.
        // Deliberately 1.3x the real-world scale so it remains legible on mobile.
        const shuttle=new T.Group();stage.add(shuttle);
        shuttle.scale.setScalar(1.3);
        const corkMat=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#f5e4c7',roughness:.93});
        const bandMat=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#203b30',roughness:.77});
        const featherMat=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#fffdf2',roughness:.9,side:T.DoubleSide});
        const ribMat=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#d8ded4',roughness:.82});
        add(shuttle,new T.SphereGeometry(.077,18,12),corkMat,[0,-.033,0]);
        add(shuttle,new T.CylinderGeometry(.077,.072,.082,18),corkMat,[0,.025,0]);
        add(shuttle,new T.CylinderGeometry(.082,.079,.024,18),bandMat,[0,.08,0]);

        const featherCount=16;
        for(let i=0;i<featherCount;i++){
          const a=i/featherCount*Math.PI*2;
          const radial=new T.Vector3(Math.cos(a),0,Math.sin(a));
          const tangent=new T.Vector3(-Math.sin(a),0,Math.cos(a));
          // The vanes flare away from the cork; unlike cones, the open rim is visible.
          const levels=[
            {y:.095,r:.064,w:.008},
            {y:.155,r:.10,w:.023},
            {y:.245,r:.149,w:.041},
            {y:.335,r:.203,w:.050},
            {y:.418,r:.242,w:.044},
          ];
          const vertices:number[]=[];
          for(const row of levels){
            for(const side of [-1,1]){
              const point=radial.clone().multiplyScalar(row.r).addScaledVector(tangent,side*row.w/2);
              vertices.push(point.x,row.y,point.z);
            }
          }
          const triangles:number[]=[];
          for(let j=0;j<levels.length-1;j++){
            const k=j*2;
            triangles.push(k,k+1,k+2,k+1,k+3,k+2);
          }
          const vaneGeo=new T.BufferGeometry();
          vaneGeo.setAttribute('position',new T.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices,3));
          vaneGeo.setIndex(triangles);
          vaneGeo.computeVertexNormals();
          add(shuttle,vaneGeo,featherMat,[0,0,0],false);
          const start=radial.clone().multiplyScalar(.067); start.y=.1;
          const end=radial.clone().multiplyScalar(.239); end.y=.417;
          limb(shuttle,[start.x,start.y,start.z],[end.x,end.y,end.z],.004,ribMat);
        }
        for(const [radius,height] of [[.138,.225],[.194,.326]] as const){
          const binding=add(shuttle,new T.TorusGeometry(radius,.0035,5,36),ribMat,[0,height,0],false);
          binding.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;
        }
        // The cork points into the direction of travel, feathers follow behind it.
        const flightAxis=new T.Vector3(0,-1,0);
        const flightDirection=new T.Vector3();
        const flightRotation=new T.Quaternion();
        const shuttleTrail=new T.Line(new T.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([new T.Vector3(0,0,0),new T.Vector3(0,0,0)]),new T.LineBasicMaterial({color:'#d0ff9a',transparent:true,opacity:.38}));
        const trailPositions=shuttleTrail.geometry.getAttribute('position');
        stage.add(shuttleTrail);

        // High-angle overview on initial load. Desktop: drag to orbit. Mobile: buttons only.
        let azimuth=.72, elevation=.78, camRadius=20;
        let targetAzimuth=.72, targetElevation=.78;
        let isDragging=false,lastX=0,lastY=0;
        const onDown=(e:PointerEvent)=>{if(e.pointerType!=='mouse'||e.button!==0)return;isDragging=true;lastX=e.clientX;lastY=e.clientY;canvas.style.cursor='grabbing';};
        const onMove=(e:PointerEvent)=>{if(!isDragging)return;targetAzimuth+=(e.clientX-lastX)*.006;targetElevation=Math.max(.4,Math.min(1.33,targetElevation+(e.clientY-lastY)*.004));lastX=e.clientX;lastY=e.clientY;};
        const onUp=()=>{isDragging=false;canvas.style.cursor='grab';};
        canvas.style.cursor='grab';
        canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',onDown);window.addEventListener('pointermove',onMove);window.addEventListener('pointerup',onUp);
        removeDrag=()=>{canvas.removeEventListener('pointerdown',onDown);window.removeEventListener('pointermove',onMove);window.removeEventListener('pointerup',onUp);};

        const resize=()=>{
          const width=Math.max(1,el.clientWidth), height=Math.max(1,el.clientHeight);
          gl.setSize(width,height,false);
          cam.aspect=width/height;
          cam.fov=height>width ? 49 : 36;
          cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
        };
        resize();
        ro=new ResizeObserver(resize);ro.observe(el);
        io=new IntersectionObserver((events)=>{isIntersecting.current=events[0]?.isIntersecting??false;}, {threshold:.02});
        io.observe(el);
        onVisibility=()=>{if(!document.hidden)isIntersecting.current=true;};
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',onVisibility);
        let lastFrame=0,lastMode='', frozenTime=0;
        let lastTime=performance.now();
        const tick=(now:number)=>{
          if(!alive)return;
          raf=window.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          if(document.hidden||!isIntersecting.current){lastTime=now;return;}
          // Avoid running the GPU at 60fps on mobile / low-powered devices.
          const minMs=window.innerWidth<680?34:17;
          if(now-lastFrame<minMs)return;
          const delta=Math.min((now-lastTime)/1000,.1); lastTime=now;lastFrame=now;
          const p=latest.current;
          const key=p.mode+':'+p.score;
          const serving=isServeMode(p.mode);
          const box=serviceBoxes(p.mode==='serve-doubles'||p.mode==='doubles'?'serve-doubles':'serve-singles',p.score);
          const toXZ=(r:{x:number;y:number;w:number;h:number},t=.5)=>({x:r.y+r.h*.5-W,z:r.x+r.w*t-L});
          if(lastMode!==key){
            lastMode=key;
            serverOverlay.visible=serving;targetOverlay.visible=serving;
            if(serving){setRect(serverOverlay,box.server);setRect(targetOverlay,box.target);}
            const singles=p.mode==='singles'||p.mode==='serve-singles';
            offsideLeft.visible=singles;offsideRight.visible=singles;
            if(singles){
              setRect(offsideLeft,{x:0,y:0,w:COURT.length,h:COURT.sideAlley});
              setRect(offsideRight,{x:0,y:COURT.width-COURT.sideAlley,w:COURT.length,h:COURT.sideAlley});
            }
          }
          const from=serving?toXZ(box.server,.64):{x:-.65,z:-3.5};
          const to=serving?toXZ(box.target,.36):{x:1,z:3.4};
          // Playback clock stops exactly when paused. On resume it advances from the frozen pose.
          // Reduced-motion is handled by the React control (initially paused),
          // so an explicit user Play action can always start the animation.
          if(!p.paused) frozenTime += delta;
          const play=frozenTime;
          const wave=Math.sin(play*4.4);
          playerA.body.position.set(from.x+wave*.18,0,from.z+.20*Math.cos(play*3.4));
          playerB.body.position.set(to.x-wave*.18,0,to.z+.20*Math.cos(play*3.4+2));
          playerA.rightArm.rotation.z=-.5+Math.sin(play*4.8)*1.05;
          playerB.rightArm.rotation.z=-.5+Math.sin(play*4.8+Math.PI)*1.05;
          playerA.rightArm.rotation.x=-.4+Math.sin(play*4.8)*.45;
          playerB.rightArm.rotation.x=-.4-Math.sin(play*4.8)*.45;
          playerA.leftArm.rotation.z=.1+Math.sin(play*2.3)*.15;
          playerB.leftArm.rotation.z=.1+Math.sin(play*2.3+Math.PI)*.15;
          playerA.leftLeg.rotation.x=Math.sin(play*3.4)*.22;
          playerB.leftLeg.rotation.x=-Math.sin(play*3.4)*.22;
          const phase=(play*.72)%2;
          const u=phase<1?phase:2-phase;
          shuttle.position.set(from.x+(to.x-from.x)*u,1.7+1.65*Math.sin(u*Math.PI),from.z+(to.z-from.z)*u);
          const directionSign=phase<1?1:-1;
          flightDirection.set(
            (to.x-from.x)*directionSign,
            1.65*Math.PI*Math.cos(u*Math.PI)*directionSign,
            (to.z-from.z)*directionSign,
          ).normalize();
          // Smoothly turn the cork into the flight path. Pause freezes the orientation too.
          if(!p.paused){
            flightRotation.setFromUnitVectors(flightAxis,flightDirection);
            shuttle.quaternion.slerp(flightRotation,Math.min(1,delta*10));
          }
          trailPositions.setXYZ(0,shuttle.position.x,shuttle.position.y,shuttle.position.z);
          const behind=flightDirection.clone().multiplyScalar(-.35);
          trailPositions.setXYZ(1,shuttle.position.x+behind.x,shuttle.position.y+behind.y,shuttle.position.z+behind.z);
          trailPositions.needsUpdate=true;
          const top=p.view==='top';
          const desiredA=top?0:targetAzimuth;
          const desiredE=top?1.53:targetElevation;
          azimuth+=(desiredA-azimuth)*.1;
          elevation+=(desiredE-elevation)*.1;
          const dist=top?21:camRadius;
          cam.position.set(dist*Math.sin(azimuth)*Math.cos(elevation),dist*Math.sin(elevation),dist*Math.cos(azimuth)*Math.cos(elevation));
          cam.lookAt(0,0,0);
          gl.render(stage,cam);
        };
        notify.current.onReady();
        raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } catch (_err) { if(alive) notify.current.onError(); }
    })();
    return ()=>{
      alive=false;
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      ro?.disconnect();io?.disconnect();removeDrag();
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',onVisibility);
      if(renderer){
        renderer.domElement.removeEventListener('webglcontextlost',onContextLost,false);
        renderer.dispose();
        if(renderer.domElement.parentElement===el)el.removeChild(renderer.domElement);
      }
      if(scene){
        scene.traverse((object:Object3D)=>{
          if('geometry' in object){const g=(object as Mesh).geometry;g?.dispose?.();}
          if('material' in object){const mats=(object as Mesh).material;for(const m of Array.isArray(mats)?mats:[mats])m?.dispose?.();}
        });
      }
      void camera;
    };
  }, []);
  return <div className="rga-three-host" ref={container} style={{ width:'100%',height:'100%',position:'relative' }} />;
}

'use client';

import { Minus, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { gsap, useGSAP } from '@/components/motion/gsap';
import { cn } from '@/lib/cn';

import {
  COURT,
  COURT_MODES,
  courtCaption,
  isServeMode,
  NET_X,
  playArea,
  serveSide,
  serviceBoxes,
  type CourtMode,
  type Rect,
} from '../lib/court';

/** Tỉ lệ vẽ: 1 m = 40 đơn vị SVG. */
const S = 40;
const W = COURT.length * S;
const H = COURT.width * S;
const MAX_SCORE = 30;

interface Point {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

interface Geometry {
  area: Rect;
  server: Rect;
  target: Rect;
  from: Point;
  to: Point;
  serve: boolean;
}

const px = (r: Rect): Rect => ({ x: r.x * S, y: r.y * S, w: r.w * S, h: r.h * S });
const attrs = (r: Rect) => ({ x: r.x, y: r.y, width: r.w, height: r.h });

function geometry(mode: CourtMode, score: number): Geometry {
  const area = px(playArea(mode));
  const serve = isServeMode(mode);
  const boxes = serviceBoxes(mode === 'doubles' || mode === 'serve-doubles' ? 'serve-doubles' : 'serve-singles', score);
  const server = px(boxes.server);
  const target = px(boxes.target);
  return {
    area,
    server,
    target,
    serve,
    // Người giao đứng gần vạch giao cầu ngắn, giữa ô; cầu rơi vào giữa ô đối diện.
    from: { x: server.x + server.w * 0.78, y: server.y + server.h / 2 },
    to: { x: target.x + target.w * 0.45, y: target.y + target.h / 2 },
  };
}

/** Đường bay cong nhẹ (nhìn từ trên xuống) từ người giao tới ô nhận. */
function flightPath(from: Point, to: Point): string {
  const cx = (from.x + to.x) / 2;
  const cy = Math.min(from.y, to.y) - Math.abs(to.y - from.y) * 0.35 - 18;
  return `M ${from.x} ${from.y} Q ${cx} ${cy} ${to.x} ${to.y}`;
}

const reducedMotion = () => typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/**
 * Sơ đồ sân tương tác: bấm Đánh đơn / Đánh đôi / Giao cầu để xem phần sân được dùng.
 * Ở chế độ giao cầu, đổi điểm số để thấy người giao đứng ô phải hay trái.
 */
export function CourtExplorer({ initial = 'singles', className }: { initial?: CourtMode; className?: string }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<CourtMode>(initial);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  // Giá trị ban đầu cố định: sau lần vẽ đầu, GSAP điều khiển vị trí các khối (React không ghi đè).
  const [first] = useState(() => geometry(initial, 0));
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const g = geometry(mode, score);
  const caption = courtCaption(mode, score);

  useGSAP(
    () => {
      const el = root.current;
      if (!el) return;
      const q = gsap.utils.selector(el);
      const d = reducedMotion() ? 0 : 0.55;
      const ease = 'power3.inOut';
      gsap.to(q('[data-area]'), { attr: attrs(g.area), opacity: g.serve ? 0.35 : 1, duration: d, ease });
      gsap.to(q('[data-server]'), { attr: attrs(g.server), opacity: g.serve ? 1 : 0, duration: d, ease });
      gsap.to(q('[data-target]'), { attr: attrs(g.target), opacity: g.serve ? 1 : 0, duration: d, ease });
      gsap.to(q('[data-player]'), { attr: { cx: g.from.x, cy: g.from.y }, opacity: g.serve ? 1 : 0, duration: d, ease });

      const shuttle = q('[data-shuttle]');
      gsap.killTweensOf(shuttle);
      if (!g.serve) {
        gsap.to(shuttle, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.2 });
        return;
      }
      const path = q('[data-flight]')[0];
      if (!(path instanceof SVGPathElement) || d === 0) {
        gsap.set(shuttle, { attr: { cx: g.to.x, cy: g.to.y }, opacity: 1 });
        return;
      }
      const len = path.getTotalLength();
      const at = { t: 0 };
      gsap.set(path, { strokeDashoffset: 0 });
      gsap.set(shuttle, { opacity: 1, attr: { cx: g.from.x, cy: g.from.y } });
      gsap.to(at, {
        t: 1,
        delay: d * 0.6,
        duration: 0.9,
        ease: 'power1.inOut',
        onUpdate: () => {
          const p = path.getPointAtLength(at.t * len);
          gsap.set(shuttle, { attr: { cx: p.x, cy: p.y } });
        },
      });
    },
    { scope: root, dependencies: [mode, score] },
  );

  const serve = isServeMode(mode);
  const side = serveSide(score) === 'right' ? 'phải' : 'trái';

  return (
    <div ref={root} className={cn('flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-[1.5rem] bg-hall-dark p-3 text-paper sm:gap-4 sm:p-5', className)}>
      <div role="group" aria-label="Chế độ sơ đồ sân" className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-xl bg-paper/8 p-1 sm:grid-cols-4">
        {COURT_MODES.map((m) => (
          <button
            key={m.mode}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={mode === m.mode}
            onClick={() => setMode(m.mode)}
            className={cn(
              'min-h-10 rounded-lg px-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors',
              mode === m.mode ? 'bg-court text-on-court shadow-sm' : 'text-paper/75 hover:bg-paper/10 hover:text-paper',
            )}
          >
            {m.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <svg viewBox={`-34 -30 ${W + 68} ${H + 62}`} role="img" aria-label={caption} className="h-auto w-full select-none">
        {/* Mặt sân */}
        <rect x={0} y={0} width={W} height={H} fill="#1d4d29" />
        <rect data-area {...attrs(first.area)} fill="#2f8a3a" opacity={first.serve ? 0.35 : 1} />
        <rect data-server {...attrs(first.server)} fill="#ffffff" fillOpacity={0.16} opacity={first.serve ? 1 : 0} />
        <rect data-target {...attrs(first.target)} fill="#62bb46" opacity={first.serve ? 1 : 0} />

        {/* Vạch kẻ */}
        <g fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth={2.5} strokeLinecap="square">
          <rect x={0} y={0} width={W} height={H} />
          <path d={`M0 ${COURT.sideAlley * S} H${W} M0 ${H - COURT.sideAlley * S} H${W}`} />
          <path d={`M${(NET_X - COURT.shortService) * S} 0 V${H} M${(NET_X + COURT.shortService) * S} 0 V${H}`} />
          <path d={`M${COURT.doublesLong * S} 0 V${H} M${W - COURT.doublesLong * S} 0 V${H}`} />
          <path d={`M0 ${H / 2} H${(NET_X - COURT.shortService) * S} M${(NET_X + COURT.shortService) * S} ${H / 2} H${W}`} />
        </g>

        {/* Viền ô giao cầu (vẽ trên vạch để luôn thấy rõ) */}
        {serve && (
          <g fill="none" strokeWidth={2.5} strokeDasharray="7 6">
            <rect {...attrs(g.server)} stroke="#ffffff" strokeOpacity={0.9} />
            <rect {...attrs(g.target)} stroke="#ED1C24" />
            <path data-flight d={flightPath(g.from, g.to)} stroke="#ffffff" strokeOpacity={0.55} strokeDasharray="3 7" />
          </g>
        )}

        {/* Lưới */}
        <line x1={NET_X * S} x2={NET_X * S} y1={-10} y2={H + 10} stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth={5} />
        <circle cx={NET_X * S} cy={-10} r={5} fill="#ffffff" />
        <circle cx={NET_X * S} cy={H + 10} r={5} fill="#ffffff" />

        <circle
          data-player
          cx={first.from.x}
          cy={first.from.y}
          r={10}
          fill="#000000"
          stroke="#ffffff"
          strokeWidth={3}
          opacity={first.serve ? 1 : 0}
        />
        <circle data-shuttle cx={first.to.x} cy={first.to.y} r={7} fill="#ED1C24" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth={2} opacity={0} />

        {/* Nhãn */}
        <g fill="currentColor" className="text-paper/70" fontSize={12} fontFamily="inherit">
          <text x={NET_X * S} y={-16} textAnchor="middle" fontWeight={600} letterSpacing={1.5}>
            LƯỚI
          </text>
          <g className="hidden sm:inline">
            <text x={W * 0.25} y={H + 26} textAnchor="middle">
              13,4 m
            </text>
            <text x={-14} y={H / 2} textAnchor="middle" transform={`rotate(-90 -14 ${H / 2})`}>
              6,1 m
            </text>
            <text x={(NET_X + COURT.shortService / 2) * S} y={H + 26} textAnchor="middle">
              1,98 m
            </text>
            <text x={W - (COURT.doublesLong / 2) * S} y={-16} textAnchor="middle">
              0,76 m
            </text>
          </g>
        </g>
      </svg>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-1 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5 text-xs text-paper/75">
          <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span aria-hidden className="size-3 rounded-sm bg-[#2f8a3a] ring-1 ring-paper/40" />
            Phần sân được dùng
          </li>
          {serve && (
            <>
              <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span aria-hidden className="size-3 rounded-sm border border-dashed border-paper bg-paper/15" />Ô đứng giao
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span aria-hidden className="size-3 rounded-sm border border-dashed border-shuttle bg-court" />Ô cầu phải rơi vào
              </li>
            </>
          )}
        </ul>
        {serve && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto">
            <span className="text-sm text-paper/75">Điểm bên giao</span>
            <div className="flex items-center rounded-full bg-paper/10 p-0.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label="Bớt 1 điểm"
                disabled={score === 0}
                onClick={() => setScore((s) => Math.max(0, s - 1))}
                className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full transition-colors hover:bg-paper/15 disabled:opacity-35"
              >
                <Minus className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              </button>
              <output aria-live="polite" className="w-9 text-center font-display text-xl tabular">
                {score}
              </output>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label="Thêm 1 điểm"
                disabled={score === MAX_SCORE}
                onClick={() => setScore((s) => Math.min(MAX_SCORE, s + 1))}
                className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full transition-colors hover:bg-paper/15 disabled:opacity-35"
              >
                <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              </button>
            </div>
            <span
              className={cn(
                'rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold',
                side === 'phải' ? 'bg-court text-on-court' : 'bg-shuttle text-paper',
              )}
            >
              Ô {side}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <p aria-live="polite" className="px-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-paper/85">
        {caption}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowRight, Check, Lightbulb, TriangleAlert, X } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';

import { buttonClass } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@/lib/cn';

import { TOPIC_LABEL, nextGuide, type Guide, type GuideBlock } from '../content';
import { readingMinutes } from '../lib/reading';
import { CourtExplorer } from './court-explorer';
import { GuideIcon } from './guide-icon';
import { RichText } from './rich-text';
import { Scoreboard } from './scoreboard';

function Block({ block }: { block: GuideBlock }) {
  switch (block.kind) {
    case 'heading':
      return (
        <h3 className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-3 text-2xl sm:text-[1.7rem]">
          <span aria-hidden className="h-6 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-court" />
          {block.text}
        </h3>
      );
    case 'text':
      return (
        <p className="text-[1.02rem] leading-relaxed text-ink/80">
          <RichText text={block.text} />
        </p>
      );
    case 'list':
      return (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {block.items.map((item, i) => (
            <li key={i} className="flex gap-3 text-[1.02rem] leading-relaxed text-ink/80">
              <span aria-hidden className="mt-[0.6rem] size-2 shrink-0 rotate-45 bg-court" />
              <span>
                {item.term && <strong className="font-semibold text-ink">{item.term}. </strong>}
                <RichText text={item.text} />
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      );
    case 'steps':
      return (
        <ol className="relative flex flex-col gap-5">
          <span aria-hidden className="absolute top-4 bottom-4 left-[1.05rem] w-px bg-line" />
          {block.items.map((step, i) => (
            <li key={i} className="relative flex gap-4">
              <span className="z-[1] grid size-[2.15rem] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-ink font-display text-lg text-paper ring-4 ring-paper">
                {i + 1}
              </span>
              <div className="pt-0.5">
                <h4 className="font-sans text-[1.05rem] font-semibold">{step.title}</h4>
                <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed text-ink/75">
                  <RichText text={step.text} />
                </p>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      );
    case 'cards':
      return (
        <ul className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {block.items.map((card) => (
            <li key={card.title} className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-hall/60 p-4">
              <span aria-hidden className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-court text-on-court">
                <card.icon className="size-5" />
              </span>
              <h4 className="mt-1 font-sans text-base font-semibold">{card.title}</h4>
              <p className="text-[0.95rem] leading-relaxed text-ink/75">
                <RichText text={card.text} />
              </p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      );
    case 'faults':
      return (
        <ol className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {block.items.map((f, i) => (
            <li key={f.title} className="flex gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-paper p-4 sm:gap-4">
              <span aria-hidden className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-shuttle-soft text-shuttle-deep">
                <X className="size-5" strokeWidth={2.5} />
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <h4 className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2 gap-y-1 font-sans text-[1.05rem] font-semibold">
                  <span>
                    {i + 1}. {f.title}
                  </span>
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-hall px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted">{f.alias}</span>
                </h4>
                <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed text-ink/75">
                  <RichText text={f.text} />
                </p>
                {f.allowed && (
                  <p className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-court-deep">
                    <Check className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden strokeWidth={2.5} />
                    <span>
                      <strong className="font-semibold">Không phải lỗi:</strong> {f.allowed}
                    </span>
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      );
    case 'note': {
      const warn = block.tone === 'warn';
      const Icon = warn ? TriangleAlert : Lightbulb;
      return (
        <aside
          className={cn(
            'flex gap-3 rounded-2xl border p-4 sm:p-5',
            warn ? 'border-shuttle/25 bg-shuttle-soft' : 'border-court/35 bg-court-soft',
          )}
        >
          <Icon className={cn('mt-0.5 size-5 shrink-0', warn ? 'text-shuttle-deep' : 'text-court-deep')} aria-hidden />
          <div>
            <p className={cn('font-semibold', warn ? 'text-shuttle-deep' : 'text-court-deep')}>{block.title}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed text-ink/80">
              <RichText text={block.text} />
            </p>
          </div>
        </aside>
      );
    }
    case 'scoreboard':
      return <Scoreboard />;
    case 'court':
      return <CourtExplorer initial={block.initial} />;
    case 'actions':
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
          {block.items.map((a) => (
            <Link key={a.href} href={a.href} className={buttonClass(a.primary ? 'brand' : 'outline', 'lg')}>
              {a.label}
              {a.primary && <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden />}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      );
  }
}

/** Dòng chủ đề · thời gian đọc. */
export function GuideMeta({ guide, className }: { guide: Guide; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <p className={cn('flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.14em] uppercase', className)}>
      <span>{TOPIC_LABEL[guide.topic]}</span>
      <span aria-hidden>·</span>
      <span>{readingMinutes(guide)} phút đọc</span>
    </p>
  );
}

/**
 * Thân bài cẩm nang (dùng chung cho hộp thoại và trang riêng).
 * `inDialog`: liên kết "Bài tiếp theo" thay URL hiện tại để nút Đóng quay về đúng trang Cẩm nang.
 */
export function GuideArticle({ guide, inDialog = false }: { guide: Guide; inDialog?: boolean }) {
  const next = nextGuide(guide.slug);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
      <p className="text-lg leading-relaxed text-ink sm:text-xl">
        <RichText text={guide.lead} />
      </p>
      {guide.blocks.map((b, i) => (
        <Block key={i} block={b} />
      ))}

      <Link
        href={`/guide/${next.slug}`}
        replace={inDialog}
        scroll={!inDialog}
        className="group mt-4 flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-hall/50 p-4 transition-colors hover:border-ink/25 hover:bg-hall"
      >
        <GuideIcon guide={next} size="sm" />
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span className="block text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.14em] text-muted uppercase">Bài tiếp theo</span>
          <span className="block truncate font-display text-xl">{next.title}</span>
        </span>
        <ArrowRight className="size-5 shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" aria-hidden />
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from 'next/link';
