File: supabase/sql/05_product_details.sql
================
-- =============================================================================
-- RALLY BADMINTON — 05_product_details.sql   (BẮT BUỘC cho màn "Quản lý sản phẩm" mới)
-- Chạy sau 00 → 01 → 02 (03, 04 tùy chọn). Chạy lại nhiều lần an toàn.
--
--   * products: trích dẫn, đơn vị tính, nhãn, SEO, kênh hiển thị (website / quầy bán)
--   * product_variants: giá vốn, mã vạch (barcode)
--   * Giá vốn KHÔNG lộ: chỉ đọc qua get_variant_costs() khi có quyền xem danh mục
--   * create_product_full / update_product_full: tạo/sửa sản phẩm + biến thể + tồn đầu kỳ
--     trong MỘT giao dịch. SECURITY INVOKER: RLS (catalog.edit) và quyền inventory.adjust
--     của người gọi vẫn được database kiểm tra.
-- =============================================================================

begin;

-- 1. Cột mới -------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.products
  add column if not exists excerpt text
    constraint products_excerpt_len check (excerpt is null or char_length(excerpt) <= 300),
  add column if not exists unit_label text
    constraint products_unit_label_len check (unit_label is null or char_length(btrim(unit_label)) between 1 and 20),
  add column if not exists tags text[] not null default '{}'
    constraint products_tags_limit check (cardinality(tags) <= 20 and char_length(array_to_string(tags, ',')) <= 600),
  add column if not exists seo_title text
    constraint products_seo_title_len check (seo_title is null or char_length(seo_title) <= 70),
  add column if not exists seo_description text
    constraint products_seo_desc_len check (seo_description is null or char_length(seo_description) <= 320),
  add column if not exists show_on_website boolean not null default true,
  add column if not exists show_on_pos boolean not null default true;

create index if not exists products_tags_gin_idx on public.products using gin (tags);

alter table public.product_variants
  add column if not exists cost_price integer
    constraint product_variants_cost check (cost_price is null or cost_price between 0 and 100000000),
  add column if not exists barcode text
    constraint product_variants_barcode_fmt check (barcode is null or barcode ~ '^[0-9A-Za-z._-]{4,32}$');

create unique index if not exists product_variants_barcode_uidx
  on public.product_variants (barcode) where barcode is not null and deleted_at is null;

comment on column public.products.show_on_website is 'Hiện trên website khách (ngoài điều kiện is_active).';
comment on column public.products.show_on_pos is 'Hiện ở màn hình bán hàng tại quầy.';
comment on column public.product_variants.cost_price is 'Giá vốn — không đọc trực tiếp; dùng public.get_variant_costs (cần catalog.view).';

-- 2. RLS: website chỉ thấy sản phẩm bật kênh website ------------------------------
drop policy if exists products_anon_read on public.products;
create policy products_anon_read on public.products
  for select to anon
  using (is_active and deleted_at is null and show_on_website);

drop policy if exists products_auth_read on public.products;
create policy products_auth_read on public.products
  for select to authenticated
  using (
    (is_active and deleted_at is null and show_on_website)
    or cardinality((select private.permitted_branch_ids('catalog.view'))) > 0);

-- 3. Giá vốn không lộ: khách (anon) và nhân viên chỉ đọc được các cột công khai ----------
--    Nhân viên (authenticated) cũng vậy: giá vốn chỉ đọc qua get_variant_costs (cần quyền catalog.view).
--    Ghi chú: thêm cột mới vào product_variants sau này thì nhớ grant select cột đó cho anon, authenticated.
revoke select on public.product_variants from anon, authenticated;
grant select (id, product_id, sku, size_label, color_label, price_override, is_default, is_active,
              sort_order, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, barcode)
  on public.product_variants to anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.get_variant_costs(p_product_id uuid)
returns table (variant_id uuid, cost_price integer)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select v.id, v.cost_price
    from public.product_variants v
   where v.product_id = p_product_id
     and cardinality((select private.permitted_branch_ids('catalog.view'))) > 0;
$$;
comment on function public.get_variant_costs(uuid) is 'Giá vốn theo biến thể — trả rỗng nếu người gọi không có quyền xem danh mục ở chi nhánh nào.';
revoke all on function public.get_variant_costs(uuid) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.get_variant_costs(uuid) to authenticated;

-- 4. Danh mục công khai: thêm điều kiện kênh website ----------------------------------
create or replace function public.list_catalog(
  p_kind public.product_kind,
  p_category_slug text default null,
  p_branch_id uuid default null,
  p_search text default null,
  p_limit integer default 24,
  p_offset integer default 0)
returns table (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  slug text,
  kind public.product_kind,
  is_bundle boolean,
  brand_name text,
  description text,
  category_name text,
  category_slug text,
  min_price integer,
  max_price integer,
  compare_at_price integer,
  cover_path text,
  available_quantity bigint,
  total_count bigint)
language sql
stable
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
  with params as (
    select nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_search, '')), '') as term,
           least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 24), 1), 60) as lim,
           greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0) as off
  ),
  base as (
    select p.id, p.name, p.slug, p.kind, p.is_bundle, p.brand_name, p.description, p.base_price,
           p.compare_at_price, c.name as cat_name, c.slug as cat_slug
      from public.products p
      left join public.product_categories c on c.id = p.category_id
     where p.kind = p_kind and p.is_active and p.deleted_at is null and p.show_on_website
       and (p_category_slug is null or c.slug = p_category_slug)
       and ((select term from params) is null
            or p.name ilike '%' || replace(replace((select term from params), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
            or coalesce(p.brand_name, '') ilike '%' || replace(replace((select term from params), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
            or exists (select 1 from unnest(p.tags) t where t ilike (select term from params)))
  ),
  variant_stock as (
    select v.product_id, v.id as variant_id,
           coalesce(sum(il.on_hand) filter (where il.is_listed and (p_branch_id is null or il.branch_id = p_branch_id)), 0) as on_hand,
           bool_or(il.is_listed and (p_branch_id is null or il.branch_id = p_branch_id)) as listed
      from public.product_variants v
      left join public.inventory_levels il on il.variant_id = v.id
     where v.is_active and v.deleted_at is null
     group by v.product_id, v.id
  ),
  single_stock as (
    select vs.product_id, sum(vs.on_hand) as qty, bool_or(coalesce(vs.listed, false)) as listed
      from variant_stock vs group by vs.product_id
  ),
  bundle_stock as (
    select bc.bundle_product_id as product_id,
           min(floor(coalesce(vs.on_hand, 0) / bc.quantity))::bigint as qty,
           bool_and(coalesce(vs.listed, false)) as listed
      from public.bundle_components bc
      left join variant_stock vs on vs.variant_id = bc.component_variant_id
     group by bc.bundle_product_id
  ),
  prices as (
    select b.id as product_id,
           case when b.kind = 'sale' then
             (select min(coalesce(v.price_override, b.base_price)) from public.product_variants v
               where v.product_id = b.id and v.is_active and v.deleted_at is null)
           else (select min(r.price) from public.rental_rates r where r.product_id = b.id and r.is_active) end as min_price,
           case when b.kind = 'sale' then
             (select max(coalesce(v.price_override, b.base_price)) from public.product_variants v
               where v.product_id = b.id and v.is_active and v.deleted_at is null)
           else (select max(r.price) from public.rental_rates r where r.product_id = b.id and r.is_active) end as max_price
      from base b
  ),
  joined as (
    select b.id, b.name, b.slug, b.kind, b.is_bundle, b.brand_name, b.description,
           b.cat_name, b.cat_slug, pr.min_price, pr.max_price, b.compare_at_price,
           (select ph.storage_path from public.product_photos ph
             where ph.product_id = b.id order by ph.is_cover desc, ph.sort_order, ph.created_at limit 1) as cover_path,
           case when b.is_bundle then coalesce(bs.qty, 0) else coalesce(ss.qty, 0) end as available_quantity,
           case when b.is_bundle then coalesce(bs.listed, false) else coalesce(ss.listed, false) end as listed
      from base b
      join prices pr on pr.product_id = b.id
      left join single_stock ss on ss.product_id = b.id
      left join bundle_stock bs on bs.product_id = b.id
     where pr.min_price is not null
  )
  select j.id, j.name, j.slug, j.kind, j.is_bundle, j.brand_name, j.description, j.cat_name, j.cat_slug,
         j.min_price, j.max_price, j.compare_at_price, j.cover_path, j.available_quantity,
         count(*) over () as total_count
    from joined j
   where j.listed
   order by j.available_quantity = 0, j.name
   limit (select lim from params) offset (select off from params);
$$;

-- 5. Chuẩn hóa nhãn: bỏ trống, bỏ trùng (không phân biệt hoa thường), tối đa 20 nhãn ---------
create or replace function private.clean_tags(p_tags jsonb)
returns text[]
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce(array_agg(t order by first_pos), '{}')
    from (
      -- Trùng không phân biệt hoa thường: giữ cách viết xuất hiện đầu tiên.
      select (array_agg(btrim(x.value) order by x.ord))[1] as t, min(x.ord) as first_pos
        from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p_tags, '[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality as x(value, ord)
       where btrim(x.value) <> '' and char_length(btrim(x.value)) <= 30
       group by lower(btrim(x.value))
       order by min(x.ord)
       limit 20
    ) s;
$$;
grant execute on function private.clean_tags(jsonb) to authenticated, service_role;

-- 6. Tạo sản phẩm đầy đủ ------------------------------------------------------------
-- p = {
--   kind, name, category_id, brand_name, description, excerpt, base_price, compare_at_price,
--   unit_label, tags[], seo_title, seo_description, show_on_website, show_on_pos, is_active, is_bundle,
--   variants:     [{ sku, size_label, color_label, price_override, cost_price, barcode, is_default }],
--   stock:        [{ branch_id, variant_index, quantity }],      -- tạo dòng kho (bày bán) + tồn đầu kỳ
--   reorder_level: số cảnh báo sắp hết áp cho mọi dòng kho mới,
--   rental_rates: [{ label, duration_minutes, price }]
-- }
create or replace function public.create_product_full(p jsonb)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_kind public.product_kind := (p ->> 'kind')::public.product_kind;
  v_bundle boolean := coalesce((p ->> 'is_bundle')::boolean, false);
  v_ids uuid[] := '{}';
  v_vid uuid;
  v_item record;
  v_default_index integer;
  v_reorder integer := greatest(coalesce((p ->> 'reorder_level')::integer, 0), 0);
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p -> 'variants') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p -> 'variants') = 0 then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'VARIANT_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  if v_bundle and jsonb_array_length(p -> 'variants') <> 1 then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'BUNDLE_SINGLE_VARIANT';
  end if;

  insert into public.products (
    kind, name, category_id, brand_name, description, excerpt, base_price, compare_at_price,
    unit_label, tags, seo_title, seo_description, show_on_website, show_on_pos, is_active, is_bundle, created_by)
  values (
    v_kind,
    btrim(p ->> 'name'),
    nullif(p ->> 'category_id', '')::uuid,
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'brand_name', '')), ''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'description', '')), ''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'excerpt', '')), ''),
    case when v_kind = 'sale' then (p ->> 'base_price')::integer end,
    case when v_kind = 'sale' then nullif(p ->> 'compare_at_price', '')::integer end,
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'unit_label', '')), ''),
    private.clean_tags(p -> 'tags'),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'seo_title', '')), ''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'seo_description', '')), ''),
    coalesce((p ->> 'show_on_website')::boolean, true),
    coalesce((p ->> 'show_on_pos')::boolean, true),
    coalesce((p ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true),
    v_bundle,
    (select auth.uid()))
  returning id into v_id;

  select coalesce(min(x.ord) filter (where (x.value ->> 'is_default')::boolean), 1)::integer
    into v_default_index
    from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'variants') with ordinality as x(value, ord);

  for v_item in
    select x.value as v, x.ord::integer as ord
      from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'variants') with ordinality as x(value, ord)
     order by x.ord
  loop
    insert into public.product_variants (
      product_id, sku, size_label, color_label, price_override, cost_price, barcode, is_default, sort_order)
    values (
      v_id,
      upper(btrim(v_item.v ->> 'sku')),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'size_label', '')), ''),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'color_label', '')), ''),
      case when v_kind = 'sale' then nullif(v_item.v ->> 'price_override', '')::integer end,
      nullif(v_item.v ->> 'cost_price', '')::integer,
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'barcode', '')), ''),
      v_item.ord = v_default_index,
      v_item.ord)
    returning id into v_vid;
    v_ids := v_ids || v_vid;
  end loop;

  -- Bày bán tại chi nhánh + tồn đầu kỳ (combo không có tồn riêng).
  if not v_bundle and jsonb_typeof(p -> 'stock') = 'array' then
    for v_item in
      select (x.value ->> 'branch_id')::uuid as branch_id,
             coalesce((x.value ->> 'variant_index')::integer, 0) as idx,
             greatest(coalesce((x.value ->> 'quantity')::integer, 0), 0) as qty
        from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'stock') as x(value)
    loop
      if v_item.idx < 0 or v_item.idx >= cardinality(v_ids) then
        raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'INVALID_LINES';
      end if;
      insert into public.inventory_levels (branch_id, variant_id, reorder_level, is_listed)
      values (v_item.branch_id, v_ids[v_item.idx + 1], v_reorder, true)
      on conflict (branch_id, variant_id) do nothing;
      if v_item.qty > 0 then
        perform public.adjust_stock(v_item.branch_id, v_ids[v_item.idx + 1], v_item.qty, 'opening',
                                    'Tồn đầu kỳ khi tạo sản phẩm');
      end if;
    end loop;
  end if;

  if v_kind = 'rental' and jsonb_typeof(p -> 'rental_rates') = 'array' then
    insert into public.rental_rates (product_id, label, duration_minutes, price)
    select v_id, btrim(x.value ->> 'label'), (x.value ->> 'duration_minutes')::integer, (x.value ->> 'price')::integer
      from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'rental_rates') as x(value);
  end if;

  return v_id;
end;
$$;

-- 7. Sửa sản phẩm + biến thể ----------------------------------------------------------
-- p giống create_product_full (không có stock/rental_rates), thêm:
--   variants[].id (bỏ trống = biến thể mới), variants[].is_active,
--   archived_variant_ids: [uuid] — ngừng biến thể (xóa mềm, giữ lịch sử)
create or replace function public.update_product_full(p_id uuid, p jsonb)
returns void
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_prod public.products;
  v_item record;
  v_vid uuid;
  v_default uuid;
  v_archived uuid[] := coalesce(
    (select array_agg(x::uuid) from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p -> 'archived_variant_ids', '[]'::jsonb)) as x), '{}');
begin
  select * into v_prod from public.products where id = p_id for update;
  if not found then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  update public.products
     set name = btrim(p ->> 'name'),
         category_id = nullif(p ->> 'category_id', '')::uuid,
         brand_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'brand_name', '')), ''),
         description = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'description', '')), ''),
         excerpt = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'excerpt', '')), ''),
         base_price = case when v_prod.kind = 'sale' then (p ->> 'base_price')::integer end,
         compare_at_price = case when v_prod.kind = 'sale' then nullif(p ->> 'compare_at_price', '')::integer end,
         unit_label = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'unit_label', '')), ''),
         tags = private.clean_tags(p -> 'tags'),
         seo_title = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'seo_title', '')), ''),
         seo_description = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'seo_description', '')), ''),
         show_on_website = coalesce((p ->> 'show_on_website')::boolean, true),
         show_on_pos = coalesce((p ->> 'show_on_pos')::boolean, true),
         is_active = v_prod.deleted_at is null and coalesce((p ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true)
   where id = p_id;

  if v_prod.is_bundle or jsonb_typeof(p -> 'variants') is distinct from 'array' then
    return;
  end if;

  -- Bỏ cờ mặc định trước để có thể đổi biến thể mặc định trong cùng giao dịch.
  update public.product_variants set is_default = false where product_id = p_id and is_default;

  for v_item in
    select x.value as v, x.ord::integer as ord
      from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'variants') with ordinality as x(value, ord)
     order by x.ord
  loop
    v_vid := nullif(v_item.v ->> 'id', '')::uuid;
    if v_vid is null then
      insert into public.product_variants (
        product_id, sku, size_label, color_label, price_override, cost_price, barcode, sort_order, is_active)
      values (
        p_id,
        upper(btrim(v_item.v ->> 'sku')),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'size_label', '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'color_label', '')), ''),
        case when v_prod.kind = 'sale' then nullif(v_item.v ->> 'price_override', '')::integer end,
        nullif(v_item.v ->> 'cost_price', '')::integer,
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'barcode', '')), ''),
        v_item.ord,
        coalesce((v_item.v ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true))
      returning id into v_vid;
    else
      update public.product_variants
         set sku = upper(btrim(v_item.v ->> 'sku')),
             size_label = nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'size_label', '')), ''),
             color_label = nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'color_label', '')), ''),
             price_override = case when v_prod.kind = 'sale' then nullif(v_item.v ->> 'price_override', '')::integer end,
             cost_price = nullif(v_item.v ->> 'cost_price', '')::integer,
             barcode = nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'barcode', '')), ''),
             sort_order = v_item.ord,
             is_active = coalesce((v_item.v ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true)
       where id = v_vid and product_id = p_id and deleted_at is null;
      if not found then
        raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'VARIANT_NOT_FOUND';
      end if;
    end if;
    if v_default is null and coalesce((v_item.v ->> 'is_default')::boolean, false) then
      v_default := v_vid;
    end if;
  end loop;

  if cardinality(v_archived) > 0 then
    update public.product_variants
       set is_active = false, deleted_at = now()
     where product_id = p_id and id = any (v_archived) and deleted_at is null and id is distinct from v_default;
  end if;

  if v_default is null then
    select v.id into v_default from public.product_variants v
     where v.product_id = p_id and v.deleted_at is null
     order by v.sort_order, v.created_at limit 1;
  end if;
  if v_default is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'VARIANT_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  update public.product_variants set is_default = true where id = v_default;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.create_product_full(jsonb) from public, anon;
revoke all on function public.update_product_full(uuid, jsonb) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.create_product_full(jsonb) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.update_product_full(uuid, jsonb) to authenticated;

commit;

notify pgrst, 'reload schema';

-- =============================================================================
-- RALLY BADMINTON — 06_product_tax.sql   (BẮT BUỘC cho phần "Thuế" của sản phẩm)
-- Chạy SAU 05_product_details.sql. Chạy lại nhiều lần an toàn.
--
--   * brand_settings: phương pháp tính thuế (khấu trừ / trực tiếp), mức VAT mặc định, mã số thuế
--   * products: tên trên hóa đơn, có/không chịu thuế, nhóm ngành nghề (thuế trực tiếp),
--               mức VAT riêng hoặc theo mặc định (thuế khấu trừ)
--   * sale_lines: chụp lại thuế tại thời điểm bán (đổi cấu hình sau không làm sai đơn cũ)
--
-- Quy ước giá: giá bán ĐÃ GỒM thuế GTGT (phương pháp khấu trừ) — tiền thuế được tách ra từ giá.
-- Phương pháp trực tiếp (hộ kinh doanh): thuế = tỷ lệ % × doanh thu theo nhóm ngành nghề
-- (GTGT + TNCN, Thông tư 40/2021/TT-BTC). Số liệu là ước tính để đối chiếu, không thay hóa đơn điện tử.
-- =============================================================================

begin;

-- 1. Cài đặt thuế cấp thương hiệu --------------------------------------------------
alter table public.brand_settings
  add column if not exists tax_method text not null default 'deduction'
    constraint brand_settings_tax_method check (tax_method in ('deduction', 'direct')),
  add column if not exists default_vat_rate numeric(4, 2) not null default 8
    constraint brand_settings_default_vat check (default_vat_rate between 0 and 20),
  add column if not exists tax_code text
    constraint brand_settings_tax_code check (tax_code is null or tax_code ~ '^[0-9]{10}(-[0-9]{3})?$');

comment on column public.brand_settings.tax_method is 'deduction = khấu trừ (VAT đã gồm trong giá); direct = trực tiếp theo tỷ lệ % doanh thu.';
comment on column public.brand_settings.default_vat_rate is 'Mức VAT mặc định (%) cho sản phẩm chọn "áp dụng mức mặc định".';

-- 2. Thuế theo sản phẩm -------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.products
  add column if not exists invoice_name text
    constraint products_invoice_name_len check (invoice_name is null or char_length(btrim(invoice_name)) between 1 and 150),
  add column if not exists taxable boolean not null default false,
  add column if not exists tax_industry text
    constraint products_tax_industry check (tax_industry is null or tax_industry in ('goods', 'service', 'rental', 'production', 'other')),
  add column if not exists vat_use_default boolean not null default true,
  add column if not exists vat_rate numeric(4, 2)
    constraint products_vat_rate check (vat_rate is null or vat_rate between 0 and 20);

comment on column public.products.taxable is 'Sản phẩm có chịu thuế. false = không tính thuế (hàng không chịu thuế, quà tặng…).';
comment on column public.products.tax_industry is 'Nhóm ngành nghề cho phương pháp trực tiếp: goods, service, rental, production, other.';
comment on column public.products.vat_rate is 'Mức VAT riêng (%) khi vat_use_default = false.';

-- 3. Tỷ lệ thuế trực tiếp theo nhóm ngành nghề (Thông tư 40/2021/TT-BTC) --------------
create or replace function private.direct_tax_rates(p_industry text, out vat_rate numeric, out pit_rate numeric)
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select r.vat, r.pit
    from (values ('goods', 1.0, 0.5), ('service', 5.0, 2.0), ('rental', 5.0, 5.0),
                 ('production', 3.0, 1.5), ('other', 2.0, 1.0)) as r(code, vat, pit)
   where r.code = coalesce(p_industry, 'other');
$$;
grant execute on function private.direct_tax_rates(text) to authenticated, service_role;

-- 4. Ghi cấu hình thuế khi tạo/sửa sản phẩm (INVOKER: RLS catalog.edit vẫn áp dụng) ----
create or replace function private.apply_product_tax(p_id uuid, p jsonb)
returns void
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if not (p ? 'taxable') then
    return; -- client cũ chưa gửi phần thuế: giữ nguyên
  end if;
  update public.products
     set invoice_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'invoice_name', '')), ''),
         taxable = coalesce((p ->> 'taxable')::boolean, false),
         tax_industry = nullif(p ->> 'tax_industry', ''),
         vat_use_default = coalesce((p ->> 'vat_use_default')::boolean, true),
         vat_rate = case when coalesce((p ->> 'vat_use_default')::boolean, true) then null
                         else nullif(p ->> 'vat_rate', '')::numeric end
   where id = p_id;
end;
$$;
grant execute on function private.apply_product_tax(uuid, jsonb) to authenticated;

-- 5. Chụp thuế vào dòng bán ------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.sale_lines
  add column if not exists tax_method text
    constraint sale_lines_tax_method check (tax_method is null or tax_method in ('deduction', 'direct')),
  add column if not exists vat_rate numeric(4, 2),
  add column if not exists vat_amount bigint not null default 0,
  add column if not exists pit_rate numeric(4, 2),
  add column if not exists pit_amount bigint not null default 0;

comment on column public.sale_lines.vat_amount is 'Khấu trừ: VAT tách từ thành tiền (giá đã gồm VAT). Trực tiếp: GTGT = tỷ lệ × thành tiền.';

create or replace function private.sale_line_tax()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_method text;
  v_default numeric;
  v_prod record;
  v_total bigint := new.quantity::bigint * new.unit_price;
  v_rates record;
begin
  select b.tax_method, b.default_vat_rate into v_method, v_default from public.brand_settings b where b.id;
  v_method := coalesce(v_method, 'deduction');
  select p.taxable, p.tax_industry, p.vat_use_default, p.vat_rate, p.kind
    into v_prod
    from public.product_variants v join public.products p on p.id = v.product_id
   where v.id = new.variant_id;

  new.tax_method := v_method;
  new.vat_rate := null; new.vat_amount := 0; new.pit_rate := null; new.pit_amount := 0;
  if not found or not coalesce(v_prod.taxable, false) then
    return new;
  end if;

  if v_method = 'deduction' then
    new.vat_rate := case when v_prod.vat_use_default then coalesce(v_default, 8) else coalesce(v_prod.vat_rate, v_default, 8) end;
    new.vat_amount := round(v_total * new.vat_rate / (100 + new.vat_rate));
  else
    select * into v_rates from private.direct_tax_rates(v_prod.tax_industry);
    new.vat_rate := v_rates.vat_rate;
    new.pit_rate := v_rates.pit_rate;
    new.vat_amount := round(v_total * v_rates.vat_rate / 100);
    new.pit_amount := round(v_total * v_rates.pit_rate / 100);
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists sale_lines_tax on public.sale_lines;
create trigger sale_lines_tax before insert on public.sale_lines
  for each row execute function private.sale_line_tax();

-- 6. Hàm tạo/sửa sản phẩm: thêm phần thuế (giữ nguyên phần còn lại của 05) -------------
create or replace function public.create_product_full(p jsonb)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_kind public.product_kind := (p ->> 'kind')::public.product_kind;
  v_bundle boolean := coalesce((p ->> 'is_bundle')::boolean, false);
  v_ids uuid[] := '{}';
  v_vid uuid;
  v_item record;
  v_default_index integer;
  v_reorder integer := greatest(coalesce((p ->> 'reorder_level')::integer, 0), 0);
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p -> 'variants') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p -> 'variants') = 0 then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'VARIANT_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  if v_bundle and jsonb_array_length(p -> 'variants') <> 1 then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'BUNDLE_SINGLE_VARIANT';
  end if;

  insert into public.products (
    kind, name, category_id, brand_name, description, excerpt, base_price, compare_at_price,
    unit_label, tags, seo_title, seo_description, show_on_website, show_on_pos, is_active, is_bundle, created_by)
  values (
    v_kind,
    btrim(p ->> 'name'),
    nullif(p ->> 'category_id', '')::uuid,
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'brand_name', '')), ''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'description', '')), ''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'excerpt', '')), ''),
    case when v_kind = 'sale' then (p ->> 'base_price')::integer end,
    case when v_kind = 'sale' then nullif(p ->> 'compare_at_price', '')::integer end,
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'unit_label', '')), ''),
    private.clean_tags(p -> 'tags'),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'seo_title', '')), ''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'seo_description', '')), ''),
    coalesce((p ->> 'show_on_website')::boolean, true),
    coalesce((p ->> 'show_on_pos')::boolean, true),
    coalesce((p ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true),
    v_bundle,
    (select auth.uid()))
  returning id into v_id;

  perform private.apply_product_tax(v_id, p);

  select coalesce(min(x.ord) filter (where (x.value ->> 'is_default')::boolean), 1)::integer
    into v_default_index
    from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'variants') with ordinality as x(value, ord);

  for v_item in
    select x.value as v, x.ord::integer as ord
      from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'variants') with ordinality as x(value, ord)
     order by x.ord
  loop
    insert into public.product_variants (
      product_id, sku, size_label, color_label, price_override, cost_price, barcode, is_default, sort_order)
    values (
      v_id,
      upper(btrim(v_item.v ->> 'sku')),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'size_label', '')), ''),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'color_label', '')), ''),
      case when v_kind = 'sale' then nullif(v_item.v ->> 'price_override', '')::integer end,
      nullif(v_item.v ->> 'cost_price', '')::integer,
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'barcode', '')), ''),
      v_item.ord = v_default_index,
      v_item.ord)
    returning id into v_vid;
    v_ids := v_ids || v_vid;
  end loop;

  -- Bày bán tại chi nhánh + tồn đầu kỳ (combo không có tồn riêng).
  if not v_bundle and jsonb_typeof(p -> 'stock') = 'array' then
    for v_item in
      select (x.value ->> 'branch_id')::uuid as branch_id,
             coalesce((x.value ->> 'variant_index')::integer, 0) as idx,
             greatest(coalesce((x.value ->> 'quantity')::integer, 0), 0) as qty
        from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'stock') as x(value)
    loop
      if v_item.idx < 0 or v_item.idx >= cardinality(v_ids) then
        raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'INVALID_LINES';
      end if;
      insert into public.inventory_levels (branch_id, variant_id, reorder_level, is_listed)
      values (v_item.branch_id, v_ids[v_item.idx + 1], v_reorder, true)
      on conflict (branch_id, variant_id) do nothing;
      if v_item.qty > 0 then
        perform public.adjust_stock(v_item.branch_id, v_ids[v_item.idx + 1], v_item.qty, 'opening',
                                    'Tồn đầu kỳ khi tạo sản phẩm');
      end if;
    end loop;
  end if;

  if v_kind = 'rental' and jsonb_typeof(p -> 'rental_rates') = 'array' then
    insert into public.rental_rates (product_id, label, duration_minutes, price)
    select v_id, btrim(x.value ->> 'label'), (x.value ->> 'duration_minutes')::integer, (x.value ->> 'price')::integer
      from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'rental_rates') as x(value);
  end if;

  return v_id;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.update_product_full(p_id uuid, p jsonb)
returns void
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_prod public.products;
  v_item record;
  v_vid uuid;
  v_default uuid;
  v_archived uuid[] := coalesce(
    (select array_agg(x::uuid) from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p -> 'archived_variant_ids', '[]'::jsonb)) as x), '{}');
begin
  select * into v_prod from public.products where id = p_id for update;
  if not found then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  update public.products
     set name = btrim(p ->> 'name'),
         category_id = nullif(p ->> 'category_id', '')::uuid,
         brand_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'brand_name', '')), ''),
         description = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'description', '')), ''),
         excerpt = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'excerpt', '')), ''),
         base_price = case when v_prod.kind = 'sale' then (p ->> 'base_price')::integer end,
         compare_at_price = case when v_prod.kind = 'sale' then nullif(p ->> 'compare_at_price', '')::integer end,
         unit_label = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'unit_label', '')), ''),
         tags = private.clean_tags(p -> 'tags'),
         seo_title = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'seo_title', '')), ''),
         seo_description = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'seo_description', '')), ''),
         show_on_website = coalesce((p ->> 'show_on_website')::boolean, true),
         show_on_pos = coalesce((p ->> 'show_on_pos')::boolean, true),
         is_active = v_prod.deleted_at is null and coalesce((p ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true)
   where id = p_id;

  perform private.apply_product_tax(p_id, p);

  if v_prod.is_bundle or jsonb_typeof(p -> 'variants') is distinct from 'array' then
    return;
  end if;

  -- Bỏ cờ mặc định trước để có thể đổi biến thể mặc định trong cùng giao dịch.
  update public.product_variants set is_default = false where product_id = p_id and is_default;

  for v_item in
    select x.value as v, x.ord::integer as ord
      from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'variants') with ordinality as x(value, ord)
     order by x.ord
  loop
    v_vid := nullif(v_item.v ->> 'id', '')::uuid;
    if v_vid is null then
      insert into public.product_variants (
        product_id, sku, size_label, color_label, price_override, cost_price, barcode, sort_order, is_active)
      values (
        p_id,
        upper(btrim(v_item.v ->> 'sku')),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'size_label', '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'color_label', '')), ''),
        case when v_prod.kind = 'sale' then nullif(v_item.v ->> 'price_override', '')::integer end,
        nullif(v_item.v ->> 'cost_price', '')::integer,
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'barcode', '')), ''),
        v_item.ord,
        coalesce((v_item.v ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true))
      returning id into v_vid;
    else
      update public.product_variants
         set sku = upper(btrim(v_item.v ->> 'sku')),
             size_label = nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'size_label', '')), ''),
             color_label = nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'color_label', '')), ''),
             price_override = case when v_prod.kind = 'sale' then nullif(v_item.v ->> 'price_override', '')::integer end,
             cost_price = nullif(v_item.v ->> 'cost_price', '')::integer,
             barcode = nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.v ->> 'barcode', '')), ''),
             sort_order = v_item.ord,
             is_active = coalesce((v_item.v ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true)
       where id = v_vid and product_id = p_id and deleted_at is null;
      if not found then
        raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'VARIANT_NOT_FOUND';
      end if;
    end if;
    if v_default is null and coalesce((v_item.v ->> 'is_default')::boolean, false) then
      v_default := v_vid;
    end if;
  end loop;

  if cardinality(v_archived) > 0 then
    update public.product_variants
       set is_active = false, deleted_at = now()
     where product_id = p_id and id = any (v_archived) and deleted_at is null and id is distinct from v_default;
  end if;

  if v_default is null then
    select v.id into v_default from public.product_variants v
     where v.product_id = p_id and v.deleted_at is null
     order by v.sort_order, v.created_at limit 1;
  end if;
  if v_default is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'VARIANT_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  update public.product_variants set is_default = true where id = v_default;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.create_product_full(jsonb) from public, anon;
revoke all on function public.update_product_full(uuid, jsonb) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.create_product_full(jsonb) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.update_product_full(uuid, jsonb) to authenticated;

commit;

notify pgrst, 'reload schema';

File: supabase/sql/07_units_options.sql

-- =============================================================================
-- RALLY BADMINTON — 07_units_options.sql   (BẮT BUỘC cho "Đơn vị tính" và "Biến thể" mới)
-- Chạy SAU 06_product_tax.sql. Chạy lại nhiều lần an toàn.
--
--   * products.option1_name / option2_name: tên thuộc tính biến thể (Kích thước, Màu sắc, Dung tích…).
--     Giá trị vẫn lưu ở product_variants.size_label (thuộc tính 1) và color_label (thuộc tính 2).
--   * product_units: đơn vị quy đổi (lốc = 6 lon, thùng = 24 lon…). Tồn kho luôn đếm theo đơn vị cơ bản
--     (products.unit_label); bán 1 thùng trừ kho 24.
--   * record_sale / void_sale: nhận unit_id từng dòng, trừ/hoàn kho theo hệ số quy đổi.
-- =============================================================================

begin;

-- 1. Tên thuộc tính biến thể ------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.products
  add column if not exists option1_name text
    constraint products_option1_len check (option1_name is null or char_length(btrim(option1_name)) between 1 and 30),
  add column if not exists option2_name text
    constraint products_option2_len check (option2_name is null or char_length(btrim(option2_name)) between 1 and 30);

-- Dữ liệu cũ: biến thể có size/màu thì đặt tên thuộc tính mặc định.
update public.products p
   set option1_name = coalesce(p.option1_name, 'Kích thước')
 where p.option1_name is null
   and exists (select 1 from public.product_variants v where v.product_id = p.id and v.size_label is not null);
update public.products p
   set option2_name = coalesce(p.option2_name, 'Màu sắc')
 where p.option2_name is null
   and exists (select 1 from public.product_variants v where v.product_id = p.id and v.color_label is not null);

-- 2. Đơn vị quy đổi ---------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.product_units (
  id          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  product_id  uuid not null references public.products (id),
  name        text not null constraint product_units_name_len check (char_length(btrim(name)) between 1 and 20),
  conversion  integer not null constraint product_units_conversion check (conversion between 2 and 10000),
  price       integer constraint product_units_price check (price is null or price between 0 and 100000000),
  barcode     text constraint product_units_barcode_fmt check (barcode is null or barcode ~ '^[0-9A-Za-z._-]{4,32}$'),
  sort_order  integer not null default 0,
  created_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  deleted_at  timestamptz
);
comment on table public.product_units is 'Đơn vị bán quy đổi của sản phẩm (lốc, thùng…). conversion = số đơn vị cơ bản.';
create index if not exists product_units_product_idx on public.product_units (product_id) where deleted_at is null;
create unique index if not exists product_units_name_uidx
  on public.product_units (product_id, lower(btrim(name))) where deleted_at is null;
create unique index if not exists product_units_barcode_uidx
  on public.product_units (barcode) where barcode is not null and deleted_at is null;

alter table public.product_units enable row level security;

drop trigger if exists touch_product_units on public.product_units;
create trigger touch_product_units before update on public.product_units
  for each row execute function private.touch_updated_at();
drop trigger if exists no_delete_product_units on public.product_units;
create trigger no_delete_product_units before delete on public.product_units
  for each row execute function private.forbid_hard_delete();

drop policy if exists product_units_read on public.product_units;
create policy product_units_read on public.product_units
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.products p where p.id = product_units.product_id));
drop policy if exists product_units_editor_insert on public.product_units;
create policy product_units_editor_insert on public.product_units
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (cardinality((select private.permitted_branch_ids('catalog.edit'))) > 0);
drop policy if exists product_units_editor_update on public.product_units;
create policy product_units_editor_update on public.product_units
  for update to authenticated
  using (cardinality((select private.permitted_branch_ids('catalog.edit'))) > 0)
  with check (cardinality((select private.permitted_branch_ids('catalog.edit'))) > 0);

grant select on public.product_units to anon, authenticated;
grant insert, update on public.product_units to authenticated;

-- 3. Dòng bán ghi đơn vị đã bán -----------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.sale_lines
  add column if not exists unit_id uuid references public.product_units (id),
  add column if not exists unit_name text,
  add column if not exists unit_conversion integer not null default 1
    constraint sale_lines_unit_conversion check (unit_conversion between 1 and 10000);

-- 4. Ghi phần mở rộng khi tạo/sửa sản phẩm --------------------------------------------------
--    create_product_full / update_product_full (06) đã gọi private.apply_product_tax ngay sau khi ghi
--    sản phẩm; hàm này nay ghi cả thuế, tên thuộc tính biến thể và đơn vị quy đổi. INVOKER: RLS vẫn áp dụng.
create or replace function private.apply_product_tax(p_id uuid, p jsonb)
returns void
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_item record;
  v_uid uuid;
  v_archived uuid[] := coalesce(
    (select array_agg(x::uuid) from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(p -> 'archived_unit_ids', '[]'::jsonb)) as x), '{}');
begin
  if p ? 'taxable' then
    update public.products
       set invoice_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'invoice_name', '')), ''),
           taxable = coalesce((p ->> 'taxable')::boolean, false),
           tax_industry = nullif(p ->> 'tax_industry', ''),
           vat_use_default = coalesce((p ->> 'vat_use_default')::boolean, true),
           vat_rate = case when coalesce((p ->> 'vat_use_default')::boolean, true) then null
                           else nullif(p ->> 'vat_rate', '')::numeric end
     where id = p_id;
  end if;

  if p ? 'option1_name' then
    update public.products
       set option1_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'option1_name', '')), ''),
           option2_name = nullif(btrim(coalesce(p ->> 'option2_name', '')), '')
     where id = p_id;
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p -> 'units') = 'array' then
    if cardinality(v_archived) > 0 then
      update public.product_units set deleted_at = now()
       where product_id = p_id and id = any (v_archived) and deleted_at is null;
    end if;
    for v_item in
      select x.value as u, x.ord::integer as ord
        from jsonb_array_elements(p -> 'units') with ordinality as x(value, ord)
       order by x.ord
    loop
      v_uid := nullif(v_item.u ->> 'id', '')::uuid;
      if v_uid is null then
        insert into public.product_units (product_id, name, conversion, price, barcode, sort_order)
        values (p_id, btrim(v_item.u ->> 'name'), (v_item.u ->> 'conversion')::integer,
                nullif(v_item.u ->> 'price', '')::integer, nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.u ->> 'barcode', '')), ''), v_item.ord);
      else
        update public.product_units
           set name = btrim(v_item.u ->> 'name'),
               conversion = (v_item.u ->> 'conversion')::integer,
               price = nullif(v_item.u ->> 'price', '')::integer,
               barcode = nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_item.u ->> 'barcode', '')), ''),
               sort_order = v_item.ord
         where id = v_uid and product_id = p_id and deleted_at is null;
        if not found then
          raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'UNIT_NOT_FOUND';
        end if;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end if;
end;
$$;
grant execute on function private.apply_product_tax(uuid, jsonb) to authenticated;

-- 5. Bán hàng & hủy đơn theo đơn vị quy đổi -------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.record_sale(
  p_branch_id uuid,
  p_lines jsonb,
  p_payment_method public.payment_method,
  p_payment_reference text default null,
  p_discount_amount bigint default 0,
  p_customer_phone text default null,
  p_customer_name text default null,
  p_note text default null,
  p_idempotency_key text default null)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_existing public.sales;
  v_sale uuid;
  v_customer uuid;
  v_subtotal bigint := 0;
  v_line record;
  v_line_id uuid;
  v_total bigint;
begin
  perform private.require_permission(p_branch_id, 'sale.record');
  if coalesce(p_discount_amount, 0) <> 0 and not private.is_owner() then
    perform private.raise_error('DISCOUNT_OWNER_ONLY');
  end if;
  if p_idempotency_key is null or char_length(p_idempotency_key) < 8 then
    perform private.raise_error('IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED');
  end if;
  select * into v_existing from public.sales where idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;
  if found then
    if v_existing.branch_id <> p_branch_id then
      perform private.raise_error('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('sale_id', v_existing.id, 'code', v_existing.code,
                              'total_amount', v_existing.total_amount, 'replayed', true);
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_lines) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_lines) not between 1 and 30 then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_LINES');
  end if;

  if p_customer_phone is not null and btrim(p_customer_phone) <> '' then
    v_customer := private.upsert_customer(p_customer_phone, coalesce(p_customer_name, 'Khách lẻ'));
  end if;

  insert into public.sales (branch_id, customer_id, subtotal_amount, discount_amount, note, idempotency_key, sold_by)
  values (p_branch_id, v_customer, 0, 0, nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_note, '')), ''), p_idempotency_key, (select auth.uid()))
  returning id into v_sale;

  -- Gộp dòng trùng biến thể, xử lý theo thứ tự variant_id để khóa nhất quán (tránh deadlock).
  for v_line in
    select l.variant_id, l.unit_id, sum(l.quantity)::integer as quantity
      from jsonb_to_recordset(p_lines) as l(variant_id uuid, unit_id uuid, quantity integer)
     group by l.variant_id, l.unit_id
     order by l.variant_id, l.unit_id nulls first
  loop
    declare
      v_name text;
      v_label text;
      v_price integer;
      v_base_unit text;
      v_unit_name text;
      v_conv integer := 1;
    begin
      if v_line.variant_id is null or v_line.quantity is null or v_line.quantity not between 1 and 1000 then
        perform private.raise_error('INVALID_LINES');
      end if;
      select p.name,
             nullif(concat_ws(' / ', v.size_label, v.color_label), ''),
             coalesce(v.price_override, p.base_price),
             p.unit_label
        into v_name, v_label, v_price, v_base_unit
        from public.product_variants v
        join public.products p on p.id = v.product_id
       where v.id = v_line.variant_id
         and v.is_active and v.deleted_at is null
         and p.kind = 'sale' and p.is_active and p.deleted_at is null;
      if not found or v_price is null then
        perform private.raise_error('PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE', v_line.variant_id::text);
      end if;
      v_unit_name := v_base_unit;
      -- Bán theo đơn vị quy đổi (lốc, thùng…): giá riêng của đơn vị hoặc giá cơ bản × hệ số; kho trừ theo đơn vị cơ bản.
      if v_line.unit_id is not null then
        select u.name, u.conversion, coalesce(u.price, v_price * u.conversion)
          into v_unit_name, v_conv, v_price
          from public.product_units u
          join public.product_variants v2 on v2.product_id = u.product_id
         where u.id = v_line.unit_id and v2.id = v_line.variant_id and u.deleted_at is null;
        if not found then
          perform private.raise_error('PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE', v_line.unit_id::text);
        end if;
      end if;
      insert into public.sale_lines (sale_id, variant_id, product_name, variant_label, quantity, unit_price,
                                     unit_id, unit_name, unit_conversion)
      values (v_sale, v_line.variant_id, v_name, v_label, v_line.quantity, v_price,
              v_line.unit_id, v_unit_name, v_conv)
      returning id into v_line_id;
      insert into public.stock_movements (branch_id, variant_id, quantity_delta, reason, sale_line_id)
      values (p_branch_id, v_line.variant_id, -(v_line.quantity * v_conv), 'sale', v_line_id);
      v_subtotal := v_subtotal + v_line.quantity::bigint * v_price;
    end;
  end loop;

  if coalesce(p_discount_amount, 0) < 0 or coalesce(p_discount_amount, 0) > v_subtotal then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_DISCOUNT');
  end if;
  update public.sales
     set subtotal_amount = v_subtotal, discount_amount = coalesce(p_discount_amount, 0)
   where id = v_sale
  returning total_amount into v_total;

  if v_total > 0 then
    perform private.insert_payment(null, v_sale, null, 'charge', p_payment_method, v_total,
                                   p_payment_reference, null, 'sale:' || p_idempotency_key);
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('sale_id', v_sale,
                            'code', (select code from public.sales where id = v_sale),
                            'total_amount', v_total);
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.void_sale(p_sale_id uuid, p_reason text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v public.sales;
  v_line record;
begin
  perform private.require_owner();
  if char_length(btrim(coalesce(p_reason, ''))) < 3 then
    perform private.raise_error('REASON_REQUIRED');
  end if;
  select * into v from public.sales where id = p_sale_id for update;
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('SALE_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if v.status = 'voided' then
    return jsonb_build_object('sale_id', v.id, 'status', v.status);
  end if;
  perform private.set_audit_reason('void sale: ' || p_reason);
  for v_line in select * from public.sale_lines where sale_id = v.id order by variant_id loop
    insert into public.stock_movements (branch_id, variant_id, quantity_delta, reason, sale_line_id, note)
    values (v.branch_id, v_line.variant_id, v_line.quantity * coalesce(v_line.unit_conversion, 1), 'sale_void', v_line.id,
            left(p_reason, 300));
  end loop;
  update public.payments
     set status = 'voided', voided_at = now(), voided_by = (select auth.uid()), void_reason = btrim(p_reason)
   where sale_id = v.id and status in ('pending', 'succeeded');
  update public.sales
     set status = 'voided', voided_at = now(), voided_by = (select auth.uid()), void_reason = btrim(p_reason)
   where id = v.id;
  return jsonb_build_object('sale_id', v.id, 'status', 'voided');
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.record_sale(uuid, jsonb, public.payment_method, text, bigint, text, text, text, text) from public, anon;
revoke all on function public.void_sale(uuid, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.record_sale(uuid, jsonb, public.payment_method, text, bigint, text, text, text, text) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.void_sale(uuid, text) to authenticated;

commit;

notify pgrst, 'reload schema';
