-- =============================================================================
-- RALLY BADMINTON — 15_sepay_deposit.sql
-- Đặt cọc bằng chuyển khoản qua SePay + tổng quan dòng tiền cho trang quản trị.
--
-- Chạy SAU 00 → 14. Chạy lại an toàn.
--
--   * Tài khoản nhận tiền: brand_settings.bank_* (mặc định) và branches.bank_* (chi nhánh dùng tài khoản riêng).
--     Khách thấy mã VietQR (số tiền + nội dung = mã đơn không gạch, ví dụ RB7K3M9Q2T) ngay sau khi giữ sân.
--   * Webhook SePay (máy chủ Next.js xác thực API key / chữ ký) gọi record_sepay_transaction:
--       - ghi mọi giao dịch vào bank_transactions (chống trùng theo id SePay),
--       - tìm đơn theo mã trong nội dung, ghi payments (method = gateway, provider = sepay),
--       - đủ tiền cọc → đơn tự chuyển "đã xác nhận"; giữ chỗ vừa hết hạn mà sân còn trống → mở lại,
--       - không khớp / đơn đã hủy / sân đã có người → để "cần xử lý" cho nhân viên.
--   * match_bank_transaction / dismiss_bank_transaction: nhân viên gán tay giao dịch ghi sai nội dung.
--   * admin_dashboard: một lần gọi trả mọi số liệu cho trang Tổng quan (theo quyền người xem).
-- =============================================================================

begin;

-- 1. Tài khoản nhận chuyển khoản ------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.brand_settings
  add column if not exists bank_code text,
  add column if not exists bank_account_no text,
  add column if not exists bank_account_name text,
  add column if not exists transfer_auto_confirm boolean not null default true;

alter table public.branches
  add column if not exists bank_code text,
  add column if not exists bank_account_no text,
  add column if not exists bank_account_name text;

-- Chữ bắt buộc đứng trước nội dung chuyển khoản (ví dụ VietinBank cá nhân qua SePay cần "SEVQR").
alter table public.brand_settings add column if not exists transfer_memo_prefix text;
alter table public.branches add column if not exists transfer_memo_prefix text;

do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conname = 'brand_settings_bank_fmt') then
    alter table public.brand_settings add constraint brand_settings_bank_fmt check (
      (bank_code is null or bank_code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,20}$')
      and (bank_account_no is null or bank_account_no ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{4,30}$')
      and (bank_account_name is null or char_length(btrim(bank_account_name)) between 2 and 80)
      and ((bank_code is null) = (bank_account_no is null)));
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conname = 'brand_settings_memo_prefix_fmt') then
    alter table public.brand_settings add constraint brand_settings_memo_prefix_fmt
      check (transfer_memo_prefix is null or transfer_memo_prefix ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,20}$');
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conname = 'branches_memo_prefix_fmt') then
    alter table public.branches add constraint branches_memo_prefix_fmt
      check (transfer_memo_prefix is null or transfer_memo_prefix ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,20}$');
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conname = 'branches_bank_fmt') then
    alter table public.branches add constraint branches_bank_fmt check (
      (bank_code is null or bank_code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,20}$')
      and (bank_account_no is null or bank_account_no ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{4,30}$')
      and (bank_account_name is null or char_length(btrim(bank_account_name)) between 2 and 80)
      and ((bank_code is null) = (bank_account_no is null)));
  end if;
end;
$$;

comment on column public.brand_settings.bank_code is 'Ngân hàng nhận cọc (tên viết tắt / BIN theo VietQR, ví dụ MBBank, Vietcombank, 970422).';
comment on column public.brand_settings.transfer_auto_confirm is 'Nhận đủ tiền cọc qua SePay thì tự xác nhận đơn.';
comment on column public.brand_settings.transfer_memo_prefix is 'Chữ bắt buộc trước mã đơn trong nội dung CK (VietinBank cá nhân: SEVQR). Trống = chỉ mã đơn.';
comment on column public.branches.bank_code is 'Tài khoản riêng của chi nhánh (trống = dùng tài khoản thương hiệu).';

-- 2. Giao dịch ngân hàng từ SePay -----------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.bank_transactions (
  id                 uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  provider           text not null default 'sepay' constraint bank_txn_provider check (provider in ('sepay')),
  provider_txn_id    text not null constraint bank_txn_provider_id_len check (char_length(provider_txn_id) between 1 and 64),
  gateway            text,
  account_number     text,
  transfer_type      text not null constraint bank_txn_type check (transfer_type in ('in', 'out')),
  amount             bigint not null constraint bank_txn_amount check (amount >= 0),
  content            text,
  payment_code       text,
  reference_code     text,
  transaction_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  status             text not null constraint bank_txn_status check (status in ('matched', 'unmatched', 'review', 'ignored')),
  status_note        text constraint bank_txn_note_len check (status_note is null or char_length(status_note) <= 300),
  branch_id          uuid references public.branches (id),
  booking_id         uuid references public.bookings (id),
  payment_id         uuid references public.payments (id),
  raw                jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  resolved_by        uuid references auth.users (id) on delete set null,
  resolved_at        timestamptz,
  created_at         timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint bank_txn_provider_uniq unique (provider, provider_txn_id),
  constraint bank_txn_matched_fields check (status <> 'matched' or (booking_id is not null and payment_id is not null))
);
comment on table public.bank_transactions is
  'Giao dịch ngân hàng nhận từ SePay (webhook). Khớp mã đơn → ghi payments; không khớp → chờ nhân viên xử lý.';
create index if not exists bank_txn_status_idx on public.bank_transactions (status, transaction_at desc);
create index if not exists bank_txn_branch_idx on public.bank_transactions (branch_id, transaction_at desc);
create index if not exists bank_txn_booking_idx on public.bank_transactions (booking_id) where booking_id is not null;

alter table public.bank_transactions enable row level security;
revoke all on public.bank_transactions from anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.bank_transactions to authenticated;

drop policy if exists bank_transactions_read on public.bank_transactions;
create policy bank_transactions_read on public.bank_transactions
  for select to authenticated
  using (
    (select private.is_owner())
    or (branch_id is not null and branch_id = any ((select private.permitted_branch_ids('payment.record'))::uuid[]))
    -- Chưa khớp chi nhánh nào: nhân viên có quyền thu tiền ở bất kỳ chi nhánh nào cũng xem được để gán tay.
    or (branch_id is null and cardinality((select private.permitted_branch_ids('payment.record'))::uuid[]) > 0)
  );

-- 3. Cho phép SePay "mở lại" giữ chỗ vừa hết hạn (chỉ khi đang ghi tiền, sân còn trống) ----------
create or replace function private.booking_transition_allowed(p_from public.booking_status, p_to public.booking_status)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select (p_from, p_to) in (
    ('held'::public.booking_status,       'confirmed'::public.booking_status),
    ('held'::public.booking_status,       'cancelled'::public.booking_status),
    ('held'::public.booking_status,       'expired'::public.booking_status),
    ('confirmed'::public.booking_status,  'checked_in'::public.booking_status),
    ('confirmed'::public.booking_status,  'completed'::public.booking_status),
    ('confirmed'::public.booking_status,  'cancelled'::public.booking_status),
    ('confirmed'::public.booking_status,  'no_show'::public.booking_status),
    ('checked_in'::public.booking_status, 'completed'::public.booking_status)
  )
  or (p_from = 'expired'::public.booking_status and p_to = 'confirmed'::public.booking_status
      and coalesce(current_setting('rally.deposit_revive', true), '') = 'on');
$$;

-- 4. Mã đơn trong nội dung chuyển khoản ------------------------------------------------------
-- Ngân hàng thường bỏ dấu gạch: "RB7K3M9Q2T", "rb-7k3m9q2t coc san" → RB-7K3M9Q2T.
create or replace function private.extract_booking_code(p_code text, p_content text)
returns text
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select 'RB-' || m[1]
    from (select regexp_match(upper(coalesce(nullif(p_code, ''), '') || ' ' || coalesce(p_content, '')),
                              'RB[^A-Z0-9]{0,2}([2-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{8})(?![A-Z0-9])') as m) x
   where m is not null;
$$;

-- Tài khoản nhận tiền áp dụng cho chi nhánh (riêng chi nhánh, nếu không thì của thương hiệu).
create or replace function private.branch_bank_account(p_branch_id uuid)
returns table (bank_code text, account_no text, account_name text)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce(b.bank_code, s.bank_code),
         coalesce(b.bank_account_no, s.bank_account_no),
         case when b.bank_code is not null then coalesce(b.bank_account_name, s.bank_account_name) else s.bank_account_name end
    from public.brand_settings s
    left join public.branches b on b.id = p_branch_id
   limit 1;
$$;

-- 5. Áp một giao dịch vào đơn: ghi tiền + tự xác nhận / mở lại / đánh dấu cần xử lý -------------
create or replace function private.apply_bank_transaction(p_txn_id uuid, p_booking_id uuid, p_actor uuid)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  t public.bank_transactions;
  v public.bookings;
  v_payment uuid;
  v_paid bigint;
  v_status text := 'matched';
  v_note text;
  v_auto boolean;
  v_constraint text;
begin
  select * into t from public.bank_transactions where id = p_txn_id for update;
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('BANK_TXN_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if t.payment_id is not null then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', t.status, 'booking_id', t.booking_id, 'payment_id', t.payment_id, 'replayed', true);
  end if;
  if t.transfer_type <> 'in' or t.amount <= 0 then
    perform private.raise_error('BANK_TXN_NOT_INCOMING');
  end if;

  select * into v from public.bookings where id = p_booking_id and deleted_at is null and kind = 'customer' for update;
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('BOOKING_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;

  perform private.set_audit_reason('system: sepay ' || t.provider_txn_id);
  insert into public.payments (booking_id, kind, method, status, amount, reference, note, provider, provider_txn_id,
                               provider_payload, idempotency_key, received_at, recorded_by)
  values (v.id, 'charge', 'gateway', 'succeeded', t.amount,
          nullif(left(btrim(coalesce(t.reference_code, '')), 100), ''),
          left('Chuyển khoản SePay: ' || coalesce(t.content, ''), 300),
          t.provider, t.provider_txn_id, t.raw, 'sepay:' || t.provider_txn_id, t.transaction_at, p_actor)
  returning id into v_payment;

  v_paid := private.booking_net_paid(v.id);
  select coalesce(transfer_auto_confirm, true) into v_auto from public.brand_settings limit 1;

  if v.status = 'held' then
    -- Còn "held" nghĩa là chưa ai lấy giờ này (giữ chỗ hết hạn chỉ nhường sân khi có người đặt chồng).
    if v_auto and v_paid >= greatest(v.deposit_amount, 1) then
      update public.bookings set status = 'confirmed' where id = v.id;
      v_note := 'Đủ cọc — đã tự xác nhận đơn.';
    elsif v.hold_expires_at <= now() then
      v_status := 'review';
      v_note := format('Giữ chỗ đã hết hạn, mới nhận %s đ / cọc %s đ — cần liên hệ khách.', v_paid, v.deposit_amount);
    else
      v_note := format('Đã nhận %s đ, cọc yêu cầu %s đ.', v_paid, v.deposit_amount);
    end if;
  elsif v.status = 'expired' then
    -- Giữ chỗ bị hủy vì hết giờ trong lúc khách đang chuyển: mở lại nếu sân vẫn trống.
    if v_auto and v_paid >= greatest(v.deposit_amount, 1) then
      begin
        perform set_config('rally.deposit_revive', 'on', true);
        update public.bookings set status = 'confirmed' where id = v.id;
        perform set_config('rally.deposit_revive', '', true);
        v_note := 'Giữ chỗ đã hết hạn nhưng sân còn trống — đã mở lại và xác nhận.';
      exception
        when exclusion_violation then
          perform set_config('rally.deposit_revive', '', true);
          v_status := 'review';
          v_note := 'Giữ chỗ đã hết hạn và giờ này đã có người khác đặt — cần liên hệ khách để đổi giờ hoặc hoàn tiền.';
      end;
    else
      v_status := 'review';
      v_note := format('Giữ chỗ đã hết hạn, mới nhận %s đ / cọc %s đ — cần liên hệ khách.', v_paid, v.deposit_amount);
    end if;
  elsif v.status in ('cancelled', 'no_show') then
    v_status := 'review';
    v_note := 'Đơn đã hủy / không đến nhưng khách vẫn chuyển tiền — cần hoàn tiền.';
  else
    v_note := 'Đã ghi vào tiền thanh toán của đơn.';
  end if;

  if v_paid > v.total_amount then
    v_status := 'review';
    v_note := coalesce(v_note || ' ', '') || format('Khách chuyển dư %s đ.', v_paid - v.total_amount);
  end if;
  perform private.set_audit_reason(null);

  -- Các lần chuyển trước của cùng đơn (thiếu cọc) đã được bù đủ → không còn cần xử lý.
  if v_status = 'matched' and (select b.status from public.bookings b where b.id = v.id) in ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'completed') then
    update public.bank_transactions
       set status = 'matched', status_note = 'Đã đủ cọc nhờ giao dịch chuyển sau.'
     where booking_id = v.id and status = 'review' and payment_id is not null and id <> t.id;
  end if;

  update public.bank_transactions
     set status = v_status, status_note = left(v_note, 300), branch_id = v.branch_id, booking_id = v.id,
         payment_id = v_payment,
         resolved_by = case when p_actor is not null then p_actor else resolved_by end,
         resolved_at = case when p_actor is not null then now() else resolved_at end
   where id = t.id;

  return jsonb_build_object('status', v_status, 'note', v_note, 'booking_id', v.id, 'booking_code', v.code,
                            'payment_id', v_payment,
                            'booking_status', (select b.status from public.bookings b where b.id = v.id));
exception
  when unique_violation then
    get stacked diagnostics v_constraint = constraint_name;
    if v_constraint in ('payments_provider_txn_uidx', 'payments_idempotency_key') then
      perform private.raise_error('BANK_TXN_ALREADY_RECORDED');
    end if;
    raise;
end;
$$;

-- 6. Webhook SePay (chỉ máy chủ gọi) -----------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.record_sepay_transaction(p_payload jsonb)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_txn_id text := nullif(btrim(p_payload ->> 'id'), '');
  v_type text := lower(coalesce(p_payload ->> 'transferType', ''));
  v_amount bigint;
  v_at timestamptz;
  v_code text;
  v_booking uuid;
  v_existing public.bank_transactions;
  v_id uuid;
begin
  perform private.require_service_role();
  if v_txn_id is null or v_type not in ('in', 'out') then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD');
  end if;
  begin
    v_amount := round((p_payload ->> 'transferAmount')::numeric)::bigint;
  exception when others then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD', 'transferAmount');
  end;
  begin
    -- SePay gửi giờ Việt Nam dạng "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss".
    v_at := ((p_payload ->> 'transactionDate')::timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
  exception when others then
    v_at := now();
  end;
  v_at := coalesce(v_at, now());

  -- Gửi lại (SePay thử lại / bấm gửi lại) → trả kết quả cũ, không ghi tiền hai lần.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('rally.sepay'), hashtext(v_txn_id));
  select * into v_existing from public.bank_transactions where provider = 'sepay' and provider_txn_id = v_txn_id;
  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', v_existing.status, 'booking_id', v_existing.booking_id, 'replayed', true);
  end if;

  v_code := private.extract_booking_code(p_payload ->> 'code', p_payload ->> 'content');
  insert into public.bank_transactions (provider, provider_txn_id, gateway, account_number, transfer_type, amount, content,
                                        payment_code, reference_code, transaction_at, status, raw)
  values ('sepay', v_txn_id, left(p_payload ->> 'gateway', 60), left(p_payload ->> 'accountNumber', 40), v_type,
          greatest(coalesce(v_amount, 0), 0), left(p_payload ->> 'content', 500), v_code,
          left(nullif(p_payload ->> 'referenceCode', ''), 100), v_at,
          case when v_type = 'out' then 'ignored' else 'unmatched' end, p_payload)
  returning id into v_id;

  if v_type = 'out' or coalesce(v_amount, 0) <= 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'ignored');
  end if;
  if v_code is null then
    update public.bank_transactions set status_note = 'Nội dung không có mã đơn RB…' where id = v_id;
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unmatched');
  end if;
  select b.id into v_booking from public.bookings b where b.code = v_code and b.deleted_at is null and b.kind = 'customer';
  if v_booking is null then
    update public.bank_transactions set status_note = format('Không có đơn %s', v_code) where id = v_id;
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unmatched', 'booking_code', v_code);
  end if;
  return private.apply_bank_transaction(v_id, v_booking, null);
end;
$$;

-- 7. Nhân viên gán tay / bỏ qua giao dịch --------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.match_bank_transaction(p_txn_id uuid, p_booking_code text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  t public.bank_transactions;
  v public.bookings;
  v_code text := private.extract_booking_code(p_booking_code, null);
begin
  select * into t from public.bank_transactions where id = p_txn_id;
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('BANK_TXN_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if t.payment_id is not null or t.status not in ('unmatched', 'review') then
    perform private.raise_error('BANK_TXN_ALREADY_RECORDED');
  end if;
  select * into v from public.bookings where code = v_code and deleted_at is null and kind = 'customer';
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('BOOKING_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  perform private.require_permission(v.branch_id, 'payment.record');
  return private.apply_bank_transaction(t.id, v.id, (select auth.uid()));
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.dismiss_bank_transaction(p_txn_id uuid, p_note text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  t public.bank_transactions;
begin
  select * into t from public.bank_transactions where id = p_txn_id for update;
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('BANK_TXN_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if t.branch_id is null then
    perform private.require_owner();
  else
    perform private.require_permission(t.branch_id, 'payment.record');
  end if;
  if char_length(btrim(coalesce(p_note, ''))) < 3 then
    perform private.raise_error('REASON_REQUIRED');
  end if;
  if t.status not in ('unmatched', 'review') then
    perform private.raise_error('BANK_TXN_ALREADY_RECORDED');
  end if;
  update public.bank_transactions
     set status = 'ignored', status_note = left(btrim(p_note), 300), resolved_by = (select auth.uid()), resolved_at = now()
   where id = t.id;
  return jsonb_build_object('status', 'ignored');
end;
$$;

-- 8. Tổng quan quản trị: một lần gọi, theo quyền người xem -----------------------------------------
create or replace function public.admin_dashboard(p_branch_id uuid default null, p_days integer default 30)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  c_tz constant text := 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
  v_owner boolean := private.is_owner();
  v_days integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_days, 30), 7), 92);
  v_today date := (now() at time zone c_tz)::date;
  v_day_start timestamptz := (v_today::timestamp) at time zone c_tz;
  v_day_end timestamptz := ((v_today + 1)::timestamp) at time zone c_tz;
  v_from timestamptz := ((v_today - v_days + 1)::timestamp) at time zone c_tz;
  v_prev_from timestamptz := ((v_today - 2 * v_days + 1)::timestamp) at time zone c_tz;
  v_scope uuid[];
  v_view uuid[];
  v_pay uuid[];
  v_sale uuid[];
  v_rent uuid[];
  v_stock uuid[];
  v_shift uuid[];
  v_result jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null then
    perform private.raise_error('AUTH_REQUIRED');
  end if;
  -- Phạm vi: một chi nhánh (phải có quyền ở đó) hoặc tất cả (chỉ chủ sân).
  if p_branch_id is null then
    if not v_owner then
      perform private.raise_error('OWNER_REQUIRED');
    end if;
    select coalesce(array_agg(id), '{}') into v_scope from public.branches where deleted_at is null;
  else
    if not (p_branch_id = any (private.permitted_branch_ids(null))) then
      perform private.raise_error('PERMISSION_DENIED');
    end if;
    v_scope := array[p_branch_id];
  end if;

  select coalesce(array_agg(x), '{}') into v_view from unnest(v_scope) x where x = any (private.permitted_branch_ids('booking.view'));
  select coalesce(array_agg(x), '{}') into v_pay from unnest(v_scope) x where x = any (private.permitted_branch_ids('payment.record'));
  select coalesce(array_agg(x), '{}') into v_sale from unnest(v_scope) x where x = any (private.permitted_branch_ids('sale.record'));
  select coalesce(array_agg(x), '{}') into v_rent from unnest(v_scope) x where x = any (private.permitted_branch_ids('rental.operate'));
  select coalesce(array_agg(x), '{}') into v_stock from unnest(v_scope) x where x = any (private.permitted_branch_ids('catalog.view'));
  select coalesce(array_agg(x), '{}') into v_shift from unnest(v_scope) x where x = any (private.permitted_branch_ids('shift.view_branch'));
  if v_owner then
    v_pay := v_scope;
    v_shift := v_scope;
  end if;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('today', v_today, 'days', v_days, 'is_owner', v_owner,
                                 'scope', case when p_branch_id is null then 'all' else 'branch' end);

  -- 8.1 Đặt sân hôm nay + lấp sân
  if cardinality(v_view) > 0 then
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('bookings', (
      with today as (
        select b.* from public.bookings b
         where b.branch_id = any (v_view) and b.deleted_at is null and b.kind = 'customer'
           and b.during && tstzrange(v_day_start, v_day_end, '[)')
      ), capacity as (
        select coalesce(sum(extract(epoch from (br.closes_at - br.opens_at)) / 60 *
                 (select count(*) from public.courts c where c.branch_id = br.id and c.status = 'active' and c.deleted_at is null)), 0) as minutes
          from public.branches br where br.id = any (v_view)
      ), used as (
        select coalesce(sum(extract(epoch from (least(upper(t.during), v_day_end) - greatest(lower(t.during), v_day_start))) / 60), 0) as minutes
          from today t where t.status in ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'completed', 'held')
      )
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'total', (select count(*) from today where status not in ('cancelled', 'expired')),
        'held', (select count(*) from today where status = 'held'),
        'confirmed', (select count(*) from today where status = 'confirmed'),
        'checked_in', (select count(*) from today where status = 'checked_in'),
        'completed', (select count(*) from today where status = 'completed'),
        'cancelled', (select count(*) from today where status in ('cancelled', 'no_show')),
        'occupancy', case when (select minutes from capacity) > 0
                          then round(100.0 * (select minutes from used) / (select minutes from capacity)) else 0 end,
        'new_online', (select count(*) from public.bookings b where b.branch_id = any (v_view) and b.source = 'online'
                         and b.created_at >= v_day_start and b.deleted_at is null),
        'upcoming', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', u.id, 'code', u.code, 'status', u.status, 'contact_name', u.contact_name,
                                              'starts_at', lower(u.during), 'ends_at', upper(u.during),
                                              'court_name', c.name, 'branch_name', br.name)
                           order by lower(u.during))
            from (select * from today where status in ('confirmed', 'checked_in') and upper(during) > now()
                   order by lower(during) limit 8) u
            join public.courts c on c.id = u.court_id
            join public.branches br on br.id = u.branch_id), '[]'::jsonb),
        'awaiting_deposit', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', h.id, 'code', h.code, 'contact_name', h.contact_name,
                                              'starts_at', lower(h.during), 'hold_expires_at', h.hold_expires_at,
                                              'deposit_amount', h.deposit_amount,
                                              'paid_amount', private.booking_net_paid(h.id),
                                              'court_name', c.name, 'branch_name', br.name)
                           order by h.hold_expires_at)
            from (select * from public.bookings b where b.branch_id = any (v_view) and b.status = 'held'
                     and b.hold_expires_at > now() and b.deleted_at is null order by b.hold_expires_at limit 10) h
            join public.courts c on c.id = h.court_id
            join public.branches br on br.id = h.branch_id), '[]'::jsonb)
      )));
  end if;

  -- 8.2 Dòng tiền
  if cardinality(v_pay) > 0 then
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('cash', (
      with p as (
        select pm.*, case when pm.kind = 'charge' then pm.amount else -pm.amount end as signed,
               case when pm.booking_id is not null then 'booking' when pm.sale_id is not null then 'sale' else 'rental' end as source,
               (pm.received_at at time zone c_tz)::date as day
          from public.payments pm
         where pm.branch_id = any (v_pay) and pm.status = 'succeeded' and pm.received_at >= v_prev_from
      ), cur as (select * from p where received_at >= v_from)
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'today_in', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from cur where kind = 'charge' and received_at >= v_day_start),
        'today_refund', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from cur where kind = 'refund' and received_at >= v_day_start),
        'today_net', (select coalesce(sum(signed), 0) from cur where received_at >= v_day_start),
        'period_net', (select coalesce(sum(signed), 0) from cur),
        'period_refund', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from cur where kind = 'refund'),
        'prev_net', (select coalesce(sum(signed), 0) from p where received_at < v_from),
        'by_source', jsonb_build_object(
          'booking', (select coalesce(sum(signed), 0) from cur where source = 'booking'),
          'sale', (select coalesce(sum(signed), 0) from cur where source = 'sale'),
          'rental', (select coalesce(sum(signed), 0) from cur where source = 'rental')),
        'by_method', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(method, total) from (
            select method::text, sum(signed) as total from cur group by method) m), '{}'::jsonb),
        'series', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('day', d.day::date,
                   'booking', coalesce(s.booking, 0), 'sale', coalesce(s.sale, 0), 'rental', coalesce(s.rental, 0),
                   'refund', coalesce(s.refund, 0)) order by d.day)
            from generate_series((v_today - v_days + 1)::timestamp, v_today::timestamp, interval '1 day') as d(day)
            left join (
              select day,
                     sum(amount) filter (where kind = 'charge' and source = 'booking') as booking,
                     sum(amount) filter (where kind = 'charge' and source = 'sale') as sale,
                     sum(amount) filter (where kind = 'charge' and source = 'rental') as rental,
                     sum(amount) filter (where kind = 'refund') as refund
                from cur group by day) s on s.day = d.day::date), '[]'::jsonb),
        'recent', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(r order by r.received_at desc) from (
            select pm.id, pm.kind, pm.method, pm.amount, pm.received_at, pm.provider,
                   coalesce(bk.code, sl.code, rt.code) as ref_code,
                   case when pm.booking_id is not null then 'booking' when pm.sale_id is not null then 'sale' else 'rental' end as source,
                   pm.booking_id, pm.sale_id, pm.rental_id
              from public.payments pm
              left join public.bookings bk on bk.id = pm.booking_id
              left join public.sales sl on sl.id = pm.sale_id
              left join public.rentals rt on rt.id = pm.rental_id
             where pm.branch_id = any (v_pay) and pm.status = 'succeeded'
             order by pm.received_at desc limit 10) r), '[]'::jsonb),
        -- Tiền còn phải thu của đơn sắp chơi (7 ngày tới).
        'receivable', (
          select coalesce(sum(greatest(b.total_amount - private.booking_net_paid(b.id), 0)), 0)
            from public.bookings b
           where b.branch_id = any (v_pay) and b.status in ('confirmed', 'checked_in') and b.deleted_at is null
             and lower(b.during) < now() + interval '7 days' and upper(during) > now() - interval '1 day')
      )));
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('bank', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'today_count', count(*) filter (where t.transfer_type = 'in' and t.transaction_at >= v_day_start),
        'today_amount', coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (where t.transfer_type = 'in' and t.transaction_at >= v_day_start), 0),
        'auto_matched_period', count(*) filter (where t.status = 'matched' and t.resolved_by is null and t.transaction_at >= v_from),
        'pending', count(*) filter (where t.status in ('unmatched', 'review')),
        'pending_list', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', t.id, 'amount', t.amount, 'content', t.content,
                                   'status', t.status, 'status_note', t.status_note, 'transaction_at', t.transaction_at))
                          filter (where t.status in ('unmatched', 'review')), '[]'::jsonb))
        from public.bank_transactions t
       where (t.branch_id = any (v_pay) or (t.branch_id is null and (v_owner or cardinality(v_pay) > 0)))
         and (t.transaction_at >= v_from or t.status in ('unmatched', 'review'))));
  end if;

  -- 8.3 Bán hàng
  if cardinality(v_sale) > 0 or (v_owner and cardinality(v_scope) > 0) then
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('sales', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'today_count', count(*) filter (where s.sold_at >= v_day_start),
        'today_total', coalesce(sum(s.total_amount) filter (where s.sold_at >= v_day_start), 0),
        'period_count', count(*),
        'period_total', coalesce(sum(s.total_amount), 0),
        'top', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(x order by x.qty desc) from (
            select pr.name, sum(l.quantity) as qty, sum(l.line_total) as total
              from public.sale_lines l
              join public.sales s2 on s2.id = l.sale_id
              join public.product_variants pv on pv.id = l.variant_id
              join public.products pr on pr.id = pv.product_id
             where s2.branch_id = any (case when v_owner then v_scope else v_sale end)
               and s2.status = 'completed' and s2.sold_at >= v_from
             group by pr.name order by sum(l.quantity) desc limit 5) x), '[]'::jsonb))
        from public.sales s
       where s.branch_id = any (case when v_owner then v_scope else v_sale end)
         and s.status = 'completed' and s.sold_at >= v_from));
  end if;

  -- 8.4 Cho thuê
  if cardinality(v_rent) > 0 then
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('rentals', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'out', count(*) filter (where r.status = 'out'),
        'overdue', count(*) filter (where r.status = 'out' and r.due_at < now()),
        'today_new', count(*) filter (where r.created_at >= v_day_start),
        'overdue_list', coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', r.id, 'code', r.code, 'due_at', r.due_at,
                                   'customer', cu.full_name) order by r.due_at)
                          filter (where r.status = 'out' and r.due_at < now()), '[]'::jsonb))
        from public.rentals r
        left join public.customers cu on cu.id = r.customer_id
       where r.branch_id = any (v_rent) and (r.status = 'out' or r.created_at >= v_day_start)));
  end if;

  -- 8.5 Tồn kho
  if cardinality(v_stock) > 0 then
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('stock', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'low', count(*),
        'out', count(*) filter (where il.on_hand <= 0),
        'list', coalesce((jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variant_id', il.variant_id, 'name', pr.name,
                     'size', pv.size_label, 'color', pv.color_label, 'on_hand', il.on_hand, 'reorder', il.reorder_level,
                     'branch_name', br.name) order by il.on_hand)), '[]'::jsonb))
        from public.inventory_levels il
        join public.product_variants pv on pv.id = il.variant_id and pv.deleted_at is null and pv.is_active
        join public.products pr on pr.id = pv.product_id and pr.kind = 'sale' and pr.deleted_at is null
        join public.branches br on br.id = il.branch_id
       where il.branch_id = any (v_stock) and il.is_listed and il.on_hand <= il.reorder_level));
  end if;

  -- 8.6 Nhân sự đang trong ca
  if cardinality(v_shift) > 0 then
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('staff', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'on_shift', count(*) filter (where sh.checked_in_at is not null and sh.checked_out_at is null),
        'scheduled_today', count(*),
        'late', count(*) filter (where sh.checked_in_at is null and sh.status = 'scheduled' and sh.scheduled_start < now()))
        from public.shifts sh
       where sh.branch_id = any (v_shift) and sh.deleted_at is null
         and sh.scheduled_start < v_day_end and sh.scheduled_end > v_day_start and sh.status <> 'cancelled'));
  end if;

  -- 8.7 Thành viên (toàn thương hiệu)
  if private.can_view_members() then
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('members', (
      select jsonb_build_object('total', count(*), 'new_period', count(*) filter (where m.created_at >= v_from))
        from public.member_profiles m));
  end if;

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

-- 9. Quyền gọi hàm ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
revoke all on function private.apply_bank_transaction(uuid, uuid, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on function public.record_sepay_transaction(jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.record_sepay_transaction(jsonb) to service_role;
revoke all on function public.match_bank_transaction(uuid, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.match_bank_transaction(uuid, text) to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.dismiss_bank_transaction(uuid, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.dismiss_bank_transaction(uuid, text) to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.admin_dashboard(uuid, integer) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.admin_dashboard(uuid, integer) to authenticated;

commit;

notify pgrst, 'reload schema';

-- =============================================================================
-- RALLY BADMINTON — 16_alerts_reconcile.sql
-- Báo email cho chủ sân khi có giao dịch cần xử lý + đối soát dự phòng với SePay.
--
-- Chạy SAU 00 → 15. Chạy lại an toàn.
--
--   * notification_settings: email nhận cảnh báo (trống = email các tài khoản chủ sân), bật/tắt từng loại.
--   * bank_transactions.alerted_at: đã gửi email cho giao dịch này chưa (không gửi trùng).
--   * reconcile_runs: nhật ký mỗi lần website tự hỏi SePay danh sách giao dịch gần đây.
--   * record_sepay_transaction: chống trùng thêm theo mã tham chiếu ngân hàng (giao dịch từ đối soát).
--   * Các hàm service_* chỉ máy chủ gọi được (service role).
-- Lịch chạy tự động mỗi 15 phút: xem 17_reconcile_cron_optional.sql.
-- =============================================================================

begin;

-- 1. Cài đặt thông báo (chỉ chủ sân đọc / sửa) ---------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.notification_settings (
  id                  boolean primary key default true constraint notification_settings_singleton check (id),
  alert_emails        text[] not null default '{}'
                        constraint notification_alert_emails_max check (cardinality(alert_emails) <= 5),
  alert_on_review     boolean not null default true,
  alert_on_unmatched  boolean not null default true,
  updated_at          timestamptz not null default now()
);
comment on table public.notification_settings is 'Email nhận cảnh báo giao dịch cần xử lý (trống = email tài khoản chủ sân).';
insert into public.notification_settings (id) values (true) on conflict (id) do nothing;

alter table public.notification_settings enable row level security;
revoke all on public.notification_settings from anon, authenticated;
grant select, update on public.notification_settings to authenticated;
drop policy if exists notification_settings_owner_read on public.notification_settings;
create policy notification_settings_owner_read on public.notification_settings
  for select to authenticated using ((select private.is_owner()));
drop policy if exists notification_settings_owner_update on public.notification_settings;
create policy notification_settings_owner_update on public.notification_settings
  for update to authenticated using ((select private.is_owner())) with check ((select private.is_owner()));

-- 2. Đánh dấu đã gửi cảnh báo ---------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.bank_transactions add column if not exists alerted_at timestamptz;
create index if not exists bank_txn_alert_idx on public.bank_transactions (created_at)
  where alerted_at is null and status in ('unmatched', 'review');
create index if not exists bank_txn_reference_idx on public.bank_transactions (reference_code) where reference_code is not null;

-- 3. Nhật ký đối soát -------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.reconcile_runs (
  id          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  source      text not null constraint reconcile_source check (source in ('cron', 'manual', 'vercel')),
  started_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  finished_at timestamptz,
  fetched     integer not null default 0,
  new_count   integer not null default 0,
  error       text constraint reconcile_error_len check (error is null or char_length(error) <= 500)
);
create index if not exists reconcile_runs_time_idx on public.reconcile_runs (started_at desc);
alter table public.reconcile_runs enable row level security;
revoke all on public.reconcile_runs from anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.reconcile_runs to authenticated;
drop policy if exists reconcile_runs_owner_read on public.reconcile_runs;
create policy reconcile_runs_owner_read on public.reconcile_runs
  for select to authenticated using ((select private.is_owner()));

-- 4. Webhook / đối soát: chống trùng theo mã tham chiếu ---------------------------------------
create or replace function public.record_sepay_transaction(p_payload jsonb)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_txn_id text := nullif(btrim(p_payload ->> 'id'), '');
  v_type text := lower(coalesce(p_payload ->> 'transferType', ''));
  v_amount bigint;
  v_at timestamptz;
  v_code text;
  v_booking uuid;
  v_existing public.bank_transactions;
  v_id uuid;
begin
  perform private.require_service_role();
  if v_txn_id is null or v_type not in ('in', 'out') then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD');
  end if;
  begin
    v_amount := round((p_payload ->> 'transferAmount')::numeric)::bigint;
  exception when others then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD', 'transferAmount');
  end;
  begin
    -- SePay gửi giờ Việt Nam dạng "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss".
    v_at := ((p_payload ->> 'transactionDate')::timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
  exception when others then
    v_at := now();
  end;
  v_at := coalesce(v_at, now());

  -- Gửi lại (SePay thử lại / bấm gửi lại) → trả kết quả cũ, không ghi tiền hai lần.
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('rally.sepay'), hashtext(v_txn_id));
  select * into v_existing from public.bank_transactions where provider = 'sepay' and provider_txn_id = v_txn_id;
  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', v_existing.status, 'booking_id', v_existing.booking_id, 'replayed', true);
  end if;
  -- Đối soát qua API có thể trả cùng giao dịch với mã khác webhook: chống trùng thêm theo mã tham chiếu ngân hàng.
  if nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payload ->> 'referenceCode', '')), '') is not null then
    select * into v_existing from public.bank_transactions t
     where t.provider = 'sepay'
       and t.reference_code = left(btrim(p_payload ->> 'referenceCode'), 100)
       and t.amount = greatest(coalesce(v_amount, 0), 0)
       and t.transfer_type = v_type
       and t.account_number is not distinct from left(p_payload ->> 'accountNumber', 40)
     limit 1;
    if found then
      return jsonb_build_object('status', v_existing.status, 'booking_id', v_existing.booking_id, 'replayed', true);
    end if;
  end if;

  v_code := private.extract_booking_code(p_payload ->> 'code', p_payload ->> 'content');
  insert into public.bank_transactions (provider, provider_txn_id, gateway, account_number, transfer_type, amount, content,
                                        payment_code, reference_code, transaction_at, status, raw)
  values ('sepay', v_txn_id, left(p_payload ->> 'gateway', 60), left(p_payload ->> 'accountNumber', 40), v_type,
          greatest(coalesce(v_amount, 0), 0), left(p_payload ->> 'content', 500), v_code,
          left(nullif(p_payload ->> 'referenceCode', ''), 100), v_at,
          case when v_type = 'out' then 'ignored' else 'unmatched' end, p_payload)
  returning id into v_id;

  if v_type = 'out' or coalesce(v_amount, 0) <= 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'ignored');
  end if;
  if v_code is null then
    update public.bank_transactions set status_note = 'Nội dung không có mã đơn RB…' where id = v_id;
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unmatched');
  end if;
  select b.id into v_booking from public.bookings b where b.code = v_code and b.deleted_at is null and b.kind = 'customer';
  if v_booking is null then
    update public.bank_transactions set status_note = format('Không có đơn %s', v_code) where id = v_id;
    return jsonb_build_object('status', 'unmatched', 'booking_code', v_code);
  end if;
  return private.apply_bank_transaction(v_id, v_booking, null);
end;
$$;

-- 5. Hàm cho máy chủ -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Người nhận cảnh báo: danh sách trong cài đặt, nếu trống thì email các tài khoản chủ sân.
create or replace function public.service_alert_recipients()
returns text[]
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_emails text[];
begin
  perform private.require_service_role();
  select alert_emails into v_emails from public.notification_settings where id;
  if coalesce(cardinality(v_emails), 0) > 0 then
    return v_emails;
  end if;
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct u.email), '{}') into v_emails
    from public.staff_accounts sa join auth.users u on u.id = sa.user_id
   where sa.role = 'owner' and sa.is_active and u.email is not null
     and u.email not like '%@thanhvien.rally.invalid';
  return v_emails;
end;
$$;

-- Giao dịch cần báo (chưa báo, trong 3 ngày) kèm thông tin đơn để viết email.
create or replace function public.service_pending_alerts(p_limit integer default 20)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  s public.notification_settings;
begin
  perform private.require_service_role();
  select * into s from public.notification_settings where id;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'recipients', to_jsonb(public.service_alert_recipients()),
    'items', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
               'id', t.id, 'amount', t.amount, 'content', t.content, 'status', t.status,
               'status_note', t.status_note, 'transaction_at', t.transaction_at, 'gateway', t.gateway,
               'booking_code', b.code, 'contact_name', b.contact_name, 'contact_phone', cu.phone,
               'starts_at', lower(b.during), 'court_name', c.name, 'branch_name', br.name)
             order by t.transaction_at)
        from (select * from public.bank_transactions x
               where x.alerted_at is null and x.transfer_type = 'in'
                 and x.created_at > now() - interval '3 days'
                 and ((x.status = 'review' and coalesce(s.alert_on_review, true))
                   or (x.status = 'unmatched' and coalesce(s.alert_on_unmatched, true)))
               order by x.transaction_at
               limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 50)) t
        left join public.bookings b on b.id = t.booking_id
        left join public.customers cu on cu.id = b.customer_id
        left join public.courts c on c.id = b.court_id
        left join public.branches br on br.id = b.branch_id), '[]'::jsonb));
end;
$$;

-- Số tài khoản cần đối soát (tài khoản thương hiệu + tài khoản riêng của chi nhánh).
create or replace function public.service_bank_accounts()
returns text[]
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct acc), '{}')
    from (select bank_account_no as acc from public.brand_settings where bank_account_no is not null
          union
          select bank_account_no from public.branches where bank_account_no is not null and deleted_at is null) a;
$$;

create or replace function public.service_reconcile_start(p_source text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_last timestamptz;
begin
  perform private.require_service_role();
  -- Mốc bắt đầu lấy giao dịch: lần đối soát thành công gần nhất (lùi 2 giờ cho chắc), tối đa 3 ngày.
  select max(started_at) into v_last from public.reconcile_runs where finished_at is not null and error is null;
  insert into public.reconcile_runs (source) values (p_source) returning id into v_id;
  delete from public.reconcile_runs where started_at < now() - interval '30 days';
  return jsonb_build_object('run_id', v_id,
    'since', greatest(coalesce(v_last, now() - interval '3 days') - interval '2 hours', now() - interval '3 days'));
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.service_reconcile_finish(p_run_id uuid, p_fetched integer, p_new integer, p_error text default null)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  perform private.require_service_role();
  update public.reconcile_runs
     set finished_at = now(), fetched = greatest(coalesce(p_fetched, 0), 0), new_count = greatest(coalesce(p_new, 0), 0),
         error = left(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_error, '')), ''), 500)
   where id = p_run_id;
end;
$$;

-- =============================================================================
-- RALLY BADMINTON — 17_reconcile_cron_optional.sql (TÙY CHỌN)
-- Lịch đối soát SePay mỗi 15 phút bằng Supabase Cron (pg_cron + pg_net).
-- Vercel gói Hobby chỉ cho chạy cron 1 lần/ngày, nên dùng Supabase để chạy dày hơn.
--
-- Trước khi chạy file này:
--   1. Đặt CRON_SECRET (chuỗi ngẫu nhiên, KHÔNG có ký tự $) trên Vercel và redeploy.
--   2. Chạy 2 lệnh dưới (thay giá trị thật) trong SQL Editor — khóa nằm trong Supabase Vault, không nằm trong file:
--        select vault.create_secret('https://rally-eight-tau.vercel.app', 'rally_site_url');
--        select vault.create_secret('<CRON_SECRET>', 'rally_cron_secret');
--      Đổi giá trị sau này: select vault.update_secret(id, '<giá trị mới>') from vault.secrets where name = 'rally_cron_secret';
--   3. Chạy file này. Chạy lại an toàn (lịch cũ được thay).
-- Tắt lịch: select cron.unschedule('rally-sepay-reconcile');
-- =============================================================================

create extension if not exists pg_cron;
create extension if not exists pg_net;

do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'rally_site_url')
     or not exists (select 1 from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'rally_cron_secret') then
    raise notice 'Chưa có secret rally_site_url / rally_cron_secret trong Vault — xem bước 2 ở đầu file. Chưa tạo lịch.';
    return;
  end if;

  if exists (select 1 from cron.job where jobname = 'rally-sepay-reconcile') then
    perform cron.unschedule('rally-sepay-reconcile');
  end if;

  perform cron.schedule(
    'rally-sepay-reconcile',
    '*/15 * * * *',
    $job$
    select net.http_post(
      url := rtrim((select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'rally_site_url'), '/')
             || '/api/cron/sepay-reconcile',
      headers := jsonb_build_object(
        'Content-Type', 'application/json',
        'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || (select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'rally_cron_secret')),
      body := '{}'::jsonb,
      timeout_milliseconds := 60000
    );
    $job$
  );
  raise notice 'Đã bật lịch đối soát SePay mỗi 15 phút (rally-sepay-reconcile).';
end;
$$;

-- Xem kết quả các lần chạy gần nhất:
--   select status, return_message, start_time from cron.job_run_details
--    where jobid = (select jobid from cron.job where jobname = 'rally-sepay-reconcile') order by start_time desc limit 10;
--   select status_code, content, created from net._http_response order by created desc limit 10;

File: supabase/sql/18_overtime.sql
================
-- =============================================================================
-- RALLY BADMINTON — 18_overtime.sql
-- Tăng ca có sự đồng ý của nhân viên + tính lương tăng ca riêng.
--
-- Chạy SAU 00 → 17 (17 là tùy chọn). Chạy lại an toàn.
--
-- Quy trình:
--   1. Chủ sân đề nghị tăng ca cho một ca: thêm bao nhiêu phút ngay sau giờ ra ca, giá tăng ca (đ/giờ), lý do.
--      Nếu nhân viên đã đồng ý trực tiếp tại sân, chủ sân ghi luôn "đã đồng ý".
--   2. Nhân viên mở "Ca & lương của tôi" → Đồng ý / Từ chối (trước khi hết khung giờ tăng ca).
--   3. Lương: phút làm SAU giờ ra ca theo lịch, tối đa bằng số phút tăng ca đã đồng ý, tính theo giá tăng ca;
--      phần còn lại tính giá thường như trước. Đề nghị bị từ chối / chưa trả lời / đã hủy → không tính giá tăng ca.
--   Ví dụ: ca 07:00–11:00 giá 25.000 đ/giờ, tăng ca 2 giờ giá 30.000 đ/giờ, quét ra lúc 13:00
--          → 4 giờ × 25.000 + 2 giờ × 30.000 = 160.000 đ.
-- =============================================================================

begin;

-- 1. Bảng đề nghị tăng ca ------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.shift_overtime (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  shift_id       uuid not null references public.shifts (id),
  employee_id    uuid not null references public.employees (id),
  branch_id      uuid not null references public.branches (id),
  minutes        smallint not null constraint shift_overtime_minutes check (minutes between 15 and 480 and minutes % 15 = 0),
  hourly_rate    integer not null constraint shift_overtime_rate check (hourly_rate between 1000 and 20000000),
  reason         text not null constraint shift_overtime_reason_len check (char_length(btrim(reason)) between 3 and 300),
  status         text not null default 'pending'
                   constraint shift_overtime_status check (status in ('pending', 'accepted', 'declined', 'cancelled')),
  consent        text constraint shift_overtime_consent check (consent is null or consent in ('app', 'in_person')),
  requested_by   uuid references auth.users (id) on delete set null,
  requested_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  responded_by   uuid references auth.users (id) on delete set null,
  responded_at   timestamptz,
  response_note  text constraint shift_overtime_note_len check (response_note is null or char_length(response_note) <= 300),
  updated_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint shift_overtime_accepted check (status <> 'accepted' or (consent is not null and responded_at is not null))
);
comment on table public.shift_overtime is 'Đề nghị tăng ca ngay sau một ca: số phút, giá tăng ca, nhân viên đồng ý / từ chối. Không xóa, chỉ đổi trạng thái.';
-- Mỗi ca chỉ có một đề nghị đang hiệu lực (chờ trả lời hoặc đã đồng ý).
create unique index if not exists shift_overtime_active_uidx on public.shift_overtime (shift_id)
  where status in ('pending', 'accepted');
create index if not exists shift_overtime_employee_idx on public.shift_overtime (employee_id, status);
create index if not exists shift_overtime_branch_idx on public.shift_overtime (branch_id, requested_at desc);

alter table public.shift_overtime enable row level security;
revoke all on public.shift_overtime from anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.shift_overtime to authenticated;
-- Giá tăng ca là thông tin lương: chỉ chủ sân và chính nhân viên đó đọc được. Ghi chỉ qua RPC.
drop policy if exists shift_overtime_read on public.shift_overtime;
create policy shift_overtime_read on public.shift_overtime
  for select to authenticated
  using ((select private.is_owner()) or employee_id = (select private.current_employee_id()));

drop trigger if exists touch_shift_overtime on public.shift_overtime;
create trigger touch_shift_overtime before update on public.shift_overtime
  for each row execute function private.touch_updated_at();
drop trigger if exists audit_shift_overtime on public.shift_overtime;
create trigger audit_shift_overtime after insert or update on public.shift_overtime
  for each row execute function private.audit_row_change('id', 'branch_id');
drop trigger if exists no_delete_shift_overtime on public.shift_overtime;
create trigger no_delete_shift_overtime before delete on public.shift_overtime
  for each row execute function private.forbid_hard_delete();

-- 2. Phút tăng ca thực làm của một ca --------------------------------------------------------
-- Phút sau giờ ra ca theo lịch (tính từ lúc vào nếu vào sau giờ ra ca), tối đa số phút đã đồng ý và tổng công.
create or replace function private.overtime_worked_minutes(
  p_checked_in timestamptz, p_checked_out timestamptz, p_scheduled_end timestamptz, p_approved integer, p_paid integer)
returns integer
language sql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select case
    when p_checked_in is null or p_checked_out is null or coalesce(p_approved, 0) <= 0 then 0
    else greatest(0, least(
      p_approved,
      coalesce(p_paid, 0),
      floor(extract(epoch from (p_checked_out - greatest(p_scheduled_end, p_checked_in))) / 60)::integer))
  end;
$$;

-- 3. Chủ sân đề nghị tăng ca ------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.offer_overtime(
  p_shift_id uuid,
  p_minutes integer,
  p_hourly_rate integer,
  p_reason text,
  p_agreed_in_person boolean default false)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v public.shifts;
  v_id uuid;
  v_ot_end timestamptz;
  v_status text;
begin
  perform private.require_owner();
  select * into v from public.shifts where id = p_shift_id and deleted_at is null for update;
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('SHIFT_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if v.status not in ('scheduled', 'present') then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_SHIFT_NOT_WORKED');
  end if;
  if private.payroll_month_closed(v.work_date) then
    perform private.raise_error('PAYROLL_MONTH_CLOSED');
  end if;
  if p_minutes is null or p_minutes < 15 or p_minutes > 480 or p_minutes % 15 <> 0 then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_INVALID_MINUTES');
  end if;
  if p_hourly_rate is null or p_hourly_rate < 1000 or p_hourly_rate > 20000000 then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_INVALID_RATE');
  end if;
  if char_length(btrim(coalesce(p_reason, ''))) < 3 then
    perform private.raise_error('REASON_REQUIRED', 'Tối thiểu 3 ký tự');
  end if;
  v_ot_end := v.scheduled_end + make_interval(mins => p_minutes);
  if v_ot_end - v.scheduled_start > interval '16 hours' then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_TOO_LONG');
  end if;
  -- Hỏi qua ứng dụng thì phải còn thời gian để nhân viên trả lời.
  if not coalesce(p_agreed_in_person, false) and now() >= v_ot_end then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_WINDOW_PASSED');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.shifts o
              where o.employee_id = v.employee_id and o.id <> v.id and o.deleted_at is null and o.status <> 'cancelled'
                and o.scheduled_range && tstzrange(v.scheduled_end, v_ot_end, '[)')) then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_OVERLAPS_SHIFT');
  end if;
  if exists (select 1 from public.shift_overtime o where o.shift_id = v.id and o.status in ('pending', 'accepted')) then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_ALREADY_OFFERED');
  end if;

  v_status := case when coalesce(p_agreed_in_person, false) then 'accepted' else 'pending' end;
  perform private.set_audit_reason(case when v_status = 'accepted' then 'overtime_in_person' else 'overtime_offer' end);
  insert into public.shift_overtime (shift_id, employee_id, branch_id, minutes, hourly_rate, reason, status, consent,
                                     requested_by, responded_by, responded_at)
  values (v.id, v.employee_id, v.branch_id, p_minutes, p_hourly_rate, btrim(p_reason), v_status,
          case when v_status = 'accepted' then 'in_person' end,
          (select auth.uid()),
          case when v_status = 'accepted' then (select auth.uid()) end,
          case when v_status = 'accepted' then now() end)
  returning id into v_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'status', v_status, 'ends_at', v_ot_end);
end;
$$;

-- 4. Nhân viên đồng ý / từ chối ---------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.respond_overtime(p_offer_id uuid, p_accept boolean, p_note text default null)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  o public.shift_overtime;
  v_end timestamptz;
  v_employee uuid := private.current_employee_id();
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or v_employee is null then
    perform private.raise_error('STAFF_NOT_ALLOWED');
  end if;
  select * into o from public.shift_overtime where id = p_offer_id for update;
  if not found or o.employee_id <> v_employee then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if o.status <> 'pending' then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_ALREADY_ANSWERED');
  end if;
  select s.scheduled_end + make_interval(mins => o.minutes) into v_end from public.shifts s where s.id = o.shift_id;
  if now() >= v_end then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_EXPIRED');
  end if;
  perform private.set_audit_reason(case when p_accept then 'overtime_accept' else 'overtime_decline' end);
  update public.shift_overtime
     set status = case when p_accept then 'accepted' else 'declined' end,
         consent = case when p_accept then 'app' end,
         responded_by = (select auth.uid()), responded_at = now(),
         response_note = left(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_note, '')), ''), 300)
   where id = o.id;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', o.id, 'status', case when p_accept then 'accepted' else 'declined' end);
end;
$$;

-- 5. Chủ sân hủy đề nghị (giữ lịch sử) --------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.cancel_overtime(p_offer_id uuid, p_reason text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  o public.shift_overtime;
  v_date date;
begin
  perform private.require_owner();
  if char_length(btrim(coalesce(p_reason, ''))) < 3 then
    perform private.raise_error('REASON_REQUIRED', 'Tối thiểu 3 ký tự');
  end if;
  select * into o from public.shift_overtime where id = p_offer_id for update;
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if o.status not in ('pending', 'accepted') then
    perform private.raise_error('OVERTIME_ALREADY_ANSWERED');
  end if;
  select work_date into v_date from public.shifts where id = o.shift_id;
  if private.payroll_month_closed(v_date) then
    perform private.raise_error('PAYROLL_MONTH_CLOSED');
  end if;
  perform private.set_audit_reason('overtime_cancel: ' || btrim(p_reason));
  update public.shift_overtime
     set status = 'cancelled', response_note = left(btrim(p_reason), 300)
   where id = o.id;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', o.id, 'status', 'cancelled');
end;
$$;

revoke all on function private.overtime_worked_minutes(timestamptz, timestamptz, timestamptz, integer, integer) from public, anon;
revoke all on function public.offer_overtime(uuid, integer, integer, text, boolean) from public, anon;
revoke all on function public.respond_overtime(uuid, boolean, text) from public, anon;
revoke all on function public.cancel_overtime(uuid, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function private.overtime_worked_minutes(timestamptz, timestamptz, timestamptz, integer, integer) to authenticated, service_role;
grant execute on function public.offer_overtime(uuid, integer, integer, text, boolean) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.respond_overtime(uuid, boolean, text) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.cancel_overtime(uuid, text) to authenticated;

-- 6. Phiếu lương lưu riêng phần tăng ca (đã gồm trong base_pay) --------------------------------
alter table public.payroll_lines add column if not exists overtime_minutes integer not null default 0;
alter table public.payroll_lines add column if not exists overtime_pay bigint not null default 0;
comment on column public.payroll_lines.overtime_pay is 'Tiền tăng ca (đã cộng trong base_pay).';

-- 7. Quét QR ra ca: tăng ca đã đồng ý kéo dài thời hạn ------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.scan_attendance_qr(p_token text, p_event text)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
  v_employee uuid;
  v_branch uuid;
  v_shift public.shifts;
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null then
    perform private.raise_error('AUTH_REQUIRED');
  end if;
  if p_event not in ('checkin', 'checkout') or p_token is null or p_token !~ '^[0-9a-f]{48}$' then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_QR_REQUEST');
  end if;
  select sa.employee_id into v_employee
    from public.staff_accounts sa
    join public.employees e on e.id = sa.employee_id and e.status = 'active'
   where sa.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and sa.is_active and not sa.must_change_password;
  if v_employee is null then
    perform private.raise_error('STAFF_NOT_ALLOWED');
  end if;

  select q.branch_id into v_branch
    from public.attendance_qr_tokens q
   where q.token_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(p_token, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
     and q.expires_at > v_now;
  if v_branch is null then
    perform private.raise_error('QR_EXPIRED_OR_INVALID');
  end if;

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('rally.qr_scan'), hashtext(v_employee::text));

  if p_event = 'checkin' then
    if exists (select 1 from public.shifts s
                where s.employee_id = v_employee and s.checked_in_at is not null
                  and s.checked_out_at is null and s.deleted_at is null) then
      perform private.raise_error('ALREADY_CHECKED_IN');
    end if;
    select * into v_shift from public.shifts s
     where s.employee_id = v_employee and s.branch_id = v_branch
       and s.status = 'scheduled' and s.checked_in_at is null and s.deleted_at is null
       and v_now >= s.scheduled_start - interval '60 minutes'
       and v_now < s.scheduled_end
     order by s.scheduled_start
     limit 1
     for update;
    if not found then
      perform private.raise_error('NO_ELIGIBLE_SHIFT');
    end if;
    perform private.set_audit_reason('qr_checkin');
    update public.shifts set checked_in_at = v_now where id = v_shift.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('event', 'checkin', 'shift_id', v_shift.id, 'at', v_now);
  end if;

  select * into v_shift from public.shifts s
   where s.employee_id = v_employee and s.branch_id = v_branch
     and s.checked_in_at is not null and s.checked_out_at is null and s.deleted_at is null
   for update;
  if not found then
    perform private.raise_error('NO_OPEN_CHECKIN');
  end if;
  if v_now < v_shift.checked_in_at + interval '1 minute' then
    perform private.raise_error('CHECKOUT_TOO_SOON');
  end if;
  -- Tăng ca đã đồng ý kéo dài thời hạn quét ra tương ứng.
  if v_now > v_shift.scheduled_end + interval '4 hours'
             + make_interval(mins => coalesce((select o.minutes from public.shift_overtime o
                                                where o.shift_id = v_shift.id and o.status = 'accepted' limit 1), 0)) then
    perform private.raise_error('CHECKOUT_TOO_LATE', 'Liên hệ chủ sân để điều chỉnh công.');
  end if;
  perform private.set_audit_reason('qr_checkout');
  update public.shifts
     set checked_out_at = v_now, status = 'present', actual_break_minutes = v_shift.break_minutes
   where id = v_shift.id;
  return jsonb_build_object('event', 'checkout', 'shift_id', v_shift.id, 'at', v_now,
                            'paid_minutes', (select paid_minutes from public.shifts where id = v_shift.id));
end;
$$;

-- 8. Chốt lương tháng: tách giá thường / giá tăng ca ----------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.close_payroll_month(p_month date)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_period uuid;
  v_unresolved integer;
  v_missing_rate integer;
  v_negative integer;
  v_next date;
begin
  perform private.require_owner();
  if p_month is null or p_month <> date_trunc('month', p_month)::date then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_MONTH');
  end if;
  if p_month >= date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date then
    perform private.raise_error('MONTH_NOT_COMPLETED');
  end if;
  v_next := (p_month + interval '1 month')::date;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('rally.payroll_close'), hashtext(p_month::text));
  if exists (select 1 from public.payroll_periods where month = p_month) then
    perform private.raise_error('MONTH_ALREADY_CLOSED');
  end if;

  -- Khóa toàn bộ ca & điều chỉnh của tháng để không ai sửa trong lúc chốt.
  perform 1 from public.shifts s where s.work_date >= p_month and s.work_date < v_next for update;
  perform 1 from public.payroll_adjustments a where a.month = p_month for update;
  perform 1 from public.shift_overtime o join public.shifts s on s.id = o.shift_id
   where s.work_date >= p_month and s.work_date < v_next for update of o;

  select count(*) into v_unresolved from public.shifts s
   where s.work_date >= p_month and s.work_date < v_next and s.deleted_at is null and s.status = 'scheduled';
  if v_unresolved > 0 then
    perform private.raise_error('UNRESOLVED_SHIFTS', v_unresolved::text);
  end if;

  drop table if exists pg_temp.rally_payroll_calc;
  create temporary table pg_temp.rally_payroll_calc (
    employee_id uuid primary key, shifts_count integer, paid_minutes integer, base_pay bigint, missing_rate integer,
    overtime_minutes integer not null default 0, overtime_pay bigint not null default 0
  ) on commit drop;
  truncate pg_temp.rally_payroll_calc;

  -- Phút sau giờ ra ca (trong phần tăng ca đã đồng ý) tính giá tăng ca; phần còn lại giá thường.
  insert into pg_temp.rally_payroll_calc (employee_id, shifts_count, paid_minutes, base_pay, missing_rate,
                                          overtime_minutes, overtime_pay)
  select s.employee_id,
         count(*) filter (where s.status = 'present')::integer,
         coalesce(sum(s.paid_minutes), 0)::integer,
         coalesce(sum(case
           when s.status <> 'present' then 0
           when r.pay_type = 'hourly' then round(r.hourly_rate::numeric * (s.paid_minutes - w.ot) / 60)
           else round(r.daily_rate::numeric * (s.paid_minutes - w.ot) / r.standard_day_minutes) end
           + case when s.status = 'present' then round(coalesce(o.hourly_rate, 0)::numeric * w.ot / 60) else 0 end), 0)::bigint,
         count(*) filter (where s.status = 'present' and r.id is null)::integer,
         coalesce(sum(w.ot) filter (where s.status = 'present'), 0)::integer,
         coalesce(sum(round(coalesce(o.hourly_rate, 0)::numeric * w.ot / 60)) filter (where s.status = 'present'), 0)::bigint
    from public.shifts s
    left join lateral (
      select pr.* from public.employee_pay_rates pr
       where pr.employee_id = s.employee_id and pr.effective_from <= s.work_date
       order by pr.effective_from desc limit 1) r on true
    left join lateral (
      select ov.minutes, ov.hourly_rate from public.shift_overtime ov
       where ov.shift_id = s.id and ov.status = 'accepted' limit 1) o on true
    cross join lateral (
      select private.overtime_worked_minutes(s.checked_in_at, s.checked_out_at, s.scheduled_end, o.minutes, s.paid_minutes) as ot) w
   where s.work_date >= p_month and s.work_date < v_next and s.deleted_at is null
   group by s.employee_id;

  select coalesce(sum(missing_rate), 0) into v_missing_rate from pg_temp.rally_payroll_calc;
  if v_missing_rate > 0 then
    perform private.raise_error('MISSING_PAY_RATE', v_missing_rate::text || ' ca');
  end if;

  -- Nhân viên chỉ có điều chỉnh (không có ca) vẫn có dòng lương.
  insert into pg_temp.rally_payroll_calc (employee_id, shifts_count, paid_minutes, base_pay, missing_rate)
  select distinct a.employee_id, 0, 0, 0, 0 from public.payroll_adjustments a
   where a.month = p_month and a.voided_at is null
  on conflict (employee_id) do nothing;

  select count(*) into v_negative
    from pg_temp.rally_payroll_calc c
    left join lateral (select coalesce(sum(a.amount), 0) as total from public.payroll_adjustments a
                        where a.employee_id = c.employee_id and a.month = p_month and a.voided_at is null) adj on true
   where c.base_pay + adj.total < 0;
  if v_negative > 0 then
    perform private.raise_error('NEGATIVE_NET_PAY', v_negative::text);
  end if;

  insert into public.payroll_periods (month, closed_by) values (p_month, (select auth.uid()))
  returning id into v_period;

  insert into public.payroll_lines (period_id, employee_id, employee_code, employee_name, branch_id,
                                    shifts_count, paid_minutes, base_pay, adjustments_total,
                                    overtime_minutes, overtime_pay)
  select v_period, e.id, e.code, e.full_name, e.home_branch_id,
         c.shifts_count, c.paid_minutes, c.base_pay,
         coalesce((select sum(a.amount) from public.payroll_adjustments a
                    where a.employee_id = e.id and a.month = p_month and a.voided_at is null), 0),
         c.overtime_minutes, c.overtime_pay
    from pg_temp.rally_payroll_calc c
    join public.employees e on e.id = c.employee_id;

  return v_period;
end;
$$;

-- 9. Xem trước bảng lương: thêm cột tăng ca (đổi kiểu trả về nên phải drop trước) ----------------
drop function if exists public.preview_payroll_month(date);
create or replace function public.preview_payroll_month(p_month date)
returns table (
  employee_id uuid,
  employee_code text,
  employee_name text,
  shifts_count integer,
  paid_minutes integer,
  base_pay bigint,
  adjustments_total bigint,
  net_pay bigint,
  unresolved_shifts integer,
  missing_rate_shifts integer,
  overtime_minutes integer,
  overtime_pay bigint,
  pending_overtime integer)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_next date;
begin
  perform private.require_owner();
  if p_month is null or p_month <> date_trunc('month', p_month)::date then
    perform private.raise_error('INVALID_MONTH');
  end if;
  v_next := (p_month + interval '1 month')::date;
  return query
  with calc as (
    select s.employee_id as emp,
           count(*) filter (where s.status = 'present')::integer as n_present,
           coalesce(sum(s.paid_minutes), 0)::integer as mins,
           coalesce(sum(case
             when s.status <> 'present' or r.id is null then 0
             when r.pay_type = 'hourly' then round(r.hourly_rate::numeric * (s.paid_minutes - w.ot) / 60)
             else round(r.daily_rate::numeric * (s.paid_minutes - w.ot) / r.standard_day_minutes) end
             + case when s.status = 'present' then round(coalesce(o.hourly_rate, 0)::numeric * w.ot / 60) else 0 end), 0)::bigint as gross,
           count(*) filter (where s.status = 'scheduled')::integer as n_unresolved,
           count(*) filter (where s.status = 'present' and r.id is null)::integer as n_missing,
           coalesce(sum(w.ot) filter (where s.status = 'present'), 0)::integer as ot_mins,
           coalesce(sum(round(coalesce(o.hourly_rate, 0)::numeric * w.ot / 60)) filter (where s.status = 'present'), 0)::bigint as ot_pay,
           count(p.id)::integer as n_pending
      from public.shifts s
      left join lateral (
        select pr.* from public.employee_pay_rates pr
         where pr.employee_id = s.employee_id and pr.effective_from <= s.work_date
         order by pr.effective_from desc limit 1) r on true
      left join lateral (
        select ov.minutes, ov.hourly_rate from public.shift_overtime ov
         where ov.shift_id = s.id and ov.status = 'accepted' limit 1) o on true
      left join lateral (
        select ov.id from public.shift_overtime ov
         where ov.shift_id = s.id and ov.status = 'pending' limit 1) p on true
      cross join lateral (
        select private.overtime_worked_minutes(s.checked_in_at, s.checked_out_at, s.scheduled_end, o.minutes, s.paid_minutes) as ot) w
     where s.work_date >= p_month and s.work_date < v_next and s.deleted_at is null
     group by s.employee_id
  ), adj as (
    select a.employee_id as emp, sum(a.amount)::bigint as total
      from public.payroll_adjustments a
     where a.month = p_month and a.voided_at is null
     group by a.employee_id
  ), people as (
    select emp from calc union select emp from adj
  )
  select e.id, e.code, e.full_name,
         coalesce(c.n_present, 0), coalesce(c.mins, 0), coalesce(c.gross, 0),
         coalesce(a.total, 0), coalesce(c.gross, 0) + coalesce(a.total, 0),
         coalesce(c.n_unresolved, 0), coalesce(c.n_missing, 0),
         coalesce(c.ot_mins, 0), coalesce(c.ot_pay, 0), coalesce(c.n_pending, 0)
    from people p
    join public.employees e on e.id = p.emp
    left join calc c on c.emp = p.emp
    left join adj a on a.emp = p.emp
   order by e.code;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.preview_payroll_month(date) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.preview_payroll_month(date) to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.close_payroll_month(date) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.close_payroll_month(date) to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.scan_attendance_qr(text, text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.scan_attendance_qr(text, text) to authenticated;

commit;

notify pgrst, 'reload schema';

File: supabase/sql/19_staff_checkout.sql
