import 'server-only';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export const AUDIT_TABLES: Record<string, string> = {
  bookings: 'Đặt sân',
  payments: 'Thanh toán',
  customers: 'Khách hàng',
  branches: 'Chi nhánh',
  courts: 'Sân',
  price_rules: 'Bảng giá',
  products: 'Sản phẩm',
  product_variants: 'Biến thể',
  rental_rates: 'Giá thuê',
  inventory_levels: 'Cài đặt tồn kho',
  sales: 'Đơn bán',
  rentals: 'Cho thuê',
  shifts: 'Ca làm',
  employees: 'Nhân viên',
  employee_pay_rates: 'Mức lương',
  staff_accounts: 'Tài khoản',
  staff_branch_permissions: 'Phân quyền',
  payroll_adjustments: 'Điều chỉnh lương',
};

export const PAGE_SIZE = 50;

export async function listAuditEvents(opts: { table?: string; page: number }) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  let query = supabase
    .from('audit_events')
    .select('id, occurred_at, actor_id, actor_role, branch_id, table_name, record_id, action, reason, old_data, new_data', {
      count: 'estimated',
    })
    .order('occurred_at', { ascending: false })
    .order('id', { ascending: false })
    .range(opts.page * PAGE_SIZE, opts.page * PAGE_SIZE + PAGE_SIZE - 1);
  if (opts.table && opts.table in AUDIT_TABLES) query = query.eq('table_name', opts.table);
  // Danh sách tài khoản nhân sự nhỏ — lấy song song thay vì chờ sự kiện rồi mới tra tên.
  const [{ data, error, count }, { data: actors }] = await Promise.all([
    query,
    supabase.from('staff_accounts').select('user_id, display_name'),
  ]);
  if (error) throw error;
  const events = data ?? [];
  const names = new Map((actors ?? []).map((a) => [a.user_id, a.display_name]));
  return {
    events: events.map((e) => ({ ...e, actorName: e.actor_id ? (names.get(e.actor_id) ?? 'Tài khoản đã xóa') : 'Hệ thống' })),
    count: count ?? events.length,
  };
}

'use server';

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

import { headers } from 'next/headers';
import { z } from 'zod';

import { getAuthUserId } from '@/lib/auth/context';
import { errorCode, toUserMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { formError, formSuccess, formZodError, type FormState } from '@/lib/form-state';
import { createSecretClient } from '@/lib/supabase/secret';
import { zText, zUuid, zVnPhone } from '@/lib/validation';

import {
  bookingSummarySchema,
  guestHoldSchema,
  phoneLookupSchema,
  type BookingSummary,
  type GuestHoldInput,
  type GuestHoldResult,
  type PhoneBooking,
} from './schemas';
import { verifyTurnstile } from './turnstile';

/** Khách giữ sân không cần đăng nhập. Mọi kiểm tra cuối cùng (trùng giờ, giá, giới hạn) nằm trong database. */
export async function createGuestHoldAction(input: GuestHoldInput): Promise<GuestHoldResult> {
  const parsed = guestHoldSchema.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Partial<Record<string, string>> = {};
    for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
      const key = String(issue.path[0] ?? '_form');
      fieldErrors[key] ??= issue.message;
    }
    return { ok: false, error: 'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại thông tin.', fieldErrors };
  }
  const v = parsed.data;

  if (!(await verifyTurnstile(v.turnstileToken))) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'Xác minh chống spam không thành công. Vui lòng thử lại.',
      fieldErrors: { turnstileToken: 'Hãy xác minh lại' },
    };
  }

  const supabase = createSecretClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('create_guest_booking_hold', {
    p_court_id: v.courtId,
    p_starts_at: v.startsAt,
    p_ends_at: v.endsAt,
    p_contact_name: v.contactName,
    p_phone: v.phone,
    p_customer_note: v.note,
    p_idempotency_key: v.idempotencyKey,
  });
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: toUserMessage(error), code: errorCode(error) ?? undefined };
  const booking = bookingSummarySchema.safeParse(data);
  if (!booking.success) return { ok: false, error: 'Không đọc được kết quả giữ sân. Vui lòng tra cứu lại đơn.' };
  // Khách đang đăng nhập tài khoản thành viên: gắn đơn vào tài khoản (người dùng lấy từ phiên phía máy chủ).
  let savedToAccount = false;
  const userId = await getAuthUserId();
  if (userId) {
    const { data: attached } = await supabase.rpc('service_attach_member_booking', {
      p_booking_id: booking.data.booking_id,
      p_user_id: userId,
    });
    savedToAccount = attached === true;
  }
  return { ok: true, booking: booking.data, savedToAccount };
}

const lookupSchema = z.object({
  code: zText('mã đơn', 6, 20).transform((c) => c.toUpperCase().replace(/\s/g, '')),
  phone: zVnPhone(),
});

export interface LookupState extends FormState {
  booking?: BookingSummary;
  phone?: string;
}

export async function lookupBookingAction(_prev: LookupState, formData: FormData): Promise<LookupState> {
  const parsed = lookupSchema.safeParse({ code: formData.get('code'), phone: formData.get('phone') });
  if (!parsed.success) return formZodError(parsed.error);
  const { data, error } = await createSecretClient().rpc('lookup_guest_booking', {
    p_code: parsed.data.code,
    p_phone: parsed.data.phone,
  });
  if (error) return formError(toUserMessage(error));
  const booking = bookingSummarySchema.safeParse(data);
  if (!booking.success) return formError('Không đọc được thông tin đơn.');
  return { ...formSuccess(''), booking: booking.data, phone: parsed.data.phone };
}

export async function cancelGuestBookingAction(_prev: LookupState, formData: FormData): Promise<LookupState> {
  const parsed = lookupSchema.safeParse({ code: formData.get('code'), phone: formData.get('phone') });
  if (!parsed.success) return formZodError(parsed.error);
  const { data, error } = await createSecretClient().rpc('cancel_guest_booking', {
    p_code: parsed.data.code,
    p_phone: parsed.data.phone,
    p_reason: 'Khách tự hủy trên website',
  });
  if (error) return formError(toUserMessage(error));
  const booking = bookingSummarySchema.safeParse(data);
  if (!booking.success) return formError('Đã hủy đơn, nhưng không đọc được thông tin cập nhật.');
  return { ...formSuccess('Đã hủy đơn.'), booking: booking.data, phone: parsed.data.phone };
}

// ---- Khách vãng lai quên mã: tra bằng số điện thoại ------------------------------------------

/** Dấu vết thiết bị để giới hạn số lần thử (băm IP, không lưu IP thật). */
async function clientKey(): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const h = await headers();
  const ip = h.get('cf-connecting-ip') ?? h.get('x-real-ip') ?? h.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim();
  if (!ip) return undefined;
  return createHash('sha256').update(`rally-lookup:${ip}`).digest('hex').slice(0, 40);
}

const phoneOnlySchema = z.object({ phone: zVnPhone(), turnstileToken: z.string().min(1, 'Vui lòng hoàn tất bước xác minh') });

export interface PhoneLookupState extends FormState {
  phone?: string;
  items?: PhoneBooking[];
  memberBookings?: number;
}

/** Bước 1: danh sách đơn của số điện thoại (chỉ xem — mã che bớt, chỉ hiện tên gọi). */
export async function lookupByPhoneAction(_prev: PhoneLookupState, formData: FormData): Promise<PhoneLookupState> {
  const parsed = phoneOnlySchema.safeParse({ phone: formData.get('phone'), turnstileToken: formData.get('turnstileToken') });
  if (!parsed.success) return formZodError(parsed.error);
  if (!(await verifyTurnstile(parsed.data.turnstileToken))) {
    return formError('Xác minh chống spam không thành công. Vui lòng thử lại.', { turnstileToken: 'Hãy xác minh lại' });
  }
  const { data, error } = await createSecretClient().rpc('lookup_guest_bookings_by_phone', {
    p_phone: parsed.data.phone,
    p_client: await clientKey(),
  });
  if (error) return formError(toUserMessage(error));
  const result = phoneLookupSchema.safeParse(data);
  if (!result.success) return formError('Không đọc được danh sách đơn.');
  return { ...formSuccess(''), phone: parsed.data.phone, items: result.data.items, memberBookings: result.data.member_bookings };
}

const revealSchema = z.object({
  bookingId: zUuid('đơn'),
  phone: zVnPhone(),
  name: zText('họ tên người đặt', 2, 80).transform((v) => v.normalize('NFC')),
});

export interface RevealState extends LookupState {
  bookingId?: string;
}

/** Bước 2: nhập đúng họ tên đã dùng khi đặt → mở đủ thông tin đơn (mã đầy đủ, hủy đơn). */
export async function revealGuestBookingAction(_prev: RevealState, formData: FormData): Promise<RevealState> {
  const bookingId = String(formData.get('bookingId') ?? '');
  const parsed = revealSchema.safeParse({ bookingId, phone: formData.get('phone'), name: formData.get('name') });
  if (!parsed.success) return { ...formZodError(parsed.error), bookingId };
  const { data, error } = await createSecretClient().rpc('reveal_guest_booking', {
    p_booking_id: parsed.data.bookingId,
    p_phone: parsed.data.phone,
    p_name: parsed.data.name,
    p_client: await clientKey(),
  });
  if (error) return { ...formError(toUserMessage(error)), bookingId };
  const mismatch = z.object({ error: z.string() }).safeParse(data);
  if (mismatch.success) return { ...formError(toUserMessage({ message: mismatch.data.error }), { name: 'Họ tên chưa khớp' }), bookingId };
  const booking = bookingSummarySchema.safeParse(data);
  if (!booking.success) return { ...formError('Không đọc được thông tin đơn.'), bookingId };
  return { ...formSuccess(''), booking: booking.data, phone: parsed.data.phone, bookingId };
}

/** Kiểm tra lại đơn (trang chờ chuyển khoản tự hỏi vài giây một lần để biết đã nhận cọc chưa). */
export async function refreshGuestBookingAction(code: string, phone: string): Promise<BookingSummary | null> {
  const parsed = lookupSchema.safeParse({ code, phone });
  if (!parsed.success) return null;
  const { data, error } = await createSecretClient().rpc('lookup_guest_booking', {
    p_code: parsed.data.code,
    p_phone: parsed.data.phone,
  });
  if (error) return null;
  const booking = bookingSummarySchema.safeParse(data);
  return booking.success ? booking.data : null;
}

function CopyCode({ code }: { code: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => {
        void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(code).then(() => {
          setCopied(true);
          window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
        });
      }}
      aria-label={copied ? 'Đã sao chép mã đơn' : 'Sao chép mã đơn'}
      className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-paper/10 text-paper ring-1 ring-paper/20 transition-colors hover:bg-paper/20"
    >
      {copied ? <Check className="size-4 text-court" aria-hidden /> : <Copy className="size-4" aria-hidden />}
    </button>
  );
}

function JourneyTrack({ journey }: { journey: BookingJourney }) {
  if (journey.kind === 'stopped') {
    return (
      <p className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-control bg-shuttle-soft px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-shuttle-deep">
        <CircleX className="size-5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
        {STOPPED_TEXT[journey.status]}
      </p>
    );
  }
  return (
    <ol className="grid grid-cols-4" aria-label="Tiến trình đơn">
      {BOOKING_STEPS.map((step, i) => {
        const done = i < journey.reached || journey.reached === BOOKING_STEPS.length - 1;
        const current = i === journey.reached;
        return (
          <li
            key={step.status}
            className="relative flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 text-center"
            aria-current={current ? 'step' : undefined}
          >
            {i > 0 && (
              <span
                aria-hidden
                className={cn('absolute top-3.5 right-1/2 h-0.5 w-full -translate-y-1/2', i <= journey.reached ? 'bg-court' : 'bg-line')}
              />
            )}
            <span
              className={cn(
                'relative z-10 grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-full text-xs font-semibold',
                done && 'bg-court text-on-court',
                current && !done && 'bg-ink text-paper ring-4 ring-court/30',
                !done && !current && 'border-2 border-line bg-paper text-muted',
              )}
            >
              {done ? <Check className="size-4" strokeWidth={3} aria-hidden /> : i + 1}
            </span>
            <span className={cn('text-xs sm:text-sm', current ? 'font-semibold text-ink' : 'text-muted')}>{step.label}</span>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}

          {booking.contact_name && (
            <p className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-paper/15 pt-4 text-sm text-paper/80">
              <UserRound className="size-4 shrink-0 text-paper/60" aria-hidden />
              <span className="truncate">
                Người đặt: <span className="font-medium text-paper">{booking.contact_name}</span>
              </span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* PHẦN THÂN VÉ ------------------------------------------------------ */}
        <div className="relative flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-6 p-5 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
          {/* Đường răng cưa giữa cuống và thân vé */}
          <span
            aria-hidden
            className="absolute inset-x-5 top-0 border-t-2 border-dashed border-line lg:inset-x-auto lg:inset-y-5 lg:left-0 lg:border-t-0 lg:border-l-2"
          />
          <span aria-hidden className="absolute -top-3 -left-3 size-6 rounded-full border border-line bg-paper lg:-top-3 lg:-left-3" />
          <span
            aria-hidden
            className="absolute -top-3 -right-3 size-6 rounded-full border border-line bg-paper lg:top-auto lg:-bottom-3 lg:-left-3 lg:right-auto"
          />

          <JourneyTrack journey={journey} />

          <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <InfoBlock icon={<CalendarDays className="size-5" aria-hidden />} label="Thời gian">
              <span className="font-display text-2xl leading-tight">
                {when.weekday}, {when.dayMonth}
                <span className="text-muted">/{when.year}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-[0.95rem] font-medium tabular">{when.timeRange}</span>
              <span className="text-sm text-muted">Thời lượng {when.duration}</span>
            </InfoBlock>
            <InfoBlock icon={<MapPin className="size-5" aria-hidden />} label="Địa điểm">
              <span className="font-display text-2xl leading-tight">{branchName}</span>
              {booking.court_name && (
                <span className="w-fit rounded-md bg-ink px-2 py-0.5 text-sm font-medium text-paper">{booking.court_name}</span>
              )}
              {booking.branch_address && <span className="text-sm text-muted">{booking.branch_address}</span>}
              <a
                href={directionsUrl(branchName, booking.branch_address)}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="mt-0.5 inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1 text-sm font-medium text-court-deep hover:underline hover:underline-offset-4"
              >
                <Navigation className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                Chỉ đường
              </a>
            </InfoBlock>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-panel bg-hall p-4 sm:p-5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <Wallet className="size-5 text-court-deep" aria-hidden />
                <span className="text-sm text-muted">Tổng tiền sân</span>
              </div>
              <span className="font-display text-3xl tabular">{formatVnd(booking.total_amount)}</span>
            </div>
            {owing && (
              <div
                className="mt-3 h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-paper ring-1 ring-line"
                role="progressbar"
                aria-label="Đã thanh toán"
                aria-valuemin={0}
                aria-valuemax={100}
                aria-valuenow={pay.percent}
              >
                <span className="block h-full rounded-full bg-court transition-[width] duration-500" style={{ width: `${pay.percent}%` }} />
              </div>
            )}
            <dl className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm sm:grid-cols-3">
              <div>
                <dt className="text-muted">Đã thanh toán</dt>
                <dd className="font-semibold text-court-deep tabular">{formatVnd(booking.paid_amount)}</dd>
              </div>
              {owing && (
                <div>
                  <dt className="text-muted">{pay.settled ? 'Trạng thái' : 'Còn lại'}</dt>
                  <dd className="font-semibold tabular">{pay.settled ? 'Đã đủ' : formatVnd(pay.remaining)}</dd>
                </div>
              )}
              {booking.deposit_amount > 0 && (
                <div>
                  <dt className="text-muted">Tiền cọc</dt>
                  <dd className="font-semibold tabular">{formatVnd(booking.deposit_amount)}</dd>
                </div>
              )}
              {booking.refund_entitlement !== null && (
                <div className={owing ? 'col-span-2 sm:col-span-3' : undefined}>
                  <dt className="text-muted">Được hoàn theo chính sách</dt>
                  <dd className="font-semibold text-shuttle-deep tabular">{formatVnd(booking.refund_entitlement)}</dd>
                </div>
              )}
            </dl>
          </div>

          {cancelError && (
            <p role="alert" className="rounded-control bg-shuttle-soft px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-shuttle-deep">
              {cancelError}
            </p>
          )}
          {cancelled && (
            <p role="status" className="rounded-control bg-court-soft px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-court-deep">
              Đã hủy đơn. Chi nhánh sẽ liên hệ nếu bạn được hoàn cọc.
            </p>
          )}

          {confirming && cancellable ? (
            <form
              action={cancelAction}
              className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-panel border border-shuttle/40 bg-shuttle-soft p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
            >
              <input type="hidden" name="code" value={booking.code} />
              <input type="hidden" name="phone" value={phone} />
              <div className="text-sm text-shuttle-deep">
                <p className="font-semibold">Hủy đơn {booking.code}?</p>
                <p>Thao tác không hoàn tác được. Tiền cọc (nếu có) hoàn theo chính sách chi nhánh.</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-2">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirming(false)} className={buttonClass('outline', 'md', 'flex-1 sm:flex-none')}>
                  Giữ đơn
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={cancelling}
                  className={buttonClass('primary', 'md', 'flex-1 bg-shuttle hover:bg-shuttle-deep sm:flex-none')}
                >
                  {cancelling ? 'Đang hủy…' : 'Xác nhận hủy'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-auto flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-line pt-5 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center">
              <Link href="/booking" className={buttonClass('brand', 'md')}>
                Đặt thêm sân
                <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden />
              </Link>
              {hotline && (
                <a href={`tel:${hotline}`} className={buttonClass('outline', 'md')}>
                  <Phone className="size-4" aria-hidden />
                  {formatPhone(hotline)}
                </a>
              )}
              {onLookupAnother && (
                <button type="button" onClick={onLookupAnother} className={buttonClass('ghost', 'md')}>
                  <Search className="size-4" aria-hidden />
                  Tra cứu đơn khác
                </button>
              )}
              {extraAction}
              {cancellable && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirming(true)} className={buttonClass('danger', 'md', 'sm:ml-auto')}>
                  <RotateCcw className="size-4" aria-hidden />
                  Hủy đơn
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </article>
      {payment}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { ArrowLeft, Info, Search, Smartphone, Ticket } from 'lucide-react';
import { startTransition, useActionState, useEffect, useEffectEvent, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

import { buttonClass } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { DepositQr } from '@/features/payments/components/deposit-qr';
import { accountForBranch, type BankAccounts } from '@/features/payments/lib/transfer';
import { cn } from '@/lib/cn';
import { formatVnd } from '@/lib/format';

import {
  cancelGuestBookingAction,
  lookupBookingAction,
  lookupByPhoneAction,
  revealGuestBookingAction,
  type LookupState,
  type PhoneLookupState,
  type RevealState,
} from '../actions';
import { loadRecentBookings, rememberBooking, type RecentBooking } from '../lib/recent-bookings';
import { type BookingSummary } from '../schemas';

import { BookingTicket } from './booking-ticket';
import { LookupHelp } from './lookup-help';
import { PhoneBookingList } from './phone-booking-list';
import { RecentBookings } from './recent-bookings';
import { Turnstile } from './turnstile';

const initial: LookupState = { status: 'idle' };
const initialPhone: PhoneLookupState = { status: 'idle' };
const initialReveal: RevealState = { status: 'idle' };

type Mode = 'phone' | 'code';

const inputClass =
  'min-h-12 w-full rounded-control border border-line bg-paper pr-3 pl-11 transition-colors placeholder:text-muted/60 focus:border-court-strong focus:ring-4 focus:ring-court/20 focus:outline-none aria-[invalid=true]:border-shuttle-deep';

function FieldIcon({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted">{children}</span>;
}

interface LookupPanelProps {
  defaultCode: string;
  hotline: string | null;
  intro: ReactNode;
  turnstileSiteKey: string;
  banks: BankAccounts;
}

export function LookupPanel({ defaultCode, hotline, intro, turnstileSiteKey, banks }: LookupPanelProps) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>(defaultCode ? 'code' : 'phone');
  const [lookup, lookupAction, looking] = useActionState(lookupBookingAction, initial);
  const [phoneSearch, phoneAction, searching] = useActionState(lookupByPhoneAction, initialPhone);
  const [reveal, revealAction, revealing] = useActionState(revealGuestBookingAction, initialReveal);
  const [cancel, cancelAction, cancelling] = useActionState(cancelGuestBookingAction, initial);
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(turnstileSiteKey ? null : 'dev-no-turnstile');
  const [turnstileReset, setTurnstileReset] = useState(0);
  // Bấm "Các đơn của số này" / "Tìm số khác": ẩn vé / danh sách đã xem (theo dấu thời gian kết quả).
  const [hiddenTicketAt, setHiddenTicketAt] = useState(0);
  const [hiddenListAt, setHiddenListAt] = useState(0);
  // Đơn được cập nhật tại chỗ (tiền chuyển khoản vừa về) — theo mã đơn.
  const [liveUpdates, setLiveUpdates] = useState<Record<string, BookingSummary>>({});
  const codeRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const phoneRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const phoneOnlyRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const resultRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Vé đang xem: kết quả mới nhất giữa "tra bằng mã" và "mở đơn bằng họ tên".
  const codeAt = lookup.status === 'success' && lookup.booking ? (lookup.nonce ?? 0) : 0;
  const revealAt = reveal.status === 'success' && reveal.booking ? (reveal.nonce ?? 0) : 0;
  const listAt = phoneSearch.status === 'success' ? (phoneSearch.nonce ?? 0) : 0;
  const ticketAt = Math.max(codeAt, revealAt);
  const ticketSource = revealAt > codeAt ? reveal : lookup;
  const showTicket = ticketAt > 0 && ticketAt > hiddenTicketAt && ticketAt > listAt;
  const ticketBooking = showTicket ? (ticketSource.booking ?? null) : null;
  const showList = !showTicket && listAt > hiddenListAt && phoneSearch.items !== undefined;

  // Kết quả hủy chỉ áp vào đúng đơn đang xem (tránh hiện đơn cũ sau khi tra đơn khác).
  const sameBooking = Boolean(cancel.booking && ticketBooking && cancel.booking.code === ticketBooking.code);
  const baseBooking = sameBooking ? (cancel.booking ?? null) : ticketBooking;
  const booking = baseBooking ? (liveUpdates[baseBooking.code] ?? baseBooking) : null;
  const account = booking ? accountForBranch(banks, booking.branch_id) : null;
  const owesMoney = booking !== null && booking.paid_amount < booking.total_amount;
  const showPayment = booking !== null && account !== null && owesMoney && ['held', 'confirmed', 'checked_in'].includes(booking.status);
  const phone = (sameBooking ? cancel.phone : ticketSource.phone) ?? '';
  const bookingCode = booking?.code ?? null;
  const resultKey = `${bookingCode ?? ''}|${showList ? listAt : 0}`;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resultKey === '|0' || !resultRef.current) return;
    if (resultRef.current.getBoundingClientRect().top > window.innerHeight * 0.6) {
      resultRef.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
  }, [resultKey]);

  // Tra cứu / mở đơn thành công → nhớ đơn trên thiết bị để lần sau bấm là xem, không cần gõ lại.
  useEffect(() => {
    for (const result of [lookup, reveal]) {
      const found = result.booking;
      if (result.status !== 'success' || !found || !result.phone) continue;
      rememberBooking({
        code: found.code,
        phone: result.phone,
        startsAt: found.starts_at,
        branchName: found.branch_name ?? '',
        courtName: found.court_name ?? '',
      });
    }
  }, [lookup, reveal]);

  const openRecent = (b: RecentBooking) => {
    setMode('code');
    if (codeRef.current) codeRef.current.value = b.code;
    if (phoneRef.current) phoneRef.current.value = b.phone;
    const data = new FormData();
    data.set('code', b.code);
    data.set('phone', b.phone);
    startTransition(() => lookupAction(data));
  };

  // Mở từ nút "Xem trạng thái đơn" (?code=…) trên đúng thiết bị đã đặt → tự tra luôn, khách không phải gõ SĐT.
  const autoOpen = useEffectEvent(() => {
    if (!defaultCode) return;
    const saved = loadRecentBookings().find((b) => b.code === defaultCode.toUpperCase());
    if (!saved) return;
    if (phoneRef.current) phoneRef.current.value = saved.phone;
    const data = new FormData();
    data.set('code', saved.code);
    data.set('phone', saved.phone);
    startTransition(() => lookupAction(data));
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    autoOpen();
  }, []);

  const focusInput = (input: HTMLInputElement | null) => {
    if (!input) return;
    input.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    input.select();
  };

  const lookupAnother = () => focusInput(mode === 'phone' ? phoneOnlyRef.current : codeRef.current);

  const searchAnotherPhone = () => {
    setHiddenListAt(listAt);
    setHiddenTicketAt(ticketAt);
    setMode('phone');
    window.setTimeout(() => focusInput(phoneOnlyRef.current), 0);
  };

  const backToList = () => setHiddenTicketAt(ticketAt);

  return (
    <>
      {/* RALLY_LOOKUP_V8: hero su dung chung luong tra cuu hien tai. */}
      <section aria-labelledby="lookup-title" className="full-bleed rally-lookup-shell">
        <div className="rally-lookup-top">
          <div className="rally-lookup-container rally-lookup-top-grid">
            {intro}
            <div className="rally-lookup-court-graphic" aria-hidden>
              <span className="rally-lookup-graphic-tag">RALLY / MATCH CENTER</span>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 600 340" role="presentation" focusable="false">
                <g transform="translate(100 46) rotate(-16 200 125)" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                  <rect x="8" y="8" width="440" height="228" rx="2" strokeWidth="3" />
                  <path d="M8 31H448 M8 213H448 M228 8V236 M162 8V236 M294 8V236 M52 8V236 M404 8V236 M52 122H162 M294 122H404" strokeWidth="2" />
                  <path d="M228 -4V249" strokeWidth="7" stroke="#FFFFFF" />
                </g>
                <circle cx="480" cy="58" r="5" fill="#E31837" stroke="none" />
                <circle cx="127" cy="284" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none" />
              </svg>
              <span className="rally-lookup-graphic-foot">YOUR GAME. YOUR SCHEDULE.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="rally-lookup-container rally-lookup-formposition">
          <div className="rally-lookup-card">
            <div className="rally-lookup-formarea">
              <header className="rally-lookup-formhead">
                <div>
                  <span className="rally-lookup-smalllabel">BẮT ĐẦU TRA CỨU</span>
                  <h2>Tìm đơn đặt sân</h2>
                </div>
                <span className="rally-lookup-secure">
                  <span aria-hidden className="size-2 rounded-full bg-[#006341]" />
                  Xác minh an toàn
                </span>
              </header>
            <div role="tablist" aria-label="Cách tra cứu" className="rally-lookup-tabs grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-control bg-hall p-1">
              {(
                [
                  ['phone', 'Số điện thoại', Smartphone],
                  ['code', 'Mã đơn', Ticket],
                ] as const
              ).map(([key, label, Icon]) => (
                <button
                  key={key}
                  type="button"
                  role="tab"
                  aria-selected={mode === key}
                  onClick={() => setMode(key)}
                  className={cn(
                    'inline-flex min-h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[0.4rem] text-sm font-medium transition-colors',
                    mode === key ? 'bg-paper text-ink shadow-sm' : 'text-muted hover:text-ink',
                  )}
                >
                  <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden />
                  {label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <form
              action={phoneAction}
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const data = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
                data.set('turnstileToken', token ?? '');
                startTransition(() => phoneAction(data));
                // Mã chống bot chỉ dùng một lần: xin mã mới cho lần tìm sau.
                if (turnstileSiteKey) setTurnstileReset((n) => n + 1);
              }}
              noValidate
              className="flex flex-col gap-4"
              hidden={mode !== 'phone'}
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                <label htmlFor="phone-only" className="text-sm font-medium">
                  Số điện thoại đã dùng khi đặt
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <FieldIcon>
                    <Smartphone className="size-5" aria-hidden />
                  </FieldIcon>
                  <input
                    ref={phoneOnlyRef}
                    id="phone-only"
                    name="phone"
                    type="tel"
                    inputMode="tel"
                    autoComplete="tel"
                    placeholder="09xx xxx xxx"
                    aria-invalid={Boolean(phoneSearch.fieldErrors?.phone)}
                    aria-describedby={phoneSearch.fieldErrors?.phone ? 'phone-only-error' : undefined}
                    className={cn(inputClass, 'font-display text-xl tracking-wider tabular')}
                  />
                </div>
                {phoneSearch.fieldErrors?.phone && (
                  <p id="phone-only-error" className="text-sm text-shuttle-deep">
                    {phoneSearch.fieldErrors.phone}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
              {turnstileSiteKey && <Turnstile siteKey={turnstileSiteKey} onToken={setToken} resetSignal={turnstileReset} />}
              {phoneSearch.status === 'error' && !phoneSearch.fieldErrors?.phone && (
                <p role="alert" className="rounded-control border-l-4 border-shuttle bg-shuttle-soft px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-shuttle-deep">
                  {phoneSearch.message}
                </p>
              )}
              <button type="submit" disabled={searching || !token} className={buttonClass('brand', 'lg', 'mt-1 w-full')}>
                <Search className="size-5" aria-hidden />
                {searching ? 'Đang tìm đơn…' : 'Tìm đơn của tôi'}
              </button>
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted">
                <Info className="mt-px size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                Dành cho khách đặt không cần tài khoản. Xem đơn hôm nay, sắp tới và lịch sử đặt sân của số này.
              </p>
            </form>
            <form
              action={lookupAction}
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                // Gửi thủ công để ô nhập giữ nguyên giá trị sau khi tra cứu.
                e.preventDefault();
                const data = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
                startTransition(() => lookupAction(data));
              }}
              noValidate
              className="flex flex-col gap-4"
              hidden={mode !== 'code'}
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                <label htmlFor="code" className="text-sm font-medium">
                  Mã đơn
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <FieldIcon>
                    <Ticket className="size-5" aria-hidden />
                  </FieldIcon>
                  <input
                    ref={codeRef}
                    id="code"
                    name="code"
                    defaultValue={defaultCode}
                    placeholder="RB-XXXXXXXX"
                    autoCapitalize="characters"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    spellCheck={false}
                    aria-invalid={Boolean(lookup.fieldErrors?.code)}
                    aria-describedby={lookup.fieldErrors?.code ? 'code-error' : undefined}
                    className={cn(inputClass, 'font-display text-xl tracking-wider uppercase placeholder:normal-case')}
                  />
                </div>
                {lookup.fieldErrors?.code && (
                  <p id="code-error" className="text-sm text-shuttle-deep">
                    {lookup.fieldErrors.code}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                <label htmlFor="phone" className="text-sm font-medium">
                  Số điện thoại đã đặt
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <FieldIcon>
                    <Smartphone className="size-5" aria-hidden />
                  </FieldIcon>
                  <input
                    ref={phoneRef}
                    id="phone"
                    name="phone"
                    type="tel"
                    inputMode="tel"
                    autoComplete="tel"
                    placeholder="09xx xxx xxx"
                    autoFocus={defaultCode.length > 0}
                    aria-invalid={Boolean(lookup.fieldErrors?.phone)}
                    aria-describedby={lookup.fieldErrors?.phone ? 'phone-error' : undefined}
                    className={cn(inputClass, 'text-[1.05rem] tabular')}
                  />
                </div>
                {lookup.fieldErrors?.phone && (
                  <p id="phone-error" className="text-sm text-shuttle-deep">
                    {lookup.fieldErrors.phone}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
              {lookup.status === 'error' && !lookup.fieldErrors && (
                <p role="alert" className="rounded-control border-l-4 border-shuttle bg-shuttle-soft px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-shuttle-deep">
                  {lookup.message}
                </p>
              )}
              <button type="submit" disabled={looking} className={buttonClass('brand', 'lg', 'mt-1 w-full')}>
                <Search className="size-5" aria-hidden />
                {looking ? 'Đang tìm đơn…' : 'Tra cứu đơn'}
              </button>
              <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted">
                <Info className="mt-px size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                Quên mã? Chuyển sang tab Số điện thoại để xem các đơn đã đặt bằng số của bạn.
              </p>
            </form>
            </div>
            <aside className="rally-lookup-aside" aria-label="Hướng dẫn tra cứu nhanh">
              <span className="rally-lookup-smalllabel">ĐƠN GIẢN VÀ RIÊNG TƯ</span>
              <h3>Bạn có thể tra cứu theo hai cách.</h3>
              <ol className="rally-lookup-aside-steps">
                <li>
                  <span aria-hidden className="rally-lookup-step-index">01</span>
                  <div><strong>Số điện thoại</strong><p>Xem danh sách đơn theo số đã dùng khi đặt sân.</p></div>
                </li>
                <li>
                  <span aria-hidden className="rally-lookup-step-index">02</span>
                  <div><strong>Mã đơn</strong><p>Mở đơn cụ thể bằng mã đặt sân và số điện thoại.</p></div>
                </li>
              </ol>
              <div className="rally-lookup-aside-note">
                <Info className="size-5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                <p>Không có mã đơn? Hãy chọn <strong>Số điện thoại</strong> ở bên trái.</p>
              </div>
            </aside>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* KẾT QUẢ hoặc HƯỚNG DẪN ------------------------------------------- */}
      <div ref={resultRef} aria-live="polite" className="rally-lookup-results scroll-mt-24">
        {booking ? (
          <section aria-label={`Đơn ${booking.code}`}>
            <BookingTicket
              key={booking.code}
              booking={booking}
              phone={phone}
              hotline={hotline}
              cancelAction={cancelAction}
              cancelling={cancelling}
              cancelError={sameBooking && cancel.status === 'error' ? (cancel.message ?? null) : null}
              cancelled={sameBooking && cancel.status === 'success'}
              onLookupAnother={lookupAnother}
              payment={
                showPayment && account ? (
                  booking.status === 'held' || booking.paid_amount < booking.deposit_amount ? (
                    <DepositQr
                      key={booking.code}
                      booking={booking}
                      phone={phone}
                      account={account}
                      statusHref={null}
                      onUpdate={(next) => setLiveUpdates((all) => ({ ...all, [next.code]: next }))}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <details className="group rounded-panel border border-line bg-paper">
                      <summary className="flex min-h-12 cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 font-medium">
                        Chuyển khoản phần còn lại ({formatVnd(booking.total_amount - booking.paid_amount)})
                        <span className="text-sm text-muted group-open:hidden">Mở mã QR</span>
                      </summary>
                      <div className="border-t border-line p-3 sm:p-4">
                        <DepositQr
                          key={booking.code}
                          booking={booking}
                          phone={phone}
                          account={account}
                          statusHref={null}
                          collapseRemaining={false}
                          onUpdate={(next) => setLiveUpdates((all) => ({ ...all, [next.code]: next }))}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </details>
                  )
                ) : undefined
              }
              extraAction={
                phoneSearch.items && listAt > 0 ? (
                  <button type="button" onClick={backToList} className={buttonClass('outline', 'md')}>
                    <ArrowLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden />
                    Các đơn của số này
                  </button>
                ) : undefined
              }
            />
          </section>
        ) : showList && phoneSearch.phone ? (
          <PhoneBookingList
            phone={phoneSearch.phone}
            items={phoneSearch.items ?? []}
            memberBookings={phoneSearch.memberBookings ?? 0}
            hotline={hotline}
            revealAction={revealAction}
            reveal={reveal}
            revealing={revealing}
            onSearchAnother={searchAnotherPhone}
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-10">
            <RecentBookings onOpen={openRecent} />
            <LookupHelp hotline={hotline} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

import 'server-only';

import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache';
import { cache } from 'react';

import { isSupabaseConfigured } from '@/lib/env';
import { PUBLIC_REVALIDATE, PUBLIC_TAGS } from '@/lib/public-cache';
import { createPublicClient } from '@/lib/supabase/public';
import { type Tables } from '@/lib/supabase/database.types';

import { type PriceRuleLite } from '@/features/booking/lib/pricing';

export interface BranchSummary {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  addressLine: string;
  district: string | null;
  city: string;
  opensAt: string;
  closesAt: string;
  coverImagePath: string | null;
  courtCount: number;
  minPrice: number | null;
}

export type QueryResult<T> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; reason: 'not_configured' | 'error' };

const fetchPublishedBranches = unstable_cache(
  async (): Promise<BranchSummary[]> => {
    const { data, error } = await createPublicClient().rpc('list_published_branches');
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message); // lỗi không được lưu vào cache
    return data.map((b) => ({
      id: b.id,
      slug: b.slug,
      name: b.name,
      addressLine: b.address_line,
      district: b.district,
      city: b.city,
      opensAt: b.opens_at,
      closesAt: b.closes_at,
      coverImagePath: b.cover_image_path,
      courtCount: b.active_court_count,
      minPrice: b.min_price_per_hour,
    }));
  },
  ['published-branches'],
  { tags: [PUBLIC_TAGS.branches], revalidate: PUBLIC_REVALIDATE.branches },
);

/** Chi nhánh đã công bố (cache phía máy chủ; xóa cache khi admin sửa chi nhánh/sân/giá). */
export const listPublishedBranches = cache(async (): Promise<QueryResult<BranchSummary[]>> => {
  if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) return { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' };
  try {
    return { ok: true, data: await fetchPublishedBranches() };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'error' };
  }
});

export interface CourtPublic {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: Tables<'courts'>['status'];
  isIndoor: boolean;
  surface: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  photos: Array<{ path: string; alt: string | null }>;
}

export interface BranchDetail {
  branch: Pick<
    Tables<'branches'>,
    | 'id'
    | 'slug'
    | 'name'
    | 'address_line'
    | 'ward'
    | 'district'
    | 'city'
    | 'phone'
    | 'map_url'
    | 'timezone'
    | 'opens_at'
    | 'closes_at'
    | 'slot_minutes'
    | 'hold_minutes'
    | 'min_booking_minutes'
    | 'max_booking_minutes'
    | 'booking_window_days'
    | 'deposit_percent'
    | 'free_cancel_hours'
    | 'partial_refund_hours'
    | 'partial_refund_percent'
    | 'description'
    | 'parking_info'
    | 'house_rules'
    | 'cover_image_path'
    | 'bank_code'
    | 'bank_account_no'
    | 'bank_account_name'
    | 'transfer_memo_prefix'
  >;
  courts: CourtPublic[];
  amenities: Array<{ code: string; label: string; icon: string | null }>;
  priceRules: Array<PriceRuleLite & { label: string | null }>;
}

const fetchBranchDetail = unstable_cache(
  async (slug: string): Promise<BranchDetail | null> => {
    const supabase = createPublicClient();
    const { data: branch, error } = await supabase
      .from('branches')
      .select(
        'id, slug, name, address_line, ward, district, city, phone, map_url, timezone, opens_at, closes_at, slot_minutes, hold_minutes, min_booking_minutes, max_booking_minutes, booking_window_days, deposit_percent, free_cancel_hours, partial_refund_hours, partial_refund_percent, description, parking_info, house_rules, cover_image_path',
      )
      .eq('slug', slug)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
    if (!branch) return null;

    const [courtsRes, amenitiesRes, rulesRes, bankRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from('courts')
        .select(
          'id, name, status, is_indoor, description, sort_order, court_surfaces(label), court_photos(storage_path, alt_text, sort_order, is_cover)',
        )
        .eq('branch_id', branch.id)
        .order('sort_order')
        .order('name'),
      supabase.from('branch_amenities').select('amenity_code, amenities(code, label, icon, sort_order)').eq('branch_id', branch.id),
      supabase
        .from('price_rules')
        .select('id, court_id, label, days_mask, starts_at, ends_at, price_per_hour, priority, valid_from, valid_until, created_at')
        .eq('branch_id', branch.id)
        .order('starts_at'),
      // Tài khoản nhận cọc riêng: đọc tách riêng để database chưa chạy SQL mới vẫn đặt sân được.
      supabase
        .from('branches')
        .select('bank_code, bank_account_no, bank_account_name, transfer_memo_prefix')
        .eq('id', branch.id)
        .maybeSingle(),
    ]);
    if (bankRes.error) console.error('[branches] Chưa đọc được tài khoản nhận cọc (đã chạy 15_sepay_deposit.sql?):', bankRes.error.message);
    const bank = {
      bank_code: bankRes.data?.bank_code ?? null,
      bank_account_no: bankRes.data?.bank_account_no ?? null,
      bank_account_name: bankRes.data?.bank_account_name ?? null,
      transfer_memo_prefix: bankRes.data?.transfer_memo_prefix ?? null,
    };

    const courts: CourtPublic[] = (courtsRes.data ?? []).map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      name: c.name,
      status: c.status,
      isIndoor: c.is_indoor,
      surface: c.court_surfaces?.label ?? null,
      description: c.description,
      photos: [...c.court_photos]
        .sort((a, b) => Number(b.is_cover) - Number(a.is_cover) || a.sort_order - b.sort_order)
        .map((p) => ({ path: p.storage_path, alt: p.alt_text })),
    }));

    const amenities = (amenitiesRes.data ?? [])
      .flatMap((row) => (row.amenities ? [row.amenities] : []))
      .sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order)
      .map((a) => ({ code: a.code, label: a.label, icon: a.icon }));

    if (courtsRes.error || rulesRes.error) throw new Error('branch_detail_failed');
    return { branch: { ...branch, ...bank }, courts, amenities, priceRules: rulesRes.data ?? [] };
  },
  ['branch-detail', 'v4'],
  { tags: [PUBLIC_TAGS.branches], revalidate: PUBLIC_REVALIDATE.branches },
);

export const getBranchDetail = cache(async (slug: string): Promise<BranchDetail | null> => {
  if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) return null;
  return fetchBranchDetail(slug).catch((err: unknown) => {
    console.error('[branches] Không tải được chi nhánh', slug, err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
    return null;
  });
});

import 'server-only';

import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache';
import { cache } from 'react';

import { isSupabaseConfigured } from '@/lib/env';
import { PUBLIC_REVALIDATE, PUBLIC_TAGS } from '@/lib/public-cache';
import { createPublicClient } from '@/lib/supabase/public';
import { DEFAULT_BRAND_TAX, isTaxMethod, type BrandTax } from '@/lib/tax';
import { type BankAccount } from '@/features/payments/lib/transfer';

export interface BrandInfo {
  name: string;
  hotline: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  addressLine: string | null;
  facebookUrl: string | null;
  zaloUrl: string | null;
  paymentInstructions: string | null;
  /** Tài khoản nhận cọc chuyển khoản (null = chưa cài, khách đặt cọc theo hướng dẫn / tại quầy). */
  bank: BankAccount | null;
}

const FALLBACK: BrandInfo = {
  name: 'Rally Badminton',
  hotline: null,
  email: null,
  addressLine: null,
  facebookUrl: null,
  zaloUrl: null,
  paymentInstructions: null,
  bank: null,
};

/** Đọc từ database; lỗi thì ném ra để KHÔNG bị lưu vào cache. */
const fetchBrandInfo = unstable_cache(
  async (): Promise<BrandInfo | null> => {
    const supabase = createPublicClient();
    const [{ data, error }, bankRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabase
        .from('brand_settings')
        .select('name, hotline, email, address_line, facebook_url, zalo_url, payment_instructions')
        .maybeSingle(),
      // Đọc tách riêng: database chưa chạy SQL mới thì chỉ mất mã QR, website vẫn chạy bình thường.
      supabase.from('brand_settings').select('bank_code, bank_account_no, bank_account_name, transfer_memo_prefix').maybeSingle(),
    ]);
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
    if (!data) return null;
    if (bankRes.error) console.error('[brand] Chưa đọc được tài khoản nhận cọc (đã chạy 15_sepay_deposit.sql?):', bankRes.error.message);
    const bank = bankRes.data;
    return {
      name: data.name,
      hotline: data.hotline,
      email: data.email,
      addressLine: data.address_line,
      facebookUrl: data.facebook_url,
      zaloUrl: data.zalo_url,
      paymentInstructions: data.payment_instructions,
      bank:
        bank?.bank_code && bank.bank_account_no
          ? {
              bankCode: bank.bank_code,
              accountNo: bank.bank_account_no,
              accountName: bank.bank_account_name,
              memoPrefix: bank.transfer_memo_prefix,
            }
          : null,
    };
  },
  // Đổi phiên bản khi đổi dạng dữ liệu → không đọc nhầm bản cache cũ (thiếu tài khoản ngân hàng).
  ['brand-info', 'v4'],
  { tags: [PUBLIC_TAGS.brand], revalidate: PUBLIC_REVALIDATE.brand },
);

/** Thông tin thương hiệu (cache phía máy chủ; xóa cache khi lưu Cài đặt). */
export const getBrandInfo = cache(async (): Promise<BrandInfo> => {
  if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) return FALLBACK;
  try {
    return (await fetchBrandInfo()) ?? FALLBACK;
  } catch {
    return FALLBACK;
  }
});

export interface BrandTaxInfo extends BrandTax {
  taxCode: string | null;
}

/** Cách tính thuế của thương hiệu (cài đặt ở Cài đặt thương hiệu > Thuế). */
const fetchBrandTax = unstable_cache(
  async () => {
    const { data, error } = await createPublicClient()
      .from('brand_settings')
      .select('tax_method, default_vat_rate, tax_code')
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
    return data;
  },
  ['brand-tax'],
  { tags: [PUBLIC_TAGS.brand], revalidate: PUBLIC_REVALIDATE.brand },
);

export const getBrandTax = cache(async (): Promise<BrandTaxInfo> => {
  const fallback: BrandTaxInfo = { ...DEFAULT_BRAND_TAX, taxCode: null };
  if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) return fallback;
  const data = await fetchBrandTax().catch(() => null);
  if (!data) return fallback;
  return {
    method: isTaxMethod(data.tax_method) ? data.tax_method : 'deduction',
    defaultVatRate: Number(data.default_vat_rate),
    taxCode: data.tax_code,
  };
});

import Form from 'next/form';
import { ChevronDown, MapPin, Search, SlidersHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';

import { buttonClass } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@/lib/cn';

interface CatalogFiltersProps {
  basePath: '/products' | '/rentals';
  categories: Array<{ slug: string; name: string }>;
  branches: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
  current: { q?: string; category?: string; branch?: string };
}

/** Lọc bằng form GET — chạy không cần JavaScript, URL chia sẻ được. */
export function CatalogFilters({ basePath, categories, branches, current }: CatalogFiltersProps) {
  const query = (patch: Record<string, string | undefined>) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    const merged = { q: current.q, category: current.category, branch: current.branch, ...patch };
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(merged)) if (v) params.set(k, v);
    const s = params.toString();
    return s ? `${basePath}?${s}` : basePath;
  };
  const chip = (active: boolean) =>
    cn(
      'inline-flex min-h-10 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full border px-4 text-sm transition-colors',
      active
        ? 'border-court-strong bg-court-strong font-medium text-paper shadow-sm'
        : 'border-line bg-paper hover:border-court-strong hover:text-court-deep',
    );
  return (
    <div className="mb-6 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:mb-8">
      <Form
        data-nav-progress
        action={basePath}
        className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] gap-2 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_14rem_auto] sm:gap-3"
      >
        {current.category && <input type="hidden" name="category" value={current.category} />}
        <label htmlFor="catalog-q" className="sr-only">
          Tìm theo tên
        </label>
        <div className="relative col-span-2 sm:col-span-1">
          <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-4 size-5 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted" aria-hidden />
          <input
            id="catalog-q"
            name="q"
            type="search"
            defaultValue={current.q}
            placeholder="Tìm theo tên hoặc thương hiệu…"
            className="h-12 w-full rounded-control border border-line bg-paper pr-3 pl-12 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.04)] outline-none transition-colors focus:border-ink focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ink/10"
          />
        </div>
        <label htmlFor="catalog-branch" className="sr-only">
          Chi nhánh
        </label>
        <div className="relative">
          <MapPin className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3.5 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-ink" aria-hidden />
          <select
            id="catalog-branch"
            name="branch"
            defaultValue={current.branch ?? ''}
            className="h-12 w-full appearance-none rounded-control border border-line bg-paper pr-9 pl-10 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.04)] outline-none focus:border-ink"
          >
            <option value="">Mọi chi nhánh</option>
            {branches.map((b) => (
              <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>
                {b.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 right-3 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted" aria-hidden />
        </div>
        <button type="submit" className={buttonClass('primary', 'lg', 'h-12 min-h-12 px-5')}>
          <SlidersHorizontal className="size-4" aria-hidden />
          Lọc
        </button>
      </Form>
      {categories.length > 0 && (
        <nav aria-label="Nhóm hàng" className="scrollbar-none -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 sm:mx-0 sm:flex-wrap sm:px-0">
          <Link
            href={query({ category: undefined })}
            aria-current={!current.category ? 'page' : undefined}
            className={chip(!current.category)}
          >
            Tất cả
          </Link>
          {categories.map((c) => (
            <Link
              key={c.slug}
              href={query({ category: c.slug })}
              aria-current={current.category === c.slug ? 'page' : undefined}
              className={chip(current.category === c.slug)}
            >
              {c.name}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </nav>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Pagination({
  basePath,
  page,
  totalPages,
  params,
}: {
  basePath: string;
  page: number;
  totalPages: number;
  params: Record<string, string | undefined>;
}) {
  if (totalPages <= 1) return null;
  const href = (p: number) => {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) if (v) sp.set(k, v);
    if (p > 1) sp.set('page', String(p));
    const s = sp.toString();
    return s ? `${basePath}?${s}` : basePath;
  };
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Phân trang" className="mt-10 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
      {page > 1 ? (
        <Link href={href(page - 1)} className={buttonClass('outline')}>
          Trang trước
        </Link>
      ) : (
        <span />
      )}
      <span className="text-sm text-muted tabular">
        Trang {page}/{totalPages}
      </span>
      {page < totalPages ? (
        <Link href={href(page + 1)} className={buttonClass('outline')}>
          Trang sau
        </Link>
      ) : (
        <span />
      )}
    </nav>
  );
}

import 'server-only';

import { z } from 'zod';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { addDays } from '@/lib/time';

/** Dữ liệu cá nhân của nhân viên — RLS chỉ trả hàng của chính họ. */
export async function getMyOverview(employeeId: string, fromDate: string) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const [{ data: employee }, { data: shifts }, { data: lines }, { data: rates }, { data: adjustments }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('employees').select('full_name, code, branches(name)').eq('id', employeeId).maybeSingle(),
    supabase
      .from('shifts')
      .select(
        'id, work_date, scheduled_start, scheduled_end, status, checked_in_at, checked_out_at, scanned_in_at, scanned_out_at, in_source, out_source, actual_time_decision, paid_minutes, branches(name, timezone), shift_overtime(id, minutes, hourly_rate, reason, status, requested_at), attendance_fix_requests(id, kind, status, claimed_at, reason, decision_note, created_at)',
      )
      .eq('employee_id', employeeId)
      .is('deleted_at', null)
      .gte('work_date', addDays(fromDate, -14))
      .lte('work_date', addDays(fromDate, 21))
      .order('scheduled_start'),
    supabase
      .from('payroll_lines')
      .select(
        'period_id, shifts_count, paid_minutes, base_pay, adjustments_total, net_pay, overtime_minutes, overtime_pay, payroll_periods(month)',
      )
      .eq('employee_id', employeeId)
      .limit(12),
    supabase
      .from('employee_pay_rates')
      .select('pay_type, hourly_rate, daily_rate, effective_from')
      .eq('employee_id', employeeId)
      .order('effective_from', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1),
    supabase
      .from('payroll_adjustments')
      .select('id, month, amount, reason, voided_at')
      .eq('employee_id', employeeId)
      .is('voided_at', null)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(10),
  ]);
  return {
    employee,
    shifts: shifts ?? [],
    payslips: [...(lines ?? [])].sort((a, b) => (b.payroll_periods?.month ?? '').localeCompare(a.payroll_periods?.month ?? '')),
    rate: rates?.[0] ?? null,
    adjustments: adjustments ?? [],
  };
}

import 'server-only';

import { configuredSiteUrl } from '@/lib/site-origin';
import { getAlertEmailConfig } from '@/lib/env.server';
import { createSecretClient } from '@/lib/supabase/secret';

import { alertEmailHtml, alertEmailText, alertSubject, pendingAlertsSchema, type AlertItem } from './lib/alert-email';

export type AlertResult =
  | { status: 'sent'; count: number; recipients: number }
  | { status: 'nothing' }
  | { status: 'skipped'; reason: 'no_api_key' | 'no_recipients' }
  | { status: 'failed'; message: string };

/** Gửi một email qua Resend (gọi thẳng REST, không cần thư viện). */
async function sendEmail(
  to: string[],
  subject: string,
  html: string,
  text: string,
): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; message: string }> {
  const { apiKey, from, apiBase } = getAlertEmailConfig();
  if (!apiKey) return { ok: false, message: 'Chưa cấu hình RESEND_API_KEY.' };
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${apiBase.replace(/\/$/, '')}/emails`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ from, to, subject, html, text }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
      cache: 'no-store',
    });
    if (res.ok) return { ok: true };
    const body = (await res.text()).slice(0, 300);
    return { ok: false, message: `Resend trả lỗi ${res.status}: ${body}` };
  } catch (error) {
    return { ok: false, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Không gửi được email.' };
  }
}

const adminBankUrl = () => `${configuredSiteUrl()}/admin/bank?tab=pending`;

/**
 * Báo chủ sân các giao dịch "Cần xử lý" / "Chưa khớp đơn" chưa báo (gộp một email).
 * Gọi sau webhook, sau mỗi lần đối soát. Gửi thành công mới đánh dấu đã báo — lỗi thì lần sau thử lại.
 */
export async function sendPendingAlerts(): Promise<AlertResult> {
  const supabase = createSecretClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('service_pending_alerts', { p_limit: 20 });
  if (error) {
    console.error('[alerts] Không đọc được giao dịch cần báo (đã chạy 16_alerts_reconcile.sql?):', error.message);
    return { status: 'failed', message: error.message };
  }
  const parsed = pendingAlertsSchema.safeParse(data);
  if (!parsed.success || parsed.data.items.length === 0) return { status: 'nothing' };
  const { items, recipients } = parsed.data;
  if (!getAlertEmailConfig().apiKey) return { status: 'skipped', reason: 'no_api_key' };
  if (recipients.length === 0) return { status: 'skipped', reason: 'no_recipients' };

  const sent = await sendEmail(
    recipients,
    alertSubject(items),
    alertEmailHtml(items, adminBankUrl()),
    alertEmailText(items, adminBankUrl()),
  );
  if (!sent.ok) {
    console.error('[alerts] Gửi email cảnh báo lỗi:', sent.message);
    return { status: 'failed', message: sent.message };
  }
  await supabase.rpc('service_mark_alerted', { p_ids: items.map((i) => i.id) });
  return { status: 'sent', count: items.length, recipients: recipients.length };
}

/** Không để lỗi email làm hỏng việc chính (webhook, đối soát). */
export async function sendPendingAlertsSafely(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await sendPendingAlerts();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[alerts] Lỗi không mong muốn:', error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
  }
}

/** Email thử từ trang Cài đặt — kiểm tra khóa Resend và hộp thư nhận. */
export async function sendTestAlert(): Promise<{ ok: true; recipients: string[] } | { ok: false; message: string }> {
  const { data, error } = await createSecretClient().rpc('service_alert_recipients');
  if (error) return { ok: false, message: 'Chưa chạy 16_alerts_reconcile.sql trên Supabase.' };
  const recipients = Array.isArray(data) ? data.filter((e): e is string => typeof e === 'string') : [];
  if (recipients.length === 0) return { ok: false, message: 'Chưa có email nhận cảnh báo.' };
  const items = [SAMPLE];
  const sent = await sendEmail(
    recipients,
    `[Rally — email thử] ${alertSubject(items).replace('[Rally] ', '')}`,
    alertEmailHtml(items, adminBankUrl()),
    alertEmailText(items, adminBankUrl()),
  );
  return sent.ok ? { ok: true, recipients } : sent;
}

import 'server-only';

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export interface PayrollRow {
  employeeId: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  shifts: number;
  paidMinutes: number;
  basePay: number;
  adjustments: number;
  netPay: number;
  unresolved: number;
  missingRate: number;
  /** Phần tăng ca (đã gồm trong basePay). */
  overtimeMinutes: number;
  overtimePay: number;
  pendingOvertime: number;
}

export async function getPayrollMonth(month: string) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  // Một lượt song song: kỳ lương (kèm dòng lương nếu đã chốt) + các khoản điều chỉnh.
  const [periodRes, { data: adjustments }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('payroll_periods')
      .select(
        'id, closed_at, note, payroll_lines(employee_id, employee_code, employee_name, shifts_count, paid_minutes, base_pay, adjustments_total, net_pay, overtime_minutes, overtime_pay)',
      )
      .eq('month', month)
      .order('employee_name', { referencedTable: 'payroll_lines' })
      .maybeSingle(),
    supabase
      .from('payroll_adjustments')
      .select('id, amount, reason, created_at, voided_at, employees(full_name, code)')
      .eq('month', month)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
  ]);
  if (periodRes.error) throw periodRes.error;
  const closedPeriod = periodRes.data;
  const period = closedPeriod ? { id: closedPeriod.id, closed_at: closedPeriod.closed_at, note: closedPeriod.note } : null;

  let rows: PayrollRow[];
  if (closedPeriod) {
    rows = closedPeriod.payroll_lines.map((l) => ({
      employeeId: l.employee_id,
      code: l.employee_code,
      name: l.employee_name,
      shifts: l.shifts_count,
      paidMinutes: l.paid_minutes,
      basePay: l.base_pay,
      adjustments: l.adjustments_total,
      netPay: l.net_pay ?? l.base_pay + l.adjustments_total,
      unresolved: 0,
      missingRate: 0,
      overtimeMinutes: l.overtime_minutes,
      overtimePay: l.overtime_pay,
      pendingOvertime: 0,
    }));
  } else {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('preview_payroll_month', { p_month: month });
    if (error) throw error;
    rows = (data ?? []).map((l) => ({
      employeeId: l.employee_id,
      code: l.employee_code,
      name: l.employee_name,
      shifts: l.shifts_count,
      paidMinutes: l.paid_minutes,
      basePay: l.base_pay,
      adjustments: l.adjustments_total,
      netPay: l.net_pay,
      unresolved: l.unresolved_shifts,
      missingRate: l.missing_rate_shifts,
      overtimeMinutes: l.overtime_minutes,
      overtimePay: l.overtime_pay,
      pendingOvertime: l.pending_overtime,
    }));
  }

  return {
    period,
    rows,
    adjustments: adjustments ?? [],
    totals: {
      net: rows.reduce((n, r) => n + r.netPay, 0),
      unresolved: rows.reduce((n, r) => n + r.unresolved, 0),
      missingRate: rows.reduce((n, r) => n + r.missingRate, 0),
      overtimePay: rows.reduce((n, r) => n + r.overtimePay, 0),
      overtimeMinutes: rows.reduce((n, r) => n + r.overtimeMinutes, 0),
      pendingOvertime: rows.reduce((n, r) => n + r.pendingOvertime, 0),
    },
  };
}

export async function listEmployeesForPayroll() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data } = await supabase.from('employees').select('id, code, full_name').order('full_name');
  return data ?? [];
}

'use server';

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { z } from 'zod';

import { invalidatePublic } from '@/lib/public-cache';
import { requireBranchPermission } from '@/lib/auth/guards';
import { isOwner } from '@/lib/auth/permissions';
import { errorCode, toUserMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { zIdempotencyKey, zManualPaymentMethod, zOptionalText, zOptionalVnPhone } from '@/lib/validation';

const saleInputSchema = z.object({
  lines: z
    .array(z.object({ variantId: z.uuid(), unitId: z.uuid().nullable().optional(), quantity: z.number().int().min(1).max(1000) }))
    .min(1, 'Giỏ hàng đang trống')
    .max(30, 'Tối đa 30 dòng mỗi đơn'),
  paymentMethod: zManualPaymentMethod(),
  paymentReference: zOptionalText(100),
  discount: z.number().int().min(0).max(100_000_000),
  customerPhone: zOptionalVnPhone(),
  customerName: zOptionalText(80),
  note: zOptionalText(300),
  idempotencyKey: zIdempotencyKey(),
});

export type SaleInput = z.input<typeof saleInputSchema>;

export type SaleResult =
  | {
      ok: true;
      saleId: string;
      code: string;
      total: number;
      replayed: boolean;
      /** Chuyển khoản qua QR: nội dung RB… khách cần ghi, tiền chưa về (null = đã thu). */
      transferCode: string | null;
    }
  | { ok: false; error: string; code?: string };

const rpcResult = z.object({
  sale_id: z.uuid(),
  code: z.string(),
  total_amount: z.number(),
  replayed: z.boolean().optional(),
  transfer_code: z.string().nullish(),
  payment_status: z.string().optional(),
});

export async function recordSaleAction(input: SaleInput): Promise<SaleResult> {
  const { ctx, branch } = await requireBranchPermission('sale.record');
  const parsed = saleInputSchema.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) return { ok: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? 'Dữ liệu đơn không hợp lệ.' };
  const v = parsed.data;
  if (v.discount > 0 && !isOwner(ctx)) return { ok: false, error: 'Chỉ chủ sân được giảm giá.' };

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('record_sale', {
    p_branch_id: branch.branchId,
    p_lines: v.lines.map((l) => ({ variant_id: l.variantId, unit_id: l.unitId ?? null, quantity: l.quantity })),
    p_payment_method: v.paymentMethod,
    p_payment_reference: v.paymentReference,
    p_discount_amount: v.discount,
    p_customer_phone: v.customerPhone,
    p_customer_name: v.customerName,
    p_note: v.note,
    p_idempotency_key: v.idempotencyKey,
  });
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: toUserMessage(error), code: errorCode(error) ?? undefined };
  const res = rpcResult.safeParse(data);
  if (!res.success) return { ok: false, error: 'Không đọc được kết quả đơn bán.' };
  revalidatePath('/admin/sales');
  revalidatePath('/admin/inventory');
  revalidatePath('/admin');
  invalidatePublic('catalog');
  return {
    ok: true,
    saleId: res.data.sale_id,
    code: res.data.code,
    total: res.data.total_amount,
    replayed: res.data.replayed ?? false,
    transferCode: res.data.payment_status === 'pending' ? (res.data.transfer_code ?? null) : null,
  };
}

const transferStatusSchema = z.object({
  sale_status: z.string(),
  total_amount: z.number(),
  paid: z.number(),
  pending: z.object({ payment_id: z.string(), amount: z.number(), reference: z.string() }).nullable(),
});
export type SaleTransferStatus = z.infer<typeof transferStatusSchema>;

/** Màn chờ khách quét QR hỏi lại: tiền đã về chưa (SePay ghi nhận tự động). */
export async function saleTransferStatusAction(saleId: string): Promise<SaleTransferStatus | null> {
  await requireBranchPermission('sale.record');
  if (!z.uuid().safeParse(saleId).success) return null;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('sale_transfer_status', { p_sale_id: saleId });
  if (error) return null;
  const parsed = transferStatusSchema.safeParse(data);
  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : null;
}

/** Khách đổi ý trả tiền mặt / thẻ, hoặc nhân viên đã thấy tiền về và nhập mã giao dịch. */
export async function settlePendingSaleAction(
  saleId: string,
  method: 'cash' | 'bank_transfer',
  reference?: string,
): Promise<{ ok: true; status: SaleTransferStatus } | { ok: false; error: string }> {
  await requireBranchPermission('sale.record');
  const ref = reference?.trim() || null;
  if (method === 'bank_transfer' && (!ref || ref.length < 3))
    return { ok: false, error: 'Nhập mã giao dịch ngân hàng (tối thiểu 3 ký tự).' };
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('settle_pending_sale', {
    p_sale_id: saleId,
    p_method: method,
    p_reference: ref,
    p_idempotency_key: `settle:${saleId}:${method}`,
  });
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: toUserMessage(error) };
  const parsed = transferStatusSchema.safeParse(data);
  if (!parsed.success) return { ok: false, error: 'Không đọc được trạng thái đơn.' };
  revalidatePath('/admin/sales');
  return { ok: true, status: parsed.data };
}

/** Hủy đơn đang chờ chuyển khoản (khách không chuyển): trả hàng về kho, giữ lịch sử. */
export async function cancelPendingSaleAction(saleId: string, reason: string): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string }> {
  await requireBranchPermission('sale.record');
  const why = reason.trim();
  if (why.length < 3) return { ok: false, error: 'Nhập lý do hủy (tối thiểu 3 ký tự).' };
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.rpc('cancel_pending_sale', { p_sale_id: saleId, p_reason: why });
  if (error) return { ok: false, error: toUserMessage(error) };
  revalidatePath('/admin/sales');
  revalidatePath('/admin/inventory');
  invalidatePublic('catalog');
  return { ok: true };
}

'use client';

import { ShoppingBag } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { formatVnd } from '@/lib/format';

import { usePos } from '../hooks/use-pos';
import { cartTax, changeDue, filterItems, type PosItem } from '../lib/cart';

import { CartPanel, EMPTY_FORM, moneyInput, type CheckoutForm } from './cart-panel';

import { CatalogToolbar, ProductGrid } from './product-grid';

interface PosTerminalProps {
  branchName: string;
  cashierName: string;
  dateLabel: string;
  today: { count: number; revenue: number };
  brand: ReceiptBrand;
  items: PosItem[];
